article.articleHeadline: DR Congo: Ebola outbreak tops 4,000 confirmed cases
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) totals 4,053 confirmed cases across 53 health zones in five provinces as of August 5, 2026, with Ituri province the epicenter (86.9% of cases). Two zones are newly affected: Gombari (Haut-Uélé) and Bafwasende (Tshopo). Deaths reach 1,850 (case fatality rate 45.7%), with 793 recoveries and 694 patients in isolation or hospitalized. Contact tracing covers 77.7% of contacts, supported by 1,158 alerts investigated in 24 hours. The outbreak began May 15 and is the second largest Ebola outbreak on record, behind 2014-2016 West Africa and ahead of 2018-2020 Kivu. MSF warns of alarming, persistent spread and urges accelerated, better-supported response with community-led surveillance; only 59% of Ituri’s contacts have been traced and 90% of ETC admissions were not previously monitored contacts. Response priorities include surveillance, treatment centers, community engagement, and the free hotline 151 for suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラ出血熱の発生、確定症例数が4,000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例4,053例・死亡1,850例（CFR45.7%）に達し、史上2番目に大規模なエボラ流行として拡大中であり、接触者追跡率も不十分でヒト-ヒト感染の継続リスクが高いため。
triage.notes: MSFが接触者追跡の不備（Ituri州で59%のみ）とサーベイランス強化の必要性を指摘。5州53保健区に拡大し、新たにGombari（Haut-Uélé）とBafwasende（Tshopo）が影響を受けている。

article.articleHeadline: Resistensi Malaria Mengintai, Efektivitas Obat Nyaris Batas Kritis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria resistance looms, drug efficacy nearly at a critical threshold.
article.articleSummary: Malaria in Indonesia shows early signs of resistance to piperaquine, though artemisinin and its derivatives remain effective according to researchers. BRIN reports that some parasites can survive therapy, complicating distinctions between reinfection and treatment failure. Genetic markers pfpm2 and pfmdr1 are used to monitor resistance patterns, with initial data indicating most parasites remain theoretically sensitive to piperaquine, yet field isolates exhibit survival post-therapy. The finding suggests resistance mechanisms are more complex than anticipated and calls for deeper genetic studies. BRIN is also pursuing new molecular targets for next-generation antimalarials, notably the apicoplast, a parasite-specific organelle vital to metabolism. Researchers warn that Plasmodium will continue to evolve genetically, underscoring ongoing research to preserve current therapies and accelerate discovery of new drugs to support Indonesia's malaria elimination target by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア耐性が忍び寄る、薬効はほぼ危機的閾値に
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでマラリア原虫のピペラキニン耐性の初期兆候が報告されているが、現時点で主要治療薬アルテミシニンは有効であり、研究段階の知見にとどまるため継続的な観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 研究機関BRINによる薬剤耐性モニタリングの報告であり、緊急対応を要する流行事象ではないが、マラリア根絶目標（2030年）に関わる長期的な監視対象として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah Patient Recovers After 45 Days on Ventilator, Discharged in Kerala
article.articleSummary: A 43-year-old Nipah patient from Farook in Kerala was discharged from Government Medical College Hospital, Kozhikode, after about two months of treatment, having spent nearly 1.5 months on a ventilator. He walked out without assistance and had regained normal cognitive functions, including memory. Kerala Health Minister K Muraleedharan attributed the recovery to the coordinated efforts of the entire health department, from cleaning staff to clinicians, and said every worker could take pride in saving the patient’s life. He also noted that Kerala reported no Nipah-related deaths during the latest outbreak. The discharge comes as Kerala continues Nipah surveillance and hospital preparedness during the latest outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ニパウイルス感染患者、人工呼吸器装着45日後に回復しケララ州で退院
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州で続くニパウイルス感染流行における重症例（人工呼吸器装着）の回復事例であり、致死率の高い人獣共通感染症でIHR基準の重大性・異常性に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はケララ州（インド）における進行中のニパウイルス流行の一環としての回復例を報じている。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は現時点で見られないが、ニパウイルスはヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があり継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola tại Congo vượt 4000 Ca, WHO đề xuất thử nghiệm vaccine
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceeds 4,000 cases; WHO proposes a vaccine trial.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 4,053 cases and 1,850 deaths due to Bundibugyo since mid-May, spanning 53 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo. Ituri accounts for about 87% of cases, North Kivu about 11%. This is the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record; official counts may understate reality. Only the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) was larger. Response challenges include armed conflict, delayed detection, and limited therapies and vaccines, with transmission mainly via contact with bodily fluids. On August 7, WHO recommended initiating comprehensive human trials of Ervebo, the only licensed Ebola vaccine, to assess possible cross-protection against Bundibugyo. Animal data show protection in non-human primates and ferrets against Bundibugyo. TAG-CVP cautions that Bundibugyo-specific vaccines remain the priority; avoid hasty actions without solid evidence. Two Bundibugyo-targeted candidates are in early trials; a third is fast-tracked.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ流行が4,000人超、WHOがワクチン試験を提案
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で4,000例超・死者1,850人規模のエボラ（ブンディブジョ株）流行が発生し、史上最速の拡大速度、武力衝突による対応の困難さ、ワクチン未確立という点でIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 西アフリカ2014-2016流行に次ぐ規模とされ、武力紛争地域での対応困難、ワクチン未承認株（ブンディブジョ）への対処としてErvebo交差防御試験が提案されている。リベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネは過去の流行事例として言及されているのみで、今回の発生地域ではないため対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 專家稱香港受「三疫夾擊」　籲市民不要掉以輕心 - 香港文匯報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts say Hong Kong is under a "triple-epidemic onslaught," urging the public not to let their guard down - Wen Wei Po (Hong Kong)
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong faces a triple-epidemic of COVID-19, influenza, and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), according to Dr. Kwan Yat-wah, President of the Asian Society of Pediatric Infectious Diseases and Honorary Clinical Associate Professor at HKU’s Pediatrics and Adolescent Medicine. A 7-year-old boy died from influenza A presenting with shock and encephalopathy; the case is described as unfortunate and not indicative of vaccine failure, noting that antibodies may wane over time and individual immune factors or potential antigenic drift should be considered. Despite summer holidays, group activities can sustain transmission, with flu activity not yet peaked. Citizens are urged to maintain protections—mask-wearing and diligent hand hygiene, especially during travel—and to monitor for severe symptoms. The article emphasizes continuing vaccination confidence while evaluating the need for boosters or updated strains.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家、香港は「三重疫病の猛攻」に見舞われていると指摘　市民に警戒緩めぬよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のCOVID-19・インフルエンザ・RSVの同時流行であり、小児の重症死亡例はあるが、国際的拡大や渡航貿易制限の兆候はなく、通常の季節性感染症動向として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 香港の記事のためChina(1814991)に統合。COVID-19・インフルエンザ・RSVの季節性流行に関する報道で、小児のインフルエンザA重症死亡例が1件報告されているが、集団感染や異常なアウトブレイクを示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ngăn dịch Ebola lan rộng, Mỹ thông báo sẽ cấp thêm 242 triệu USD để ứng phó
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To prevent the Ebola outbreak from spreading, the United States announced it would provide an additional $242 million to respond.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to escalate as Africa CDC implements vaccination with the Ebola Zaire vaccine and expands remdesivir use. Congo reports more than 4,000 cases and about 1,850 deaths, with funding shortfalls, limited treatment capacity, security instability, and incomplete contact tracing hindering control. In Uganda, authorities report a recent Ebola outbreak with roughly a 10% case-fatality rate, crediting remdesivir with improved outcomes; Uganda declared the outbreak over in mid-July after the last patient discharge. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting the DRC, warned the outbreak has outpaced response capacity and urged decisive international action. The United States announced an additional $242 million for the eastern DRC response, raising total direct aid to $512 million to fund six months of emergency operations. African health officials urged continued global support to contain what is described as the region’s most serious outbreak in years.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行拡大防止のため、米国が追加で2億4200万ドルの支援を発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で4,000例以上・死者約1,850人という大規模なエボラ流行が継続し、資金不足・治安不安等で対応が追いついておらず、WHOも国際的な対応拡大を要請しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダの流行は7月中旬に終息宣言済みのため、現在進行中の主要な懸念はDRCの流行。米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: أميركا ترفع التأهب ضد إيبولا.. إجراءات استثنائية للمسافرين من إفريقيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States raises its Ebola alert: extraordinary measures for travelers from Africa.
article.articleSummary: The United States raises its Ebola alert with extraordinary travel restrictions for travelers returning from Africa. Based on CDC guidelines issued Friday, U.S.-bound travelers who visited Uganda or South Sudan within 21 days before arrival will be routed to specific U.S. airports for public health entry screening, including those who only transited through these countries. For travelers who visited the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) within 21 days before travel to the United States, they will not be allowed to board commercial flights to the U.S. and must remain outside the United States until 21 days have elapsed since leaving the DRC. Some travelers to Ebola-affected areas in the DRC may face additional local travel requirements before departure. If Ebola is suspected, the traveler will be transported to a hospital for testing, isolation, and care.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ警戒を強化：アフリカからの渡航者に対する特別措置
triage.triage_reason: 米国CDCがコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ発生地域からの渡航者に対し異例の入国制限・隔離措置を発表しており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大・渡航制限）を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのエボラ発生地域を対象とした米国の渡航制限措置について述べている。ウガンダ・南スーダンは経由地としてスクリーニング対象に含まれるが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations からは除外。米国も対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo registra 23 casos de sarampo, sendo 16 pessoas não vacinadas. - Fala Canedo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo records 23 measles cases, with 16 unvaccinated people. - Fala Canedo.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in the State of São Paulo, Brazil, with 23 confirmed cases, 16 of which involve unvaccinated individuals, highlighting vaccine hesitancy (about 69%). Cases are concentrated in the City of São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo, suggesting rapid spread in areas with lower immunization coverage. Measles is highly contagious and transmits via respiratory droplets; infection can cause pneumonia and encephalitis, potentially fatal. Health authorities will intensify vaccination campaigns to reach non-vaccinated populations and reinforce immunization in at-risk zones, with emphasis on children and pregnant women. Public health education is emphasized to counter misinformation and improve access to reliable vaccination information. Next steps include monitoring cases, expanding vaccination outreach, and providing psychosocial support to hesitant parents to safeguard community health.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で麻疹23例確認、うち16人は未接種者
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹は高い伝染力を持ち、未接種者を中心に流行が拡大しており、WPRO基準（異常性・重症度・持続曝露・流行性）を複数満たし、当局が対策強化に動いていることから社会的関心も認められる。
triage.notes: 感染はサンパウロ市、グアルーリョス、サンベルナルド・ド・カンポに集中しており、ワクチン忌避（約69%）が拡大要因とされる。国際的拡大やIHR相当の深刻性を示す情報は現時点でなし。

article.articleHeadline: 已接種疫苗7歲男童染甲流不治　專家指屬個別事件
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccinated 7-year-old boy dies from influenza A; experts say it's an isolated case.
article.articleSummary: Seven-year-old boy, fully vaccinated against influenza, died from influenza A with shock and encephalopathy after ICU treatment at Queen Mary Hospital, Hong Kong. He passed away on August 4, 2026, the year’s first pediatric flu death. Dr. Kwan Yat-Wah, President of the Asia Society of Pediatric Infectious Diseases and Honorary Clinical Associate Professor at HKU, described the case as unlucky and isolated, urging public confidence in vaccination. He noted that some individuals mount exaggerated immune responses leading to rapid deterioration; vaccine antibodies wane after about six months and outcomes depend on underlying conditions and potential viral mutations. Hong Kong faces triple threats: COVID-19, influenza, and RSV. By end-July, the Centre for Health Protection recorded 12 children with severe influenza complications. Although summer holidays reduce school contact, gatherings persist. Those vaccinated last year may skip revaccination until the new program starts.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチン接種済みの7歳男児がA型インフルエンザで死亡　専門家は個別事例と指摘
triage.triage_reason: 香港での小児インフルエンザ死亡例だが専門家は「個別事例」と評価しており、異常性や国際的拡大の根拠は乏しい。ただし季節性インフルエンザ・RSV・COVID-19の同時流行状況が続いているため、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 香港はCOVID-19・インフルエンザ・RSVの三重流行状態にあり、季節性重症化例（今年初の小児死亡）として報告されているが、専門家は孤立事例と説明し公衆衛生上の重大な異常性は認めていない。続報（重症例数の推移等）を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Avika Gor Hospitalised With Dengue, Shot Through Fever
article.articleSummary: Dengue patient in Mumbai: Actress Avika Gor has been hospitalised after testing positive for dengue. Her husband Milind Chandwani posted that she had a sustained fever of 103–104°F for five days and was admitted last night. Despite the illness, Gor continued working, completing a two‑day project in one day and then travelling to Delhi for an ad shoot to prevent producer losses, after tests confirmed she hadn’t contracted another virus. He praised her work ethic and said she prioritized others’ time and money over her health. Gor later shared hospital‑bed updates, flashing a victory sign and noting her platelet counts as she received treatment with an IV drip. Her new song Bukhaar released the same day, and Milind urged fans to keep her in their prayers. Gor rose to fame in Balika Vadhu and later acted in Telugu and Hindi projects.

triage.headline_ja: 女優アビカ・ゴールがデング熱で入院、発熱に見舞われる
triage.triage_reason: 単一の芸能人個人症例に関する報道であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生や異常性を示す情報がないため、公衆衛生シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 有名人の個別症例報道であり、デング熱の集団発生や公衆衛生上の脅威に関する情報は含まれていない。芸能ニュースとしての注目度はあるが、感染症サーベイランスの観点では見送り。

article.articleHeadline: 1.259 ca sốt xuất huyết, Hà Nội tăng cường kiểm tra phòng dịch trên toàn thành phố
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 1,259 dengue fever cases, Hanoi steps up disease-prevention inspections citywide.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Hanoi, Vietnam, rose to 1,259 cases as of Aug 5, 2026, across 115 of 126 communes/wards, signaling peak-season transmission. Hanoi’s Department of Health has formed 46 inspection teams to scrutinize 91 communes/wards with recent cases over the past two weeks, focusing on epidemiological surveillance, outbreak response, vector control, risk communication, and local readiness. On Aug 7, teams visited Gia Lam (6 cases this year) and Phu Dong (7 cases across seven villages). Gia Lam maintains 276 vector-control squads and 36 surveillance teams, conducting two environmental cleanups and trainings, with spraying readiness. Phu Dong organized 552 rapid-response members, 71 surveillance teams, and a 30-person spraying unit. In central wards Cu Nam and Hoan Kiem, Cu Nam reported extensive household checks (over 14,100), removal of 1,118 larval containers, release of ~5,000 larvivorous fish, and school spraying. Hoan Kiem documented 3 cases and 1 outbreak, with 901 staff/volunteers, 16,600 households checked, 1,266 larval containers addressed, and broad public-info efforts. Authorities call for continued surveillance and community-led environmental sanitation to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱1,259例、ハノイ市が全市で防疫検査を強化
triage.triage_reason: 季節性デング熱の増加であり、当局が既に対応体制を強化しているため、現時点でIHR基準への該当は限定的だが、症例増加傾向は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: ハノイ市内で毎年見られる季節性デング熱の流行。市当局が独自に検査班・防除体制を強化しており、外部支援の必要性は示唆されていない。重症度（入院・死亡数）については記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: 七歲男童中甲流死亡　關日華：屬個別事件　盼勿礙市民對疫苗信心
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seven-year-old boy dies from H1N1 influenza; Kwan Ri-hua says it is an isolated incident and hopes it will not undermine public confidence in vaccines.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-08, Hong Kong reports a seven-year-old boy who died from influenza A (H1N1) with shock and encephalopathy; the Asian Society of Pediatric Infectious Diseases president Dr. Kwan Ri-hua states the death is unfortunate and emphasizes not to downplay influenza, as some individuals' immune response can trigger rapid deterioration. The child had previously received a flu vaccine; Kwan says the incident is isolated and notes waning antibodies over time, urging analysis of congenital factors and possible viral mutations. He warns Hong Kong is facing a 'triple attack' of COVID-19, influenza, and RSV, with flu season ongoing. He adds that pediatric influenza-related severe cases requiring hospitalization are higher this year than last, and advises parents to vaccinate children before summer break ends.

triage.headline_ja: 7歳男児がA型インフルエンザ(H1N1)で死亡、関日華医師「個別の事例」とし、ワクチンへの信頼を損なわないよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 香港で小児のH1N1インフルエンザ死亡例が報告されたが、専門家は「個別事例」と説明。ただし今シーズンの小児重症例増加や新型コロナ・RSVとの「三重流行」状況があり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 香港特別行政区の事例だが、対象国リストの規定によりChina(1814991)に分類。専門家は個別事例と強調しているが、今シーズンの小児インフルエンザ重症化例増加という文脈があるため、季節性動向として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Avika Gor Hospitalised After Battling Dengue, Husband Milind Chandwani Shares Health Update
article.articleSummary: Balika Vadhu actress Avika Gor is hospitalized after testing positive for dengue, with a fever of 103–104°F for the past five days. Despite the high fever, she completed two days of a project shoot, then traveled to Delhi for an ad shoot and returned to Mumbai last night; dengue confirmation followed. Husband Milind Chandwani said she had been in bed, barely able to move or eat, yet refused to postpone work to avoid losses, continuing professional commitments. Gor posted from hospital with a selfie, mentioning platelets and the Bukhaar song releasing the same day. She had been admitted to hospital after the Delhi-Mumbai stint, and her illness intersects with her role as a contestant on Rohit Shetty-hosted Khatron Ke Khiladi 15. Several celebrities sent wishes for her speedy recovery. Published date: 2026-08-08.

triage.headline_ja: アヴィカ・ゴール、デング熱との闘病後に入院 夫ミリンド・チャンドワニが健康状態を報告
triage.triage_reason: 個人の芸能人がデング熱に感染したという単発の人物ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の異常性や集団発生を示す情報がないため。
triage.notes: インドはデング熱の流行国として季節的に既知であり、本記事は著名人個人の罹患報告に過ぎず、公衆衛生イベントとしての新規性・異常性はない。

article.articleHeadline: 50 muertos al día y 99 nuevos contagios, el último balance del ébola que asusta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 50 deaths per day and 99 new infections, the latest Ebola tally that is alarming.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-08, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is escalating, with 99 new confirmed cases and 52 deaths reported in the last 24 hours. Cumulatively, the country has 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths. WHO warns the outbreak is out of control, with contact tracing at 75%, far below the 95% operational target required to rapidly identify transmission chains and detect new cases among known contacts. The warning follows a high-level WHO mission to the affected area, highlighting persistent transmission and the urgent need to bolster surveillance, tracing, and response measures to curb further spread within the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 1日50人死亡、新規感染99人—懸念高まるエボラ最新集計
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ流行が拡大し、WHOが制御不能と警告するなど深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: WHOが接触者追跡率が目標を大きく下回り、流行が制御不能と警告している点が重要。致死率も非常に高い（約45%）。

article.articleHeadline: Panic in Nagarahole after hairless dhole spotted, feared to have contagious skin disease
article.articleSummary: At Nagarahole Tiger Reserve (NTR), a hairless dhole was spotted during a safari in the Antharsanthe Range, about 2 km from a village. The sighting involved one individual from a four-dhole pack; the other dholes showed no signs of disease. Veterinarians say the skin condition could be scabies (sarcoptic mange) or demodicosis, hypodermitis, a fungal infection, or canine distemper (paramyxovirus)—all contagious to canines and felines and potentially fatal. Because dholes roam long distances, infection could have originated from village dogs. Forest officials plan to sedate and capture the animal for detailed testing for viral and fungal infections before deciding whether to treat and release or euthanize. After capture, the pack will be closely monitored for signs. This is the first reported incident of its kind in this forest patch.

triage.headline_ja: ナガラホーレで毛が抜けたドール(野犬)が発見され、伝染性皮膚病の疑いでパニック
triage.triage_reason: 野生動物（ドール）1頭に皮膚疾患の疑いが見られた事例で、人への感染リスクや公衆衛生上の影響は示唆されておらず、ヒトの感染症シグナルとしての重要性は低い。
triage.notes: 疾患は動物（イヌ科野生動物）の皮膚疾患であり、ヒトの感染症事象ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: ഇന്ത്യയിൽ മലേറിയ രോഗബാധ കിഴക്കൻ-മധ്യ സംസ്ഥാനങ്ങളിൽ അതിരൂക്ഷം: മൂന്ന് വർഷത്തിനിടെ പതിനായിരക്കണക്കിന് കേസുകളുമായി പശ്ചിമ ബംഗാളും ഒഡീഷയും മുന്നിൽ, കേരളത്തിൽ 10 മരണം; പ്രതിരോധ മരുന്നുകൾ വാങ്ങാനുള്ള ചുമതല കേന്ദ്രം സംസ്ഥാനങ്ങൾക്ക് നൽകി
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria burden in India severe in the east-central states: within three years, West Bengal and Odisha lead with hundreds of thousands of cases; Kerala records 10 deaths; the Centre has entrusted the procurement of preventive medicines to the states.
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains a major burden in India's east-central states. RTI-derived data identify West Bengal, Odisha, Lakshadweep, Chhattisgarh, and Tripura as the top five burdened areas; Lakshadweep is among the least affected. West Bengal recorded 23,428 cases in 2023, 19,497 in 2024, and 18,872 in 2025. National totals show 2023: 181,785 cases and 56 deaths; 2024: 207,855 cases and 45 deaths; 2025: 168,414 cases and 41 deaths. Over three years, Maharashtra accounted for the most malaria deaths (56), followed by Mizoram (17), Odisha (14), Kerala (10), and Chhattisgarh (9). Monsoon months (July–September) are peak transmission. Lakshadweep reports zero malaria cases for three years; Sikkim, Ladakh, Manipur, and Puducherry also report very low numbers. From 2026-27, the central procurement of three major malaria preventive medicines will be decentralized to states, funded through the National Health Mission."} }) }  // Note: final output is a concise 100–150 word summary focused on disease, locations, case/death counts, trends, and policy changes.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Washington announces strict health measures at airports to confront health risks...
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-08, Washington announced strict health measures at U.S. airports to counter Ebola transmission risks. The United States imposed temporary travel restrictions on travelers returning from Uganda, South Sudan, and the Democratic Republic of Congo. The measures form part of public health efforts to prevent importation of Ebola and to strengthen screening at points of entry. Instructions indicate that flights may be subject to additional local requirements imposed by authorities before departure. The report does not provide case counts or laboratory confirmations, focusing on policy actions rather than confirmed outbreaks. The steps illustrate ongoing risk-management to curb Ebola spread through international travel, aligning with border-control and aviation health protocols and emphasizing compliance with local authority requirements for travelers from these affected countries.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avika Gaur diagnosed with dengue fever; actress hospitalized; husband Milind provides health update.
article.articleSummary: Avika Gaur, Indian TV actress known for Balika Vadhu and Sasural Simar Ka, has dengue fever and is hospitalized. As of 8 August 2026, her husband Milind Chandwani posted a video update saying she had a five-day fever of 103–104°F but still completed a Delhi shoot; dengue was confirmed after a medical test conducted before travel to Delhi. She has since been admitted to hospital, with Instagram posts showing her in bed and receiving IV fluids. Fans are urged to pray for her recovery; there are no reports of fatalities or a broader outbreak. The report centers on her diagnosis and hospitalization, while also noting her career background and previous pregnancy‑rumor discussions during public appearances.

article.articleHeadline: 浪浪舔一下！陸女診斷「3級暴露」　醫：狂犬病致死率近100%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A stray dog licks her! Mainland Chinese woman diagnosed with “Category 3 exposure”; doctor says the rabies fatality rate is nearly 100%.
article.articleSummary: Rabies exposure in Zhejiang, China: A Mainland Chinese woman was licked on the toe by a stray dog while she and her husband were in a park. The toe had paronychia and skin breakdown. At Zhejiang Provincial People's Hospital, clinicians classified the incident as Category 3 exposure per the 2023 Rabies Exposure Prevention and Management guidelines, which includes cases where saliva contacts broken skin or mucous membranes and requires immediate passive and active immunization. She received rabies vaccines along with rabies immune globulin. The article emphasizes that rabies is an acute infectious disease with near 100% fatality if untreated, but timely, guideline-adherent post-exposure management reduces risk. It advises not to judge skin integrity by feel alone, especially in hot summer months when animals may be more irritable. The case underscores the need to seek medical evaluation after dog bites, scratches, or even saliva contact with broken skin.

triage.headline_ja: 野良犬に舐められた！中国本土の女性が「3級暴露」と診断—医師「狂犬病の致死率はほぼ100%」
triage.triage_reason: 個別の曝露事例で適切な曝露後予防が実施されており、公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Eduardo Bolsonaro aprofunda campanha antivacina e ignora surto de sarampo nos Estados Unidos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Eduardo Bolsonaro deepens anti-vaccine campaign and ignores measles outbreak in the United States.
article.articleSummary: Eduardo Bolsonaro promotes anti-vaccine views after recording a video in Texas celebrating a bureaucratic waiver allowing his daughter to attend school unvaccinated, having paid $10 for a sworn statement of non-vaccination. He criticizes Brazil’s immunization policy and frames vaccination as parental liberty, portraying public health measures as government overreach. The piece links such rhetoric to broader anti-vaccine conspiracy theories imported from the United States. It notes that measles has reemerged in the United States, with outbreaks across multiple states, amid weakened vaccination coverage under negationist policies. Consequently, Brazilian health authorities issued travel advisories urging travelers to the US to receive a measles booster to avoid reintroducing the virus. The article warns that Bolsonaro’s stance undermines Brazil’s National Immunization Program and signals risks for public health.

article.articleHeadline: US tightens travel rules for people returning from Ebola-hit regions
article.articleSummary: Ebola travel restrictions: The United States imposes temporary controls on travelers from Uganda, South Sudan, and the Democratic Republic of Congo to curb Ebola spread. As of 2026-08-08, passengers who recently visited Uganda or South Sudan must undergo arrival screening at designated US airports; US citizens and nationals who were in those countries (within 21 days) will have air travel routed for public health entry screening. Travelers who have been in DRC within 21 days prior to departure are prohibited from boarding U.S.-bound flights and must remain outside the United States until 21 days have elapsed since leaving DRC. In addition, travelers from Ebola-affected provinces in DRC may face extra requirements imposed by local authorities before leaving the country. If Ebola is suspected, individuals will be transferred to a hospital for evaluation, isolation, and care.

triage.notes: 記事はDRC発のエボラ流行に対する米国の渡航制限措置を報じている。ウガンダ・南スーダンも発生地域として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。米国も対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah Rabies, 190 Hewan Peliharaan Warga Sidrap Divaksin Gratis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies Prevention: 190 Sidrap Residents' Pets Vaccinated for Free.
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination campaign in Sidrap, South Sulawesi, Indonesia vaccinated 190 pets across Baranti and Watang Pulu. On Aug 4, 2026, Baranti vaccinated 111 dogs; on Aug 5, 2026, Watang Pulu vaccinated 79 pets. Vaccinations are provided free of charge, funded by local APBD with support from the South Sulawesi provincial government and the central government. The Dinas Peternakan dan Perikanan Sidrap led the effort, with veterinarians and KKN-T veterinary medicine students educating residents and assisting vaccination. The rabies vaccine consists of inactivated or attenuated rabies virus to stimulate antibody production, and the program also includes health checks and rabies prevention education. The campaign aims to curb rabies transmission via bites, scratches, or saliva, protecting both animal and human health, with positive community reception.

article.articleHeadline: 兒童流感入院流感併發重症個案增　關日華籲暑假期間盡快接種疫苗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pediatric influenza hospitalizations and influenza-related severe cases on the rise; Guan Rihua urges vaccination as soon as possible during the summer vacation.
article.articleSummary: Influenza in Asia-Pacific children remains at a summer peak, with pediatric hospitalizations and severe cases rising versus last year, according to Guan Rihua, president of the Asian Society for Pediatric Infectious Diseases. He urges parents to vaccinate children before the school term resumes and before summer ends, noting vaccines for the 2025/2026 season should be given if not yet administered. Infections may involve brain involvement and can progress to severe pneumonia or gastroenteritis, with a mention of COVID-19–associated croup. As schools prepare to reopen, vigilance is advised; even those inoculated retain partial protection, though it wanes, and people are encouraged to wear masks in crowded settings. The vaccination push during summer vacation is emphasized to curb the ongoing pediatric influenza burden across Asia.

article.articleHeadline: L'impatto dell'epidemia di Ebola nei campi profughi dell'Ituri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The impact of the Ebola epidemic in the Ituri refugee camps.
article.articleSummary: Ebola, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, is impacting the Ituri refugee camps around Bunia, Democratic Republic of Congo, with the outbreak declared May 15, 2026 and ongoing as of August 8, 2026. In camps like Kigonze, housing over 25,000 people in crowded tents, transmission is challenging: spread occurs through direct contact with blood or other bodily fluids of sick or dead individuals, and via contaminated objects; it is not airborne. Mercy Corps’ analysis across seven IDP sites finds 81% of families report receiving no humanitarian aid since the outbreak; existing handwashing stations are often under-resourced. Effective containment requires continuous water, soap, and hygiene at latrines, markets, food distribution points, clinics, and schools. Fear and delayed care hinder early presentation. In the absence of a licensed Bundibugyo-specific vaccine, response hinges on rapid case recognition, triage, isolation, health-worker protection, meticulous contact tracing, decentralized diagnostics, and strong community engagement, including safe and dignified burials.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ難民キャンプにおけるエボラ流行の影響
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州の難民キャンプでBundibugyoエボラウイルスによるアウトブレイクが継続しており、人道支援不足・過密環境・ワクチン未承認等によりヒト-ヒト感染拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 難民キャンプという脆弱な環境下でのエボラ（Bundibugyo種）流行であり、ワクチン未承認、人道支援不足（81%が支援未受領）、衛生設備不足が報告されている。継続的なモニタリングとフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ebola na RD Congo chega a 3.605 casos e 1.587 mortes; OMS reforça resposta e alerta para risco de propagação internacional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo reaches 3,605 cases and 1,587 deaths; WHO intensifies response and warns of risk of international spread.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 3,605 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths as of 30 July 2026 (case fatality rate 44%), the largest Ebola surge to date. Transmission now spans five provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo—and 49 health zones, with Mongbwalu area and Nizi hosting over 80,000 displaced people in 22 camps. Factors include population movement, mining activity, insecurity, and cross-border mobility. An Ebola Treatment Center’s capacity was expanded to 80 beds (30 new beds, 38 mattresses). In the past week, 567 new cases and 296 deaths were reported. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus; WHO warns of international spread risk and has mobilized a regional mission led by WHO Africa and Africa CDC, meeting in Kampala, Uganda, with Mohamed Janabi and Jean Kaseya to strengthen regional health security.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、3,605症例・1,587人死亡に達する；WHOが対応を強化し国際的拡大リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、WHOが正式に国際拡大リスクを警告しており、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事にウガンダ（カンパラ）が登場するが、これはWHO/Africa CDCによる地域対応会議の開催地であり、感染発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。過去最大規模のエボラ流行であり、5州49保健地域に拡大、8万人以上の避難民キャンプも存在するなど、極めて深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Papua Terkini: Baru 2 Pasien Keracunan MBG Pulang dari RS Dian Harapan Jayapura, Sebagian Observasi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Papua Today: Only two MBG-poisoned patients discharged from Dian Harapan Hospital in Jayapura, with some under observation.
article.articleSummary: Mass MBG poisoning in Jayapura, Papua, involves 24 patients treated at Dian Harapan Jayapura Hospital (Perumnas II). By August 8, 2026, two have recovered and been discharged; the rest remain in intensive care or under close observation. The hospital has expanded capacity with 20 additional beds funded by Denzipur 10/KYD Waena, anticipating referrals from overwhelmed facilities like RSUD Yowari. To optimize patient flow, authorities plan to redistribute admissions to facilities with available capacity as clinically appropriate. Ambulances were dispatched to Depapre to accelerate evacuation; the cohort includes children and adults, with several pediatric cases stabilizing while others require monitoring. Main symptoms are vomiting and diarrhea; some patients, including children, are developing malaria-related fever. Deputy Minister Ribka Haluk and BGN Deputy Head Trenggono visited to review clinical status and readiness; BGN is probing the suspected MBG poisoning source.

article.articleHeadline: الولايات المتحدة تفرض قيود سفر على العائدين من مناطق متضررة من الإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States imposes travel restrictions on returnees from areas affected by Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Aug 8, 2026 — The United States has imposed temporary Ebola-related travel restrictions on returnees from Uganda, South Sudan, and the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Under CDC public health protocols, travelers who visited Uganda or South Sudan (including layovers) within 21 days before arriving in the United States must be directed to designated U.S. airports for entry health screenings. Citizens or nationals who visited the DRC within 21 days before departure are prohibited from boarding commercial flights to the United States and must remain outside the U.S. for 21 days after leaving the DRC. The guidance notes possible additional local travel requirements before departure from affected areas. These measures aim to reduce Ebola transmission risk associated with international travel and reflect ongoing public health protections for travelers from Ebola-affected regions.

article.articleHeadline: डीआरसी के इतुरी में इबोला का प्रकोप, सबसे ज्यादा असर महिलाओं और बच्चों पर: संयुक्त राष्ट्र
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Ituri, DR Congo, hits women and children the hardest: United Nations.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is hitting women and children hardest. UN OCHA says about 1 million people are displaced in Ituri, with 80% women and children. UNICEF notes children account for one-third of deaths and a quarter of confirmed cases. Health services in affected areas have fallen by more than 40% due to fear of infection. UNFPA warns pregnant women are going without care; obstetric deaths have nearly doubled, and in Ebola-affected pregnancies fetal death is common. UNICEF and partners have deployed 13,000 community workers who reached over 2.4 million people and conducted more than 500,000 household visits to counter misinformation and encourage care-seeking. South Sudan is aiding preparedness; no confirmed Ebola cases yet, but cross-border risk remains. Preparedness includes surveillance, entry-point screening, staff training, and supplies; this month 135,300 travelers were screened, 300+ staff trained, and 7 tons of supplies stored near Yambio.

triage.headline_ja: DRCイトゥリ州でエボラ出血熱が流行、女性と子どもに最も深刻な影響：国連

triage.notes: 南スーダンでの越境リスクや準備活動が言及されているが、確定症例は未報告であり対象国リストにも南スーダンは含まれないため除外。国連機関（OCHA, UNICEF, UNFPA）による人道的影響の詳細な報告があり、既存の流行状況の深刻化を示す内容。

article.articleHeadline: Chandipura Virus Symptoms in Children: Warning Signs to Know
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus (CHPV) has re-emerged in India, with confirmed infections among children under 15 in Gujarat during the 2026 monsoon season. National surveillance has intensified and a dedicated outbreak response team deployed as CHPV can progress rapidly from fever to acute encephalitis syndrome (AES) in some children. CHPV belongs to the Vesiculovirus genus of the Rhabdoviridae family; transmission is mainly via bites from infected female sandflies, with no routine person-to-person spread established. The illness often begins with fever and may resemble other viral infections, but warning signs—high fever with persistent vomiting, unusual drowsiness, seizures, confusion, or altered responsiveness—require immediate medical care, especially within 24–48 hours. There is currently no licensed vaccine or specific antiviral treatment; care is supportive (fever control, seizure management, breathing and hydration, neurological monitoring). Prevention focuses on avoiding sandfly bites, as there is no vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: チャンディプラウイルス感染症の小児における症状:知っておくべき警告サイン
triage.triage_reason: インドのグジャラート州で小児にチャンディプラウイルスによる急性脳炎症候群が再発生し、国家的サーベイランス強化と対応チーム展開がなされているため、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を2つ満たしフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスはサシチョウバエ媒介のウイルスで、ヒト-ヒト感染は確立されていない。グジャラート州で毎年モンスーン期に散発する既知の疾患だが、2026年の再発生と国家的対応の動きから注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: डीआरसी के इतुरी में इबोला का प्रकोप, सबसे ज्यादा असर महिलाओं और बच्चों पर संयुक्त राष्ट्र | Ebola takes severe toll on women, children in eastern DR Congo: UN
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Ituri, eastern DR Congo: UN says women and children are most affected.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, has hit women and children hardest, UN humanitarian workers say. In Ituri, around 1 million people are displaced, roughly 80% of them women and children. UNICEF reports children account for about one-third of deaths and about one-quarter of confirmed cases. Health services in affected areas have fallen by more than 40% as fear of infection keeps people away. UNFPA notes many pregnant women are not receiving care, with obstetric deaths nearly doubling since the outbreak began; weekly maternal deaths average six, and Ebola during pregnancy almost always results in fetal death. OCHA and partners deployed 13,000 community workers, reaching over 2.4 million people and visiting more than 500,000 households to counter misinformation and encourage care-seeking. No confirmed cases in neighboring South Sudan yet, but cross-border risk persists; preparedness includes screening, training, and supplies, with 135,300 travelers screened this month.

triage.headline_ja: DRC東部イトゥリ州でエボラ流行、女性と子どもに深刻な影響:国連
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的な流行により重大な公衆衛生影響（高い死亡率、周産期死亡の増加）が生じており、国際的越境リスク（南スーダンへの拡大懸念）も指摘されているためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 南スーダンでは確認例なしだが越境リスクにより国境スクリーニングが実施されている。南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 關日華稱本港受「三疫夾擊」　強調感仍未見頂籲勿輕心 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kwan Yat-wah says Hong Kong is under a 'triple-epidemic' onslaught, stressing that the infection wave has not yet peaked and urging the public not to let their guard down.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong reports its first pediatric influenza death of the year: a seven-year-old boy who had received seasonal flu vaccination died after an influenza A infection, with complications including shock and encephalopathy. Dr. Kwan Yat-wah, president of the Asia Society of Pediatric Infectious Diseases and honorary clinical associate professor at HKU, warns that Hong Kong is facing a 'triple-epidemic' of COVID-19, influenza, and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). The case highlights that influenza can cause rapid, severe complications in some individuals, even after vaccination, as antibody levels may wane over time and immune responses vary. He calls for assessing potential congenital susceptibilities and whether the circulating influenza strain has major mutations. Flu activity has not peaked yet; the public should continue basic protections such as masking and hand hygiene, and stay vigilant during travel to prevent spread.

triage.headline_ja: 關日華氏、香港は「三重流行」の直撃を受けていると発言　感染はまだピークを迎えていないとして警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 香港で季節性インフルエンザによる小児死亡例が報告され、COVID-19・インフルエンザ・RSVの「三重流行」が懸念されているが、季節性の流行パターンであり新規性・国際的拡大リスクは低いため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 香港（記事はHong Kong SARに関するもの）はChinaとして分類。季節性のインフルエンザ・RSV・COVID-19同時流行であり、毎年冬季に見られる典型的なパターン。小児死亡例は重症度の観点で注目されるが、新規変異株の証拠や国際的拡大の兆候は記事内で確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية توصي باختبار لقاح "إرفيبو" ضد فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO recommends testing the Ervebo Ebola vaccine against the Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 8 August 2026, the World Health Organization's Technical Advisory Group on Immunization recommends prioritizing the Ervebo Ebola vaccine—the only licensed vaccine against Ebola—for inclusion in a randomized clinical trial to support outbreak response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Early animal studies suggest cross-protection, but human efficacy against Ebola virus remains unproven. Vaccinating contacts of cases with Ervebo does not raise safety concerns. Developing a vaccine specifically targeted to the virus remains the long-term preferred option. The WHO also warned of accelerating transmission in the DRC, with the outbreak's pace outstripping current response efforts and the death toll surpassing 1,800.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱に対しエルベボワクチンの試験投与を推奨
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の感染拡大が対応能力を上回るペースで進行し、死者数が1,800人を超えるなど深刻な公衆衛生上の影響が確認されており、WHOがワクチン臨床試験を推奨するなど国際的な関与も生じているため。
triage.notes: 死者数1,800人超、感染拡大が対応を上回るペースとの警告あり。WHOはワクチン臨床試験（Ervebo）の優先実施を推奨。国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限については記事内に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: Thailand's HIV cases pass 550,000, Laos reports rising infections among young people
article.articleSummary: Thailand reports 557,993 cumulative HIV cases, with new infections down about 12,000 over the past three years. Thirteen of 77 provinces have more than 10,000 cases, led by Bangkok (88,535), Chonburi (31,072), Chiang Mai, and Chiang Rai (17,524). Youth aged 15-24 are the most affected, accounting for more than 25,000 cumulative infections. Treatment outcomes are strong: about 83% of patients are on antiretroviral therapy and 76% have viral suppression, with virtually all known cases diagnosed and registered. The World Health Organization notes no cure, but daily ART keeps patients healthy and reduces transmission. Across the Mekong region, Laos has not published full 2026 figures yet; in Oudomxay in July, 12 positives were found among 264 sex workers, suggesting under-detection due to limited testing. Laos recorded 1,617 new infections in 2025 through September; about 29% of cases were aged 15-29, with roughly 21,000 people living with HIV.

triage.headline_ja: タイのHIV感染者数が55万人を超える、ラオスでは若者の感染増加
triage.triage_reason: 既知の慢性的流行病であるHIVに関する定例統計報告であり、急性の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ラオスの状況も言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。既存の慢性感染症統計であり治療体制も機能しているため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: अब तक 1352 कन्फर्म मामले, 58 मौत, क्या है लेप्टोस्पायरोसिस जिसने केरल में फैला दी दहशत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: So far 1,352 confirmed cases, 58 deaths: what is leptospirosis, which has spread panic in Kerala.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis (rat fever) in Kerala, India, remains a significant public health concern during the monsoon. As of July 29, 2026, Kerala reports 1,352 confirmed cases and 58 deaths. In 2025, 390 deaths occurred, with 47 among manual laborers (37%), 14 among agricultural workers (11%), and 13 among domestic workers (10%). Adults aged 40–69 are most affected. From 2016–2020 there were 319 deaths; 2021–2025 saw 1,455 deaths, with cases more than tripling and mortality rising from 4.2% to 6%. Flooding and contaminated water/soil during heavy rains increase exposure. Transmission follows contact with urine-contaminated water/soil through broken skin, mucous membranes, or eyes. Prevention emphasizes avoiding contact, protective gear, wound care, rodent control, and prompt medical care; doxycycline is advised for high-risk groups under clinician guidance, not self-medication. Guidelines are being updated to better protect workers and reduce delays in treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 確認症例1,352件、死者58人：ケララ州でパニックを引き起こしたレプトスピラ症とは何か
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州で毎年発生する風土病だが、症例・死亡数が増加傾向にあり社会的関心も高まっているため、フルRRAでの経過確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症はケララ州でモンスーン期に毎年発生する風土病であり、動物・水系媒介でヒト-ヒト感染はない。2021-2025年で死亡数・致死率が上昇傾向にあり、労働者層への影響が大きい点が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Surguja Malaria News: छत्तीसगढ़ के इस इलाके में खतरनाक बीमारी की दस्तक! अचानक एक के बाद एक बिगड़ी 34 लोगों की तबीयत, स्वास्थ्य विभाग में मचा हड़कंप
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Surguja Malaria News: A dangerous disease strikes this part of Chhattisgarh! Suddenly, 34 people fell ill one after another, causing a stir in the health department.
article.articleSummary: As of August 8, 2026, Surguja district in Chhattisgarh reported a malaria cluster with 34 people infected in the Mataringa area in Udipur. Health authorities mounted a rapid response with a health camp and door-to-door screenings to identify additional cases. Patients with severe symptoms were admitted to a medical college hospital for specialized care. In response, officials intensified case finding and community outreach, while sanitation teams cleaned water-logging sites and improved drainage; villagers were provided with mosquito nets to reduce exposure. Ongoing surveillance remains in place to monitor new infections and prevent further transmission. Authorities will continue monitoring the outbreak trajectory and adjust control measures as needed.

triage.headline_ja: Surgujaマラリアニュース：チャッティースガル州のこの地域で危険な病気が発生！突然34人が次々と体調不良に、保健部門が騒然
triage.triage_reason: インド・チャッティースガル州の一地域でマラリア患者34人のクラスターが発生し、重症者は入院しているが、マラリアは同国の風土病であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にNepalが含まれているが、記事本文はチャッティースガル州Surguja地区のUdipur（Mataringa地区）でのローカルなマラリアクラスターについてのみ言及しており、ネパールは主題ではないため除外した。地元保健当局が対応中で外部支援の必要性は現時点で示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Fever Is Gone, But Joint Pain Stays? Doctor Warns of Delayed Chikungunya Diagnosis
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya diagnosis is delayed due to early symptoms that mimic dengue fever and influenza, says Dr. Conrad Rui Vas, Senior Consultant Physician at S.L. Raheja Hospital. The article emphasizes that diagnosing chikungunya early is challenging because initial manifestations overlap with other viral infections, leading patients to delay seeking care or self-medicate. As a result, they may endure prolonged joint pain that affects daily life even after fever subsides. The piece highlights the pattern of late presentation and the need for clinical vigilance when persistent arthralgia occurs, rather than relying on fever alone. There are no case counts or outbreak figures provided; the discussion focuses on diagnostic difficulty, patient behavior, and implications for timely management of chikungunya within the hospital setting as of 2026-08-08.

triage.headline_ja: 熱は治まったが関節痛が続く？ 医師がチクングニア熱の診断遅延に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: 症例数やアウトブレイク情報はなく、医師による診断啓発的な一般記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性を示す情報がないため。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の集団発生や症例数を報告しておらず、診断遅延に関する一般的な医療解説記事。インドでの具体的な流行状況の言及もないためverified_locationsは空とした。

Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: स्वाइन फ्लू और वायरल फीवर में क्या होता है अंतर? मानसून के बीच बढ़ रहा H1N1 का खतरा, हल्के में न लें ऐसे लक्षण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is the difference between swine flu and viral fever? The H1N1 risk is rising during the monsoon season; don’t take such symptoms lightly.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) risk rises in Delhi-NCR during the monsoon. Transmission increases due to humidity, indoor crowding, and close contact, via cough droplets and contaminated surfaces. The piece recalls India’s notable outbreaks: the 2009 global pandemic and a severe 2015 phase with over 33,000 infections and about 2,900–3,000 deaths, with Rajasthan, Gujarat, Delhi, and Madhya Pradesh most affected. While symptoms resemble a common viral fever, major signs include high fever with chills, persistent cough and sore throat, nasal congestion, headache, body aches, and marked fatigue; children may also have vomiting or diarrhea. Seek urgent evaluation for breathing difficulties, chest pain, or profound weakness. Preventive measures include hand hygiene, masking, covering coughs, limiting close contact with the ill, adequate fluids, and sleep. High-risk groups: children under 5, adults over 65, pregnant women, and those with diabetes, heart disease, asthma, COPD, or kidney disease.

triage.headline_ja: スワインフルーとウイルス性発熱の違いとは？モンスーン期にH1N1のリスクが上昇、症状を軽視しないよう注意
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデリーNCRにおける季節性H1N1（スワインフルー）に関する一般的な健康啓発・予防情報記事であり、現在進行中の具体的なアウトブレイクのデータ（症例数・死亡者数など）は示されていない。過去（2009年、2015年）の事例を回顧する内容が中心。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）に関する予防啓発コンテンツであり、現在の具体的な感染者数や新規アウトブレイクの発生を報告するものではない。モンスーン期における一般的なリスク上昇と予防法の紹介が主旨。

article.articleHeadline: Μία ημέρα με τον Δρ. Alex, επιζώντα Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Day with Dr. Alex, Ebola survivor.
article.articleSummary: Dr. Alex Bonane Murutsi, an Ebola survivor turned frontline physician with Doctors Without Borders (MSF), was treated for Ebola for 18 days at the Ebola Treatment Center Elykia in Bunia, Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, and has returned to work there. The DRC outbreak records 3,262 confirmed cases and more than 1,400 deaths. MSF-supported efforts include Ebola treatment centers and isolation units across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, plus a renovated Ebola Treatment Center near Kampala and an isolation unit near the DRC border in southwestern Uganda. The response emphasizes surveillance, rapid diagnosis and treatment, survivor care, safe burials, medical supplies, trainings, and strengthening primary health care for both Ebola and non-Ebola patients. The center Elykia means “hope.”

triage.headline_ja: エボラ生存者アレックス医師との一日
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認例3,262例・死亡者1,400人超の大規模エボラ流行が継続中であり、隣国ウガンダにも越境した対応拠点が設置されるなど国際的拡大の懸念があるため、フルRRAでの継続評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ生存者の人間的ストーリーが主題だが、DRCでの大規模な継続中エボラ流行（3,262例、1,400人超死亡）と国境を越えたウガンダでの対応体制について言及されており、既存の大規模アウトブレイクの状況確認として有用。新規発生ではなく既知の進行中流行の続報。

article.articleHeadline: Число подтверждённых случаев лихорадки Эбола в Демократической Республике Конго превысило 4000 -- НИАТ "Ховар"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola fever cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has exceeded 4,000 — NIA "Khovar".
article.articleSummary: Ebola fever in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 4,053 confirmed cases with 1,850 deaths. As of August 8, 2026, 694 patients remain in isolation or hospitalized, and 793 have recovered. The outbreak is centered in eastern DR Congo and is described by Doctors Without Borders as more serious than ever, spreading at alarming and unprecedented speeds with no signs of slowing. The report does not detail laboratory confirmation methods, infection sources, or information on imported or exported cases. These numbers indicate a severe, ongoing Ebola outbreak with substantial active caseload and high mortality, underscoring the need for continued international humanitarian response and strengthened public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱確認症例数が4000人を超える -- NIAT「Khovar」
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認症例が4,053例、死亡1,850例に達し、国境なき医師団が「前例のない速さで拡大」と警告する深刻な進行中のアウトブレイクであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率が約45.6%と高く、国境なき医師団により深刻度が強調されている。国際的な人道支援の継続的必要性が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: PODCAST: Chasing Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo, centered around Bunia, is the focus of Reuters On Assignment's latest episode. The podcast follows a local Ebola surveillance officer as he canvasses for missed cases, probes deaths, and negotiates the practical hurdles of outbreak response. It highlights how limited resources, public mistrust, and misinformation can impede containment while underscoring the dedication of health workers striving to stay ahead of transmission. The report illustrates real-world surveillance, case-finding, and the skeletal lab and field operations involved in Ebola management in a resource-constrained setting. Related reading notes that Congo's outbreak has surpassed 4,000 cases, and offers explainer context on why transmission dynamics differ from prior epidemics. The piece emphasizes ongoing containment challenges and the human factors shaping response in Bunia and broader eastern Congo.

triage.headline_ja: ポッドキャスト：エボラを追う
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部（ブニア中心）でエボラ出血熱の流行が4,000症例を超えており、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクを有する継続中のアウトブレイクであるため。
triage.notes: 記事はロイターのポッドキャストで、コンゴ民主共和国東部ブニア周辺のエボラ流行（累計4,000症例超）の現地対応・サーベイランスの困難さを取材した内容。既存の大規模流行の継続報道であり、新規発生ではないが公衆衛生上の重大性からPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Avika Gor hospitalised due to dengue, husband Milind Chandwani says she worked with 104 fever: 'Unable to move or eat'
article.articleSummary: Avika Gor is hospitalised with dengue in Mumbai after returning from a Delhi ad shoot, despite an illness that left her unable to stand or eat. Milind Chandwani says she had fever and travelled to Delhi with the same fever to shoot, dismissing postponement. On return, dengue was confirmed in a test. A team member who travelled with her said she wasn't able to stand properly but still attended the shoot; she survived on oral rehydration solution (ORS). Industry friends and fans praised her dedication to work. Chandwani asked fans to keep her in prayers. The article notes she went on with the schedule while unwell, and there are no further details on laboratory timing or infection source beyond the dengue diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: アヴィカ・ゴールがデング熱で入院、夫ミリンド・チャンドワニ氏「104度の熱でも仕事をしていた」
triage.triage_reason: 個人（芸能人）の単発デング熱感染事例であり、公衆衛生上の異常性や拡大リスクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 芸能ニュースであり、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての意義は低い。デング熱自体はインドで流行性の疾患だが、本記事は個人の症例報告に過ぎない。

article.articleHeadline: വീണ്ടും ചിക്കുൻ​ഗുനിയ വ്യാപനം, പ്രതിരോധവും ലക്ഷണങ്ങളും
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya spreads again: prevention and symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya is spreading again in Kerala, India, with 105 laboratory-confirmed cases reported as of August 8, 2026. Most patients are from Thiruvananthapuram. Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes drive transmission, and these vectors are also responsible for dengue and Zika viruses. Because these species bite during the day, heightened precautions are recommended in morning and evening hours to curb exposure. The update underscores ongoing transmission within the state and highlights the role of Aedes mosquitoes in sustaining the chikungunya outbreak, emphasizing vector-control measures and personal protection to limit further spread. The report emphasizes the health risk posed by day-biting Aedes species and urges vigilance in affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱が再び流行:予防法と症状について
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州で確認例105件と季節性のチクングニア熱流行が継続しているが、重症度や国際的拡大の情報はなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: インド・ケララ州で例年発生するチクングニア熱の季節的流行と考えられ、デング熱・ジカ熱を媒介する同一種の蚊（ネッタイシマカ・ヒトスジシマカ）による感染リスクも指摘されている。続報で症例数の推移や重症例の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, oltre 4mila casi in Congo: i morti sono 1.800
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: over 4,000 cases in Congo; 1,800 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) has reached 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths as of 5 August, with 694 patients in isolation or hospital. Recoveries total 793, nearing 800. The outbreak spans five provinces, with Ituri as the epicenter (86.9% of cases) and four others—Haut-Uélé, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, and Tshopo. Two new health zones are affected: Gombari (Haut-Uélé) and Bafwasende (Tshopo), bringing the total affected health zones to 53 of 140. Contact tracing stands at 77.7%. Surveillance remains active, with 1,158 reports examined in 24 hours and strengthened response capacity in the affected provinces. Figures are from the Congolese Ministry of Communications via X, with the situation described as ongoing and subject to updates."

triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例4,053人、死者1,850人に達する大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが5州に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States tightens travel restrictions for those returning from Ebola-affected areas.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-08, the United States tightened travel restrictions for certain travelers returning from Ebola-affected areas—Uganda, South Sudan, and the Democratic Republic of Congo. Per U.S. CDC guidelines, American citizens and nationals who visited Uganda or South Sudan within the 21 days prior to arrival in the United States must route through designated U.S. airports and undergo public health screening on entry. The guidance also notes that the rule applies to travelers who transited through Uganda or South Sudan during their journey. The measures are intended to reduce the risk of importing Ebola and form part of American public health protocols for travelers from outbreak regions. No broad travel ban is described; the emphasis is on screening and airport routing to mitigate transmission risk.

triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国の渡航制限措置だが、背景にDRC・ウガンダ・南スーダンでのエボラ流行がある。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ・南スーダン・米国は対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: PIT XXI Perhimpunan Dokter Spesialis Dermatologi, Venereologi, dan Estetika Digelar di Yogyakarta, Kondisi Penyebaran HIV/AIDS di Indonesia Turut Disoroti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The 21st PIT Congress of the Association of Dermatology, Venereology, and Aesthetics Specialists Held in Yogyakarta, the HIV/AIDS Transmission Status in Indonesia Also Under Scrutiny
article.articleSummary: The 21st PIT Congress of Indonesia’s Perhimpunan Dokter Spesialis Dermatologi, Venereologi, dan Estetika (Perdoski) was held at Marriott Yogyakarta, Indonesia, from August 6–9, 2026, with pre-congress online activities July 26–August 2, 2026. Theme: Bridging the Gaps: From Innovation and Research to Application and Practice in Dermatology, Venereology, and Aesthetics, stressing rapid translation of research into clinical care. Program covered inflammatory skin diseases, sexually transmitted infections, tropical dermatology, dermatopathology, and cosmetic dermatology and aesthetics. HIV/AIDS in Indonesia was highlighted as an ongoing challenge, with rising numbers noted by Perdoski’s leadership; despite antiretroviral therapy, viral suppression can still lead to immunodeficiency and more severe infections. The event gathered clinicians, researchers, and health workers, emphasizing knowledge exchange and practical application across dermatology and related fields.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Delhi's Rising H1N1 Crisis: Two Sisters Die in Three Days; Learn Which Symptoms Should Not Be Ignored — Symptoms, Risks and Precautions.
article.articleSummary: Two sisters die within three days in Delhi amid rising H1N1 cases. The younger sister, 3 years 11 months, was brought August 3 with confirmed H1N1 infection; MRI showed acute necrotizing encephalopathy, a rare post-influenza brain complication. The older sister died earlier with fever and cold symptoms; H1N1 status not officially confirmed. Delhi reports 1,349 H1N1 cases this year; last year had a surge with 3,151 cases in 2024. Safdarjung Hospital logged 11 H1N1 patients in July; PSRI Hospital notes a near fourfold rise, with several ICU admissions for severe lung infection. Common symptoms include high fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, headache, body pain, fatigue; vomiting/diarrhea may occur. High-risk groups: young children, elderly, pregnant women, and those with diabetes, heart, or lung disease. Prevention emphasizes hand hygiene, masks, cough etiquette, and prompt medical advice.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでH1N1感染拡大、姉妹2人が3日間で死亡 ― 症状・リスクと予防法
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1症例が急増（前年比ほぼ4倍）し、小児の死亡や急性壊死性脳症などの重症合併症、ICU収容例が報告されており、WPRO基準の複数該当と報道による社会的関心の高まりが見られるため。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして毎年流行するため国際的な異常事態には該当しないが、症例急増と重症化（脳症合併症・死亡例）が地域レベルで懸念されるため注視が必要。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sumatra Island rogue monkey captured after two weeks of attacking 18 people.
article.articleSummary: As of Aug 8, 2026, an adult long-tailed macaque was captured in Tanjung Balai, eastern Sumatra, ending a two-week attack spree that wounded 18 residents. The incidents totaled 19 attacks, with one victim struck twice; most targets were solitary, including children and the elderly. Injuries included deep lacerations, with some victims receiving more than 10 stitches and vaccination against rabies. The macaque was trapped on Aug 6, and footage from the Tanjung Balai Fire and Rescue Service shows it confined in a cage. Ismail, head of the service, confirmed the figures. Local officials warned residents to stay vigilant, fearing the animal may operate with others, suggesting additional macaques could be involved. The case underscores the broader pattern of human–wildlife conflict in Indonesia, where deforestation shrinks habitats for primates, elephants, and tigers.

article.articleHeadline: Avika Gor Hospitalised With Dengue, Worked Despite 104 Fever: Husband Milind Chandwani Shares Health Update
article.articleSummary: Dengue hospitalization of Indian TV actor Avika Gor in Mumbai, India. As of 8 August 2026, she was diagnosed with dengue after five days of high fever (103–104°F) and hospitalised. She had continued working, completing a pending shoot in a single day, then travelled to Delhi for an ad shoot before the dengue diagnosis was confirmed upon returning to Mumbai. A team member said she could barely stand, ate little, and largely survived on ORS. Husband Milind Chandwani shared health updates and requested prayers for her recovery. The report provides no outbreak counts or broader infection data; focus remains on Gor’s illness, her determination to fulfill work commitments, and support from colleagues and fans.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola takes severe toll on women, children in eastern DRC: UN
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, continues with a disproportionate toll on women and children. Nearly 1 million people are displaced in Ituri, about 80% of them women and children. UNICEF reports children account for almost one third of deaths and about a quarter of confirmed cases. Health service use in hardest-hit areas has fallen by more than 40% in recent months due to fear of infection. Maternal deaths in Ituri have nearly doubled since the outbreak began, averaging around six childbirth-related deaths per week, while Ebola infection during pregnancy is linked to almost universal fetal loss. UN agencies stress restoring community confidence; 13,000 community workers and partners have reached more than 2.4 million people with prevention and early-detection messages and conducted over 500,000 household visits to counter misinformation and encourage care-seeking.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola kills 300 children in DR Congo, says UN
article.articleSummary: As of 8 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province, caused by Bundibugyo virus, has killed more than 300 children since mid-May. UNICEF says children make up about 25% of confirmed cases and nearly a third of deaths, with women and children bearing a disproportionate burden in a province where almost one million people are displaced. Health services are severely disrupted, with use down over 40% in hardest-hit areas, hindering care for pregnant women and contributing to rising maternal mortalities; Ebola infection during pregnancy is linked to fetal loss. About 13,000 community workers have reached over 2.4 million people with prevention and early-detection messaging and conducted more than 500,000 household visits. WHO recommends evaluating Ervebo, a licensed Ebola Zaire vaccine, in a randomized trial for Bundibugyo virus disease, while noting the need for a Bundibugyo-specific vaccine and addressing safety in trial settings.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, over 4,000 cases in Congo: the death toll is 1,800
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus continues, with 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths as of August 5, 2026, per the Ministry of Communications. About 694 patients are in isolation or hospitalized. The five affected provinces are Haut-Uélé, Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, and Tshopo, with 53 health zones affected (out of 140); Gombari in Haut-Uélé and Bafwasende in Tshopo are newly reported. Ituri remains the epicenter, representing 86.9% of total cases. Nearly 800 people have recovered (793). Contact tracing stands at 77.7%. Health authorities report 1,158 signals examined in 24 hours and say surveillance and case management are being strengthened across the affected provinces to control transmission.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't ignore these H1N1 symptoms, thinking they're just a viral fever—consult a doctor immediately.
article.articleSummary: August 8, 2026 — H1N1 influenza (swine flu) can present with fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, headache, and body aches during the monsoon, often mimicking a common viral fever. Some children may have vomiting or diarrhea; symptoms onset can be abrupt and vary in severity. Distinguishing H1N1 from other viral infections is difficult from symptoms alone, and doctors may order tests to confirm. Seek medical care urgently if breathing becomes difficult, chest pain, marked weakness, or if symptoms worsen, especially in high-risk individuals. High-risk groups include children under 5, adults over 65, pregnant women, and people with diabetes, heart disease, asthma, COPD, kidney disease, or weakened immunity. Preventive measures include regular handwashing, covering the mouth and nose when coughing or sneezing, avoiding close contact with the sick, and wearing masks in crowded spaces. Do not ignore persistent symptoms; timely medical evaluation can reduce complications.

article.articleHeadline: Delhi Rains Trigger 20% Surge in Waterborne Illnesses; AIIMS Experts Issue Advisory
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-08, Delhi records a 20% rise in waterborne illness cases linked to heavy monsoon rains. In New Delhi, gastroenteritis dominates hospital OPDs, presenting with severe diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and high fever. Contaminated water and food—exacerbated by untreated sewerage inflow into pipelines and exposure to open-food—is driving the surge. In June, Gulmohar Park reported cases of typhoid, diarrhea, norovirus, and other waterborne infections tied to contaminated water; viral hepatitis cases are also noted. AIIMS experts issued advisory; doctors including those at RML Hospital warn that dehydration and electrolyte loss from diarrhoea or vomiting are major risks. Management emphasizes oral rehydration solution (ORS); antibiotics or anti-diarrheal medicines should not be used without medical guidance. Seek urgent care for persistent vomiting, reduced urination, high fever, blood in stool, or signs of dehydration in children.

article.articleHeadline: 킴 카다시안, 비키니 입고 호수서 패들보트..."코로 침입하는 '이 생물' 주의해야?"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kim Kardashian, bikini-clad on a lake paddle boat... "This creature" that invades through the nose—watch out?
article.articleSummary: Naegleria fowleri (brain-eating amoeba) poses a fatal risk in warm freshwater lakes, rivers, and ponds, especially during summer, when water exposure occurs via the nose rather than ingestion. In the United States, primary amoebic meningoencephalitis (PAM) cases are typically under 10 per year and are almost always fatal. Korea reported its first domestically confirmed death from N. fowleri in December 2022—a 50-year-old man who had spent about four months in Thailand before returning. A 2017 Korean study detected N. fowleri in 6 of 52 raw-water samples (11.5%), indicating domestic presence. Prevention includes keeping the nose closed (nose clips) or pinching the nose while diving, avoiding stirring lake sediments, and staying out of warm water when the nose would be exposed. Shoreline risk also includes ticks and snakes; wear long clothing, use repellents, perform thorough checks after outdoor activity, and seek prompt care if bitten. Sun exposure and heat illness (heat exhaustion/heat stroke) are additional concerns; reapply broad-spectrum SPF 30+ sunscreen every 2 hours.

article.articleSummary: Dengue fever concerns rise in Ernakulam district, Kerala, with over 200 dengue patients treated in two weeks and more than 10,000 fever cases reported. Nine fever-related deaths have occurred, five of them in patients with elephantiasis. Dengue is most reported within Kochi Corporation areas—Churnikkar, Edappally, Eloor, Fort Kochi, Kakkanad, Kadavattam, Mattancherry, Kaloor, Palluruthy—while peripheral local bodies (Kalamasheri, Thrikkakkara, Aluva, Udayamperoor, Nedumbassery, Koothattukulam) also show cases. Vector-control measures, including larviciding, source reduction, chlorine treatment of drinking water, ASHA volunteers, and cleaning of markets and streets, are being intensified under the Health department’s ‘Arogya Bhery’ plan; 90% of local bodies have adopted it. No cause for alarm per DMO Dr. R. Shahheesha; overall dengue incidence is down this year, though Kochi Corporation shows a slight rise. In 15 days: 1,804 jaundice, 7 malaria, 464 influenza; two deaths linked to H1N1; one death each from West Nile and Influenza; one pneumonia death post-fever.

triage.headline_ja: エルナクラム県でデング熱の拡大が懸念を高める
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州エルナクラム県における季節性デング熱等の流行報告だが、当局は『懸念なし』としており地域限定の通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内。ただし複数疾患による死亡例があり経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 地元当局(DMO)は『懸念なし』とコメントし、全体のデング熱発生数は前年より減少と説明。ただし局地的にコーチン市地区で若干増加、9名の熱関連死亡（うち5名は象皮病患者）、H1N1関連死2名、West Nileおよびインフルエンザ死亡各1名が報告されており、複数病原体の混在流行として注視が必要。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Un trabajador sanitario combate el ébola en el Congo sin cobrar desde mayo y aun así camina 13 kilómetros para llegar al hospital cuando se queda sin dinero para gasolina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A healthcare worker fights Ebola in Congo without pay since May, and still walks 13 kilometers to reach the hospital when he runs out of money for gasoline.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, persists since May, with frontline health workers unpaid. Wiza Bondele, 29, travels daily to a Bunia hospital to disinfect contaminated areas, screen visitors, and enforce hygiene protocols as part of the response, despite months without promised wages. The government had touted a $510 monthly salary, but payments have been delayed or only partially delivered. Some workers registered mobile numbers and signed attendance sheets, yet many did not receive funds. Officials attribute delays to logistics and inflated payroll lists; a mobile-money transfer system is being introduced to replace cash payments. The payroll delays have spurred strikes by hundreds of responders, risking the outbreak response, including case finding, patient care, sanitation, and safe burials. Bondele continued working even after walking 13 kilometers home when his motorcycle ran out of gasoline.

article.articleSummary: Hyderabad faces ongoing risk of dengue and other mosquito-borne diseases, with BC Welfare Minister Ponnam Prabhakar launching a Special Monsoon Drive from August 11 to 21. An Information, Education and Communication (IEC) program on vector prevention was unveiled at the Minister’s Quarters, with entomology officials outlining awareness activities. The GHMC will conduct door-to-door campaigns to promote environmental cleanliness and reduce breeding sites. Prabhakar urged residents to maintain clean surroundings and to remove stagnant water around homes every Friday as part of the 'Friday-Dryday' initiative, reinforcing that preventive measures are preferable to treatment. He stressed government efforts to prevent dengue and asked for public cooperation to ensure water does not stagnate. The program underscores community partnership in mosquito prevention to safeguard Hyderabad’s health.

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Wabah Salmonella Ahli Ungkap Telur hingga Cabai Jalapeno Jadi Sumber
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Salmonella Outbreak Alert: Experts Reveal Eggs and Even Jalapeño Peppers as Sources.
article.articleSummary: Salmonella outbreaks are expanding, with epidemiological investigations tracing sources to commercial eggs, jalapeño peppers, and direct contact with poultry. Salmonella causes gastrointestinal illness with fever, abrupt abdominal cramps, nausea, vomiting, and severe diarrhea, beginning 6 hours to 6 days after exposure. Contamination is found not only in animal products like raw eggs and undercooked chicken but also in fresh produce, particularly jalapeño peppers, suspected to be contaminated during harvest, washing, or distribution. Household exposure to poultry can spread Salmonella via feathers, feet, and feces. Vulnerable groups include children under five, older adults, and immunocompromised individuals; severe cases can lead to bacteremia requiring urgent medical care and antibiotics. To reduce household risk, authorities urge thorough cooking of eggs and meat, meticulous washing of fresh produce, separate cutting boards for raw and cooked foods, and handwashing after handling raw foods or animals.

article.articleHeadline: Virus Ebola in Congo in crescita, appello Oms sull'epidemia: "Avanza più rapidamente della risposta sanitaria"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo on the rise, WHO appeal on the epidemic: "It is advancing faster than the health response."
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is escalating in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as the Bundibugyo strain spreads. As of August 4, 2026, the WHO records 3,973 confirmed cases across five provinces, 1,801 deaths, and 776 recoveries. Ituri province accounts for about 87% of cases; Uganda reports 20 infections and two deaths, signaling cross-border risk. Contact tracing is about 75%, far below the ~95% target to stop transmission. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, Africa CDC head Mohamed Janabi, and Africa CDC leadership Jean Kaseya urged governments and partners to bolster surveillance, isolation, and care capacity. The rapid spread is outpacing health response, underscoring the need for intensified clinical management and community containment in eastern DRC.

article.articleHeadline: 不要輕視流感！香港傳染病專家示警當前「三疫夾擊」 | 港澳話題 | 兩岸 | 經濟日報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't underestimate influenza! Hong Kong infectious disease expert warns of the current "triple-epidemic" onslaught | Hong Kong and Macao Topics | Cross-Strait | Economic Daily
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong is experiencing a 'triple-epidemic' of COVID-19, influenza, and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), with influenza the dominant threat. A seven-year-old boy contracted influenza A and died on August 4 from shock and encephalopathy, despite receiving a seasonal flu vaccine; this is HK's first pediatric influenza death this year. Dr. Guan Rihua, president of the Asian Society for Pediatric Infectious Diseases and honorary clinical professor at the University of Hong Kong, warns against underestimating influenza and notes that individual immune responses can deteriorate rapidly. He urges evaluation of any congenital issues and monitoring mutations in circulating flu strains. RSV can cause bronchiolitis and pneumonia; some children with COVID-19 have developed croup. There is no pediatric COVID vaccination program yet, though adults can reduce household risk via vaccination. Summer flu activity persists; transmission may continue into new school year. Basic protections—masking and hand hygiene—are advised, especially during group activities and travel.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザを甘く見るな！香港の感染症専門家が現在の「トリプル流行」襲来を警告

triage.notes: 香港（Hong Kong Special Administrative Region）は中国（China, 1814991）としてまとめて計上。季節性呼吸器感染症の複合流行であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは現時点では低いが、小児死亡例と変異株監視の呼びかけがあり続報監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Nội bước vào cao điểm sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanoi Enters the Peak Dengue Season
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Hanoi is entering peak season, with 1,259 cases across 115 of 126 communes as of 8 August 2026, and thousands of outdoor water containers harboring larvae. Hot, humid monsoon conditions favor Aedes breeding. Hanoi’s Health Department deployed 46 inspection teams to 91 communes to strengthen surveillance, outbreak response, vector control, and public communication, though many households still fail to clean containers, leaving larval habitats. In southern Vietnam, Ho Chi Minh City recorded 1,130 dengue cases in week 31 (27 Jul–2 Aug), up 20% from four-week average; cumulative 24,651 this year. The southern region totals 53,428 cases, +38.9% YoY. Ha Tinh reports a Tan Duc, Ky Hoa outbreak with 5 NS1-positive cases; Đồng Nai and Tây Ninh are also affected. Authorities emphasize vector control, environmental sanitation, larviciding, planned spraying, and vaccination; national dengue in 2025 exceeded 181,000 cases with 43 deaths; early 2026 near 60,000, nearly triple year prior.
