article.articleHeadline: Brasil reforça vacinação contra o sarampo após novos casos em São Paulo - 24 Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil strengthens measles vaccination after new measles cases in São Paulo - 24 News
article.articleSummary: Measles cases prompt strengthened vaccination in Brazil after import-linked transmission in São Paulo. A transmission chain associated with virus importation was confirmed, triggering enhanced prevention in three municipalities: São Paulo city, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo. By end-July, 17 measles cases were confirmed nationwide, with 14 active in São Paulo state; 11 in the capital, two in São Bernardo do Campo, and one in Guarulhos. Investigations point to transmission in a highly mobile region with extensive international travel, raising risk of reintroduction. The Health Ministry temporarily expands measles vaccination to all residents aged 6 months to 59 years in the three municipalities as part of the August 2026 Multivaccination Campaign, from Aug 3 to Sep 1, 2026. A dose zero of the trivalent measles-mumps-rubella vaccine is given to 6–11 month-olds, not replacing routine doses (12 and 15 months). SUS vaccines are free.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、サンパウロで麻疹新規症例発生後にワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: 輸入例に関連した麻疹の伝播が確認され、麻疹排除国であるブラジルでの再興は異常事態であり、国際移動の多い地域での再導入リスクも指摘されているためIHR基準を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: ブラジルは過去に麻疹排除認定を受けており、輸入例による伝播チェーンの発生は公衆衛生上重要な意味を持つ。ワクチン接種キャンペーンにより自国内で管理対応が進められている点は考慮すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Hasil Uji Lab MBG Bandengan 05 Temukan Salmonella, 110 Siswa dan 13 Guru Positif Keracunan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MBG Bandengan 05 Lab Test Results Detect Salmonella; 110 Students and 13 Teachers Poisoned
article.articleSummary: Salmonella sp outbreak linked to MBG meals at SMPN 2 Jepara, Jepara Regency, Indonesia. About 110 students and 13 teachers who ate MBG on August 3, 2026 reported diarrhoea, nausea, and vomiting; four students needed emergency department care at RS PKU Aisyiyah Jepara. LabKes Jepara, testing bank samples from SPPG Bandengan 05 (managed by Yayasan Cahaya Arjuna Bangsa) collected August 4–7, 2026, found Salmonella sp and Enterobacteriaceae in beef teriyaki; other foods (white rice, fried tempeh, labu siam, and yellow carrot) were free of bacteria. Semangka (watermelon) samples contained Bacillus cereus and Enterobacteriaceae; yeast and mold detected in other samples. Washing water from the facility contained coliforms. Health authorities warn of food safety risks and are continuing investigations into the contamination source.

triage.headline_ja: MBGバンデンガン05のラボ検査結果でサルモネラ菌検出、生徒110名・教員13名が食中毒陽性
triage.triage_reason: 特定の学校給食施設で発生した単発のサルモネラ食中毒事例であり、原因食品（牛肉照り焼き）が特定され当局が対応中。重症例は少数で国際的拡大の懸念もない。
triage.notes: インドネシア政府の無料給食プログラム(MBG)関連の食中毒事例。原因食品と汚染源が特定され、現地保健当局による調査・対応が継続中。重症患者は4名のみで死亡例なし。

article.articleHeadline: IIT Guwahati's ₹3,500 'E-Eye' Detects Arsenic, Lead & E. Coli In Water At Just ₹2 Per Test | Video
article.articleSummary: IIT Guwahati's E-Eye is a portable optical sensing device (≈₹3,500; ≈₹2 per test) that on-site detects arsenic, lead, iron, chromium, fluoride, and Escherichia coli in water, with wireless data transmission to water treatment facilities. Aligned with India's Jal Jeevan Mission to provide safe drinking water, it enables field deployment at water sources and environment samples. The device's readings are comparable to standard UV-Visible and Atomic Absorption spectroscopy, validated by lab tests; it uses Beer-Lambert law, producing a colorimetric signal that is converted to digital concentration data. More than 2,700 samples have been tested with accurate results. Beyond water, E-Eye analyzes environmental, biological, vegetables, tea, soil, and milk samples. Supported by MeitY, startup ENVIONIX Labs plans technology transfer; future work includes solar integration and cloud connectivity for remote monitoring. Location: Guwahati, India.

triage.headline_ja: IIT Guwahatiの3,500ルピー『E-Eye』が水中のヒ素・鉛・大腸菌を1回2ルピーで検出（動画あり）
triage.triage_reason: 感染症の発生事例ではなく、水質検査デバイスに関する技術・環境ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や社会的関心の高まりは見られない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症アウトブレイクではなく、水質検出デバイス（E-Eye）の技術紹介記事である。E. coliは検出対象物質の一例として言及されているのみで、実際の感染症発生事例ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Mutirão de limpeza contra dengue chega ao bairro Pio XII em Teresina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cleanup drive to combat dengue arrives in the Pio XII neighborhood in Teresina.
article.articleSummary: On Saturday, August 8, 2026, Teresina's Municipal Health Foundation (FMS) continues its weekly cleanup campaigns to eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding sites in the Pio XII neighborhood, in the southern zone. The effort, conducted with the SDU Sul and ETURB, targets homes where the majority of mosquito foci are found; residents are urged to keep yards clean and place collection materials on the curb at the designated times to support the mutirões and dengue prevention. The Saturday campaigns rotate through districts across the capital, with vector-control teams, veterinarians, and urban-cleaning services. Weekly dates and locations are announced ahead of each action. Infestation indices guide prioritization. Endemias agents and Zoonoses veterinarians perform home visits for environmental inspections, population education, and elimination of potential mosquito breeding sites. Diseases of concern include dengue, Zika, and chikungunya transmitted by Aedes aegypti.

triage.headline_ja: テレジーナのピオ12世地区でデング熱対策の清掃活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: デング熱蚊発生源対策としての通常の定期清掃キャンペーンの報道であり、異常な増加や重症例の報告は見られず、ルーティンの公衆衛生活動である。
triage.notes: 記事は自治体による定期的な清掃・啓発活動の告知であり、感染者数や流行状況に関する具体的データは含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Hành động đáng chú ý của ngành y tế Đồng Tháp khi ổ dịch sốt xuất huyết giảm sâu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Notable Actions by Đồng Tháp's Health Sector as the Dengue Fever Outbreak Declines Sharply.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases in Đồng Tháp Province dropped 47.3% in week 31/2026 versus the four-week average, reflecting aggressive surveillance, elimination of larval habitats, and disruption of community outbreaks. The Dong Thap CDC notes that year-to-date cumulative cases remain above the five-year average at multiple points. With the rainy season bringing heavy rainfall, Aedes aegypti breeding is favored, sustaining outbreak risk where larval habitats persist and environmental sanitation is incomplete. Authorities vow to maintain intensified surveillance, rapid detection of suspected cases to contain clusters, and expanded larval control and environmental hygiene campaigns. Household measures urged: cover water storage containers, wash containers weekly, release larvivorous fish, sleep under nets, and wear long sleeves. Individuals with sudden high fever should seek immediate medical care promptly, not self-medicate.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱アウトブレイクが急減する中でのドンタップ省保健当局の注目すべき対応
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例数は減少傾向にあり、既存の季節性流行への通常の対応措置を報じる内容で、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ベトナム・ドンタップ省における季節性デング熱の通常の監視・対策活動に関する報道であり、症例数はむしろ減少している。

article.articleHeadline: 港三疫夾擊、台流感與COVID-19升 疾管署籲戴口罩
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong hit by a triple epidemic; Taiwan influenza and COVID-19 on the rise; Taiwan CDC urges mask-wearing.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong is experiencing a triple epidemic of COVID-19, influenza, and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). Taiwan reports rising influenza and COVID-19 activity, with the Taiwan CDC urging mask-wearing and hand hygiene, especially in crowded or enclosed spaces. Four-week Taiwan surveillance shows influenza and human metapneumovirus (hMPV) each at about 19.9%, followed by parainfluenza at 15.7% and COVID-19 at 13.2%. COVID-19 has entered an epidemic phase; week 30 (July 26–Aug 1) emergency and outpatient visits totaled 18,990, up 74.8% from 11,863 the prior week. The four pathogens cause similar respiratory symptoms and require laboratory confirmation. Taiwan extends free COVID-19 vaccination through Sept 28 for those aged 6 months and older; high-risk groups (65+, 55+ Indigenous, immunocompromised) may receive a second dose after a 180-day interval.

triage.headline_ja: 港三疫夾撃、台湾のインフルエンザとCOVID-19が上昇、疾病管制署がマスク着用を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 香港での複合流行（COVID-19・インフルエンザ・RSV）と台湾での急増（前週比74.8%増）が報告され、WPRO基準（持続曝露・流行しやすさ）に該当し、当局・メディアの関心も高いためフルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。香港はルールに基づき中国(1814991)として計上。季節性呼吸器感染症の増加であり重症度データは不明だが、複数病原体の同時流行とヒト-ヒト感染継続の可能性から一応の監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 首现儿童流感病殁案例　专家：香港遭受"三疫夹击"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First reported pediatric influenza death case; experts say Hong Kong is under a triple-epidemic attack.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong reports its first pediatric influenza death of the year: a 7-year-old boy died on August 4 after infection with influenza A, leading to shock and encephalopathy. Authorities say Hong Kong is under a “triple-epidemic” of COVID-19, influenza, and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), with influenza currently the most active. The child had received the seasonal flu vaccine, and experts stress this is an isolated case and should not undermine vaccination confidence, noting waning antibody levels over time, potential underlying conditions, and possible antigenic drift. RSV can cause tracheitis and pneumonia, while some pediatric COVID-19 infections have been associated with wheezing. The summer influenza peak has not yet peaked. In response, the Department of Health has purchased about 1.3 million vaccine doses from three manufacturers—Sanofi, Sinovac, and AstraZeneca—across four vaccines and is actively planning vaccination programs.

triage.headline_ja: 小児インフルエンザ死亡例が初めて報告　専門家「香港は三重の流行に見舞われている」
triage.triage_reason: 香港で季節性インフルエンザによる小児死亡例が初めて報告され、COVID-19・インフルエンザ・RSVの「三疫夹击」状態にあると当局が発表。重症例の発生と社会的関心の高まりが見られるため、フルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 香港特別行政区はChina(1814991)として集約。季節性呼吸器感染症の同時流行という文脈であり、通常の季節的パターンの範囲内と考えられるが、小児死亡例と当局の大規模ワクチン調達（130万回分）から社会的関心が高いと判断しPICKUPとした。

article.articleHeadline: गुजरातमध्ये चांदीपुरा विषाणूचा उद्रेक; मुंबईत अद्याप एकही रुग्ण नाही
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chandipura virus outbreak in Gujarat; Mumbai has not yet reported a single case.
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus (CHPV) outbreak is currently in Gujarat; Mumbai reports no CHPV cases yet. CHPV, a Vesiculovirus in the Rhabdoviridae family, causes encephalitis and was first identified in Chandipura village, Nagpur district, Maharashtra, in 1965. This outbreak follows earlier waves in 2003–04 across Maharashtra, Gujarat, Andhra Pradesh and other areas. Transmission is mainly via Phlebotomine sandflies. Symptoms include sudden high fever, vomiting, altered mental status, seizures, ataxia, and neck stiffness; diarrhea may occur. The disease can progress rapidly, with fatalities possible within 48 hours of hospital admission. The most affected are children under 15 in rural settings; there is no specific antiviral or vaccine, so early diagnosis and supportive care are crucial (oxygen, ventilation, fluids/electrolytes, intracranial pressure management). Gujarat is preparing a 10-bed isolation unit at Kasturba Hospital and coordinating with state, central government and NCDC; vector-control measures are being implemented.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州でチャンディプラウイルスの大流行；ムンバイでは今のところ患者報告なし
triage.triage_reason: チャンディプラウイルスによる急性脳炎のアウトブレイクで、小児を中心に致死率が高く48時間以内に死亡例もあるため、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と流行の可能性がありフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 現在の発生はグジャラート州が中心であり、マハーラーシュトラ州・アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州は2003-04年の過去の流行に関する言及。ムンバイでは症例未報告。すべてインド国内の出来事のため verified_locations はIndiaのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai: BMC Labourer Dies After Falling From Water Tank During Dengue Breeding Inspection at BDD Chawl
article.articleSummary: 47-year-old Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) labourer Pandurang Todkar died on Aug 8, 2026, after falling 5–7 feet from a water tank during a dengue-breeding inspection at BDD Chawl No. 6-A in Bhoiwada, Mumbai. Todkar, attached to the PCO Department of the F/South ward, slipped while stepping down; a rod struck his eye and he landed on his back. He was rushed to KEM Hospital where CPR and resuscitation attempts failed and he was declared dead on arrival. The incident occurred during routine dengue-prevention inspections of water storage sites to curb mosquito breeding. The report notes safety concerns for civic workers conducting field inspections, with details of any safety equipment or measures under inquiry. No laboratory confirmation of dengue infection or outbreak counts are provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイ:BMC作業員がBDDチャウルでのデング熱発生源調査中に給水タンクから転落し死亡
triage.triage_reason: 本件はデング熱対策の点検作業中に発生した労災死亡事故であり、感染症の発生・拡大に関する公衆衛生上の情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱そのものの感染拡大情報ではなく、点検作業員の転落死亡事故に関する報道。デング熱の発生状況・症例数等は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: शौक पड़ा भारी! बिल्लियों के हमले से दहशत, एक हफ्ते में 40 लोगों को अस्पताल पहुंचा चुकी हैं पालतू बिल्लियां - up rampur swar pet cat bites surge anti rabies vaccine
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A hobby turned costly! Panic over cat attacks; in a week, pet cats have admitted 40 people to hospital — UP Rampur: pet cat bites surge; anti-rabies vaccine.
article.articleSummary: As of 8 August 2026, in Swara town and surrounding rural areas of Rampur district, Uttar Pradesh, pet cats have surged into a public health problem. Over the past week, about 40 people were treated for cat bites at Swara Community Health Center, with roughly 6–7 people daily needing anti-rabies vaccination. Cat bites have surpassed stray dog bites, which affect about 3–4 people per day (roughly 20 per week). The spike coincides with a rising domestic cat-keeping trend, with children repeatedly playing with cats, sometimes triggering sudden attacks. Victims received anti-rabies vaccination; some victims include owners, children, and neighbors. Health workers advise immediate wound cleaning, prompt medical consultation, regular vaccination of pets, and avoiding home remedies like chili, turmeric, or lime. Authorities are urging vigilance to prevent further cases.

triage.headline_ja: 趣味が高くつく！猫の攻撃にパニック — 1週間で40人が病院搬送、UP州ランプルでペット猫の咬傷が急増、狂犬病ワクチン接種
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の確定症例ではなく、ペット猫の咬傷増加による予防的ワクチン接種の話であり、国際的拡大や重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・ウッタル・プラデーシュ州ランプル県の地域的な猫咬傷増加事例であり、狂犬病の症例確定や死亡例の報告はない。ネパールは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola takes severe toll on women and children in eastern DRC: UN
article.articleSummary: Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province) continues to deepen a humanitarian crisis as fear and conflict suppress healthcare access. The UN says nearly one million people are displaced, with women and children making up about 80% of the displaced. UNICEF reports children account for nearly one-third of Ebola-related deaths, though they represent roughly a quarter of confirmed cases. Health-service use has fallen by more than 40% in the hardest-hit areas due to fear of infection. UNFPA warns fear and stretched services hinder pregnant women from obtaining maternal care; maternal deaths in Ituri have nearly doubled, averaging about six per week from childbirth complications. Ebola infection during pregnancy remains tied to a very high risk of fetal loss.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国東部で女性と子どもに深刻な打撃を与えている:国連
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的流行がコンゴ民主共和国東部で人道危機を深刻化させており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性（高い死亡率・妊産婦死亡増加）からIHR基準を2つ以上満たす。
triage.notes: 紛争地域での医療アクセス低下、妊産婦死亡の急増、子どもの死亡割合の高さなど、既存のエボラ流行の深刻化を示す内容。国際的拡大や渡航制限については記事内で言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi must stay ahead of dengue this monsoon: Why rain, stagnant water and delayed diagnosis can turn a seasonal threat serious
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Delhi is a seasonal monsoon threat driven by rain, humidity and stagnant water that supports Aedes aegypti breeding. The virus is spread mainly by infected Aedes aegypti mosquitoes, which breed in small water accumulations such as flowerpot trays, discarded containers, old tyres, uncovered tanks, and neglected coolers. As of 2026-08-08, Delhi's MCD figures show dengue infections in 2026 below the corresponding period last year, but cases are steadily increasing as rainfall and humidity create favorable breeding conditions. Dr Prakhar Singh emphasizes that timing of prevention is critical; waiting for dengue cases to rise sharply before acting can leave communities trying to control mosquitoes after breeding has already expanded.

triage.headline_ja: デリーは今年のモンスーン期にデング熱への警戒を怠るな：雨、滞留水、診断の遅れが季節性の脅威を深刻化させる理由
triage.triage_reason: デリーの季節性デング熱に関する一般的な予防啓発記事であり、症例数は前年同期を下回っているため、異常事態や国際的懸念には該当しない。
triage.notes: 毎年恒例のモンスーン期デング熱予防啓発記事。2026年の症例数は前年を下回っており、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Cúm mùa có thể gây biến chứng nặng ở cả trẻ khỏe mạnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seasonal flu can cause serious complications even in healthy children.
article.articleSummary: Seasonal influenza can cause serious complications in children in Vietnam. At Bach Mai Hospital, Dr. Pham Cong Khac notes flu is a viral respiratory illness; most children recover in a week with proper care, but severe outcomes occur even in healthy kids. Symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, nasal congestion, and myalgia; younger children may be irritable, poorly fed, vomiting, or lethargic. Complications range from dehydration and asthma exacerbation to pneumonia, respiratory failure, myocarditis, encephalitis, seizures, rhabdomyolysis, shock, and multi-organ failure requiring ICU. High-risk groups include under-5s, under 2; congenital heart disease, chronic lung or neurological conditions, diabetes, immune suppression, and cancer. A 2026 US Pediatrics study found vaccinated children had about 80% lower influenza mortality (2016–2025). US guidelines advise annual vaccination for all 6 months+. Inactivated vaccines cannot cause flu; mild reactions are common. Prevention includes vaccination, hand hygiene, covering coughs, masking when needed, and keeping feverish children home.

triage.headline_ja: 季節性インフルエンザは健康な子どもにも重篤な合併症を引き起こす可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な医学啓発記事であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムの病院医師による季節性インフルエンザの一般的な健康啓発情報であり、特定の異常発生やアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。米国のワクチン研究データも引用されているが、これも一般的な医学情報。

article.articleHeadline: Over 200 Mithuns Dies Due to Foot-And-Mouth Disease in Arunachal
article.articleSummary: Over 200 mithuns have died in a foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) outbreak in Dibang Valley district, Arunachal Pradesh, in the last month. Acheso village has the highest deaths, with more than 90 mithuns killed, followed by Angrim (>50) and ALG (three). The outbreak has also spread to Aropo, Gipulin, and other villages. The district, with a mithun population of 3,925 per the 21st livestock census, faces intensified veterinary response: field operations, spot inspections, and medicines for sick animals. DVO Dr Dammo Riba is coordinating with panchayat leaders and mithun owners to monitor and treat cases. The state government has deployed an expert team and placed veterinary authorities in eastern districts on high alert.

triage.headline_ja: アルナーチャル・プラデーシュ州で口蹄疫により200頭以上のミトゥン(家畜牛)が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 動物(家畜)の口蹄疫感染事例であり人への直接的健康被害は報告されていないが、感染拡大と経済的影響の観点から継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本事例は動物(家畜)の疾病であり、ヒトへの感染や公衆衛生への直接的影響は記事内で言及されていない。家畜の経済的損失や地域の畜産業への影響として注視すべき事案。

article.articleHeadline: Pune records 749 suspected dengue cases this year, spike in June-July
article.articleSummary: Pune, Maharashtra, has recorded 749 suspected dengue viral fever cases this year, with about two-thirds occurring in June and July (175 in June, 323 in July) and 78 suspected cases reported in August to date. Suspected cases were NS1 antigen–positive on early screening; infections confirmed by Indian Council of Medical Research–National Institute of Virology lab in 26 cases. Health officials traced 1,708 mosquito breeding sites at homes, offices and schools, and levied an administrative fee of Rs 2.6 lakh. Wardwise, Kothrud leads with 72 cases, followed by Nagar Road-Wadgaonsheri (67), Warje-Karvenagar (65), Sahakarnagar (64) and Aundh-Baner (61). A parent in Kothrud reported a dengue-diagnosed five-year-old recovering, highlighting school exposure. In parallel, pediatricians report influenza-like illness and swine flu (AH1N1): about 60 children affected in the last 15 days; 107 AH1N1 confirmed Jan–Jul, ~75 in July.

triage.headline_ja: プネーで今年の推定デング熱症例749件を記録、6月から7月にかけて急増
triage.triage_reason: インド・プネーにおける季節性のデング熱・季節性インフルエンザ流行報告であり、モンスーン期の典型的な増加パターンで、重症例や国際的拡大の兆候はない。
triage.notes: デング熱749件（うち確定26件）、スワインフル（AH1N1）107件確認だが、いずれも季節性の地域内流行であり、地方自治体レベルで対応中。国際的関心や渡航制限の兆候なし。

article.articleHeadline: Над 300 починали деца от ебола след началото на епидемията
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 300 children died of Ebola after the outbreak began.
article.articleSummary: As of 8 August 2026, Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri Province, has surpassed 4,000 cases and 1,850 deaths, including over 300 child fatalities. Children account for about 25% of confirmed cases and roughly one-third of deaths. Health service use in the hardest-hit areas has fallen by over 40% due to fear of infection. Maternal mortality in Ituri has nearly doubled, with about six women dying weekly from pregnancy-related complications; Ebola infection during pregnancy is linked to near-universal fetal loss. The WHO Technical Advisory Group on Vaccine Research recommended a clinical trial in DRC to evaluate Ervebo against Bundibugyo virus; Ervebo is the only licensed Ebola vaccine. WHO, UNICEF and partners have deployed 13,000 public health workers, reaching over 2.4 million people with prevention and early-detection info and conducting more than 500,000 household visits, to counter fear and misinformation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行開始以降、子ども300人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で大規模なエボラ流行（4000症例、1850死亡）が継続しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、ヒト-ヒト感染拡大の懸念、国際支援の必要性が明確なためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 既存の大規模流行の継続報道。WHOやUNICEFなど国際機関が既に大規模介入しており、ワクチン臨床試験も検討されている。継続的なモニタリングとフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : renforcement des mesures barrières à l'institut supérieur pédagogique de Bunia - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: strengthening barrier measures at Bunia's Higher Institute of Pedagogy - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease prevention measures were tightened at Bunia's Higher Institute of Pedagogy in Ituri Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, during a combined ceremony marking the academic year’s closing and opening. All participants must wash hands and undergo temperature checks at entry; access to the ceremony hall was limited to students, academic authorities, and a select number of invited officials, with parents barred to reduce crowding. A sanitary screening setup was placed at the gate. These actions form part of wider efforts by health authorities and public institutions in Ituri to strengthen Ebola prevention and control, especially in high-traffic settings. The university community was urged to remain vigilant and observe hand hygiene and other health measures to support the outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ブニアの高等教育大学で防疫措置強化 - ACP通信
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州ブニアにおいて、エボラ出血熱のアウトブレイク対応の一環として教育機関での防疫措置強化が報じられており、エボラという致死率の高い感染症の継続的な流行状況を示唆しているためフルRRAでの確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事自体は新規症例の報告ではなく防疫措置強化に関するものだが、「アウトブレイク対応を支援する」との記述からイトゥリ州で進行中のエボラ流行の存在が示唆される。流行の規模・現状（症例数、死者数等）については記事から不明であり、続報および公式発表の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : désinfection obligatoire des véhicules reliant Mahagi à Bunia pour prévenir Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: Mandatory disinfection of vehicles linking Mahagi to Bunia to prevent Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 8 August 2026, Ituri province in northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo mandates disinfection for all vehicles traveling between Mahagi and Bunia to curb the Ebola outbreak. The rule covers public transport and privately imported passenger vehicles within the province; transport operators must provide lists of eligible vehicles to enable pre-departure disinfection. A checkpoint has been installed on Route Nationale 27 (RN27) at Ngote to enforce compliance, with sanctions for violators. The measure is separate from the border hygiene program (PNHF), which manages entry-point movements. Health officer Jaryekong'a Isaya of the Mahagi health zone announced the policy and urged cooperation and adherence to barrier measures to limit Ebola spread in several areas of Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州：エボラ予防のためマハギ〜ブニア間の車両消毒を義務化 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州でエボラ出血熱の感染拡大防止策として車両消毒義務化・検問所設置が行われており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生イベントである。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行そのものの詳細（症例数・死者数）には言及せず、地方当局による移動制限・消毒義務化措置に焦点を当てている。エボラはDRCで既知の反復的アウトブレイクであるため異常性はやや低いが、対策強化の動きは注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: खगड़िया : डेंगू-चिकनगुनिया से बचाव को लेकर दिया गया प्रशिक्षण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Khagaria: Training provided on dengue and chikungunya prevention
article.articleSummary: Khagaria hosted a one-day training for rural physicians on dengue and chikungunya prevention and management. The session covered causes, clinical features, preventive measures, patient identification, and treatment pathways for dengue and chikungunya. Experts highlighted that monsoon conditions promote mosquito breeding, elevating risk, and urged households to prevent water stagnation, enhance cleanliness, and employ protective measures such as nets, full-body clothing, and repellents. Physicians were trained to recognize suspected cases by fever, body pains, headache, joint pain, and weakness, and to refer patients promptly to nearby government health centers for testing and medical guidance. District officials pressed for ongoing community awareness. The August 1 district-level meeting, chaired by the District Magistrate, directed CHCs to train rural doctors within their areas. The Chhatam CHC program included participants from Kerala Bag area and Chhatam block, with health staff including VVDs Manish Kumar, WHO Monitor Sanjay Kumar, and others.

triage.headline_ja: カガリア：デング熱・チクングニア熱予防に関する研修が実施
triage.triage_reason: 地域の医療従事者向け予防研修に関する定例的な報道であり、具体的な症例急増や異常事態の記述がないため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 季節性のモンスーンに伴う蚊媒介感染症対策の一環としての研修・啓発活動の報道であり、具体的な患者数増加や異常発生の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai: डेंगू जांच के दौरान पानी की टंकी से गिरकर BMC कर्मचारी की मौत, भोईवाड़ा की BDD चॉल में हुआ हादसा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mumbai: BMC employee dies after falling from a water tank during dengue testing, incident at Bhoiwada's BDD Chawl.
article.articleSummary: During Mumbai's dengue prevention campaign, a 47-year-old BMC employee, Pandurang Todkar, died after falling from a water tank while inspecting for dengue-transmitting mosquitoes at BDD Chawl No. 6-A in Bhoiwada, Mumbai. Todkar, part of the F/South Ward PCO department, was surveying water tanks and containers for mosquito breeding as part of routine monsoon surveillance. He fell from a height of about 5 to 7 feet; an iron rod reportedly pierced his eye, causing life-threatening injuries. He was rushed to KEM Hospital where CPR and other resuscitation attempts failed and he was pronounced dead. Authorities say a full investigation will determine the circumstances and whether safety protocols and protective equipment were followed. The incident highlights the occupational hazards faced by field workers conducting dengue surveillance in urban monsoon conditions.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイ:デング熱調査中に給水タンクから転落、BMC職員死亡 ボイワダのBDDチャウルで事故発生
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の発生自体ではなく、蚊媒介調査中の労働災害による職員死亡事故であり、公衆衛生上の感染症シグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の流行状況やサーベイランス結果を報じるものではなく、蚊の繁殖調査中に発生した労働災害（転落死）に関する内容であるため、感染症シグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 'അനങ്ങാനോ ഭക്ഷണം കഴിക്കാനോ പോലും പറ്റില്ല, 104 ഡി​ഗ്രി പനിയിലും ഷൂട്ടിങ്ങിന് പോയി'; അവികയ്ക്ക് ഡെങ്കിപ്പനി സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചെന്ന് ഭർത്താവ്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unable to eat or drink anything, she went to shoot even with a 104-degree fever; her husband confirms Avika has dengue.
article.articleSummary: Indian actress Avika Gor has dengue, confirmed by her husband Milind Chandwani in an Instagram video. Milind says she has been hospitalized for the past five days with a high fever and is unable to eat or drink. He notes her temperature reached 104°F, and that she still went ahead with a shoot despite the illness. The update emphasizes that dengue has been diagnosed, but the report provides no further details on laboratory confirmation timing, prognosis, or exposure source. No other locations or individuals are mentioned. The information is conveyed through Milind Chandwani’s social-media post, highlighting the ongoing health challenge faced by the actress.

article.articleHeadline: Congolese rebels linked to Islamic State said to kill at least 13 villagers in Ebola-struck region
article.articleSummary: 13 civilians were killed in Banana École, a village near Mambasa, Congo, by Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) militants linked to Islamic State, who attacked early Saturday, looting and burning homes. The assault occurred as Congo endures an Ebola outbreak described as the fastest-spreading in history in the eastern region, with residents fleeing toward Bunia. The ADF, rooted in Uganda and pledging allegiance to Islamic State in 2019, has long operated in the border area. The head of New Civil Society of Congo/Mambasa notes the death toll is provisional as searches continue in surrounding villages. The violence amplifies a volatile security landscape in eastern Congo, where M23 and other rebel groups operate. In July 2025, the UN reported the ADF killed 66 people in eastern Congo in a “bloodbath.”

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの反政府勢力（イスラム国系）、エボラ発生地域で少なくとも13人の村人を殺害したとされる
triage.triage_reason: 記事はコンゴ東部のエボラ流行地域における武装勢力の襲撃を報じているが、当該エボラ流行が「史上最速の拡大」と表現されており、治安悪化による住民の避難・移動が感染拡大や対応能力低下につながる懸念があるため、IHR基準の複数該当が見込まれる。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼は武装勢力による村民殺害事件だが、コンゴ東部のエボラ流行が『史上最速の拡大』と評され、治安悪化・住民避難が感染対応を困難にしている点が公衆衛生上のリスクとして注視すべき。具体的な症例数・死亡者数など疫学データは記事内に記載なし。ウガンダはADFの拠点として言及されているが、発生地域としての言及ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 13 وفاة و240 مصاب بالكوليرا في تشاد
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 13 deaths and 240 cholera cases in Chad
article.articleSummary: Chad reports a cholera outbreak with 13 deaths and about 240 cases since late July; as of the previous Monday, 239 cases and 13 deaths were recorded nationwide, CFR 5.4%. Most infections are in the Hadjer-Lamis region and in the capital, N'Djamena, where 11 deaths occurred in August, indicating rapid spread in densely populated areas. Authorities cite limited access to safe drinking water and sanitation as key drivers, despite some improvements elsewhere. About 50,800 people have received the cholera vaccine since the July 24 outbreak declaration, part of a campaign to curb transmission and protect high-risk groups. The earliest deaths occurred on June 13, more than a month before the official outbreak. Across West and Central Africa, outbreaks have also affected the Central African Republic, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and Nigeria. Cholera is a water- and foodborne bacterial disease treatable with early care; without treatment it can be fatal.

triage.headline_ja: チャドでコレラにより13人死亡、240人感染
triage.triage_reason: 致死率5.4%と高く、複数国（中央アフリカ共和国、コンゴ民主共和国、ナイジェリア）にまたがる地域的流行となっており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）を2つ満たすためフルRRAへ進めるべきと判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はチャドでの流行（対象国リスト外）だが、サマリー中で中央アフリカ・コンゴ民主共和国・ナイジェリアにも流行が及んでいると明記されているため、対象国であるDRCのみverified_locationsに含めた。チャド国内の詳細（ワクチン接種状況等）は続報で確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kerala Reports 105 Chikungunya Cases Amid Monsoon Surge
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya infections in Kerala, India, rose during the 2026 monsoon, with 105 confirmed and 62 probable cases reported as of August 4, 2026. Thiruvananthapuram district accounts for the bulk of infections, triggering intensified vector-control and public-awareness efforts. Monsoon rainfall creates abundant Aedes breeding sites, especially in discarded containers, tyres, flower pots, coconut shells, drains, and empty water-storage vessels; vectors include Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, which can also transmit dengue. Surveillance and mosquito-control measures have been strengthened, with emphasis on community participation to eliminate breeding sites. Chikungunya is transmitted by daytime-biting mosquitoes; symptoms include sudden fever and severe joint pain, plus headache, muscle pain, fatigue, joint swelling, and rashes. Treatment is supportive; there is no antiviral. Prevention focuses on eliminating standing water, protective clothing, repellents, and screened homes.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州、モンスーンの影響でチクングニア熱105件を報告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の媒介蚊感染症の増加であり毎年報告される事象だが、症例数や地域拡大を継続的に監視する必要がある。IHR基準には該当せず社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: モンスーン期に例年みられるチクングニア・デング熱の増加であり、現地当局によるベクター対策が実施されている。重症例や死亡の報告はなく、現時点では通常の季節性発生の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Swara Bhasker Hospitalised After Testing Positive For Dengue, Shares Health Update
article.articleSummary: New Delhi, 8 August 2026 – Swara Bhasker has been diagnosed with dengue and hospitalised, Instagram posting “Dengue-fied and hospitalised!” with no disclosed symptom details or duration. Avika Gor (Balika Vadhu) is also hospitalised after testing positive for dengue; her husband Milind Chandwani said she had a high fever for five days before diagnosis. She reportedly continued working, completing a shoot and then travelling to Delhi to film an advertisement, before her dengue diagnosis was confirmed on a return to Mumbai. Swara Bhasker, last seen on the TV reality show Pati Patni Aur Panga, has not announced her next project, while Avika Gor’s latest release was the Telugu thriller Ugly Story, which hit theatres May 22. No deaths or broader outbreak context are provided, and infection sources are not detailed.

triage.triage_reason: 有名人個人のデング熱罹患に関する芸能ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や広範な流行を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドの風土病であり個別の芸能人罹患事例のため、感染症危機管理上のシグナルとしては該当しない。地域リストにインドが含まれるが、記事は個人の健康状態報告であり流行状況を示す内容ではないためverified_locationsは空とする。

article.articleHeadline: Monyet Ekor Panjang Serang 18 Warga Tembilahan, Puluhan Sekolah Ditutup - Suara Merdeka Banyumas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Long-tailed macaques attack 18 residents of Tembilahan, dozens of schools closed
article.articleSummary: Long-tailed macaques triggered a human-wildlife conflict in Tembilahan, Kota Tembilahan, Riau, Indonesia, injuring 18 residents across 19 attacks, with one person struck twice. The BBKSDA Riau deployed cage-trap measures, and the Wildlife Rescue Unit KSDA Wilayah I captured the implicated macaque on Thursday. The animal was transported to Pekanbaru for blood tests and conservation observations. Medical care included sutures for bites and inoculation against rabies as a precaution. In response, 40 schools in Tembilahan remained closed on Friday, with three days of online learning; in-person classes were planned to resume Monday if field conditions were deemed safe. Authorities warned that other primates may remain in the area, urging heightened vigilance. The incident underscores human-wildlife conflict linked to habitat alteration in Southeast Asia, including forest clearance for plantations such as oil palm.

triage.notes: 記事は野生動物（マカク）による人身攻撃事件であり、狂犬病の確定診断や感染拡大の報告はない。予防的措置としての狂犬病ワクチン接種のみ言及されている。学校閉鎖は野生動物対策のためであり感染症拡大防止措置ではない。

article.articleHeadline: AIIMS to undertake advanced TB testing in 2 dists
article.articleSummary: AIIMS Bhubaneswar to pilot advanced TB testing in two Odisha districts, boosting tuberculosis elimination efforts in the state. In collaboration with the Odisha government, the initiative will deploy advanced genotypic testing and Universal Drug Susceptibility Testing to enable early detection of drug-resistant TB, improve treatment outcomes, reduce transmission, and strengthen public health response in rural, tribal, and remote areas. The plan was outlined during the National Conclave and Policy Dialogue on Tuberculosis in Bhubaneswar, with Odisha assembly speaker Surama Padhy urging closer coordination among AIIMS Bhubaneswar, government, and stakeholders to translate findings into action. Health Minister Mukesh Mahaling emphasized coordinated participation across agencies, labs and communities. AIIMS Bhubaneswar Executive Director Dr. Ashutosh Biswas said discussions are underway to start the two-district pilot to generate evidence for wider rollout if feasible, affordable, and scalable within the public health system.
