article.articleHeadline: Swara Bhasker Hospitalised With Dengue: 5 Warning Signs To Watch Out For
article.articleSummary: Swara Bhasker was hospitalised in Mumbai after being diagnosed with dengue, sharing a photo of an IV line and a hospital gown on Instagram. Actress Avika Gor was also hospitalised with dengue, with her husband Milind Chandwani posting a health update. While dengue has traditionally been tied to India's monsoon, cases are reportedly occurring year-round. Dengue symptoms (per US CDC) include fever, severe headache, pain behind the eyes, muscle and joint pain, nausea, vomiting, and skin rash. Severe dengue warning signs requiring urgent care include nose or gum bleeding, abdominal pain or tenderness, repeated vomiting, and blood in stool or vomiting blood. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes aegypti mosquitoes that breed in stagnant water. To reduce infection risk, prevention focuses on eliminating standing water.

triage.headline_ja: 女優スワラ・バスカーがデング熱で入院：注意すべき5つの警告サイン
triage.triage_reason: 著名人の個人的な入院に関する一般的な健康記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や集団発生を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドの風土病であり、本記事は個人の症例紹介と一般的な症状啓発が主旨。集団発生やアウトブレイクの情報は含まれないため、疾患自体は既知でありverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola Crisis Deepens As Officials Investigate Virus Changes
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) exceeds 4,000 cases. As of Aug 4, there are 3,973 confirmed infections, 1,801 deaths, and 776 recoveries across 51 health zones in five provinces, with 99 new cases and 52 deaths reported in the latest 24 hours. The outbreak began official reporting on May 15, with concerns of undetected spread since January. WHO and Africa CDC urge major expansion of the response as conventional containment lags; investigators are assessing whether viral changes contribute to severity, though a mutation has not been confirmed. Transmission is hard to trace: over two-thirds of deaths occur in communities, and at a Bunia MSF centre about 90% of admissions are not listed as contacts. Contact tracing covers ~75% of contacts (target 95%); about 10 contacts per patient (vs ~40 expected). Response shifts to door-to-door active searches by community health workers; Ituri accounts for ~90% of cases, with Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbwalu heavily affected. North Kivu treatment-centre occupancy at 139% (674 patients).

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ危機深刻化、当局がウイルス変化を調査
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認例3,973件・死者1,801人に達する大規模エボラ流行が継続し、WHO・Africa CDCが対応拡大を要請するなど公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的懸念が認められるため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にルワンダ(Kigali Province)が含まれるが、記事本文中では感染確認の記載がなく、対象国リストにも含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو: تفشٍ قياسي لإيبولا وسط مخاوف من سلالة بلا علاج
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Record Ebola outbreak amid fears of an untreatable strain.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns unprecedented acceleration of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with transmission spreading beyond the epicenter in Ituri province in the northeast. Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says containment remains possible if authorities and partners act faster than the virus, amid concerns about movement into new areas. The outbreak has reached five provinces; official counts likely underestimate true numbers by at least fourfold due to late detection and infections outside known transmission chains. To date, 3,973 confirmed infections have been reported in 80 days, with more than 1,800 deaths and 776 recoveries; around 220 suspected cases are pending confirmation. About 84% of cases are in Ituri, which accounts for roughly 85% of the most recent 99 new infections. Fears of an untreatable strain are compounded by health-worker protests in Bunia over unpaid salaries, hindering the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ:未治療株への懸念の中、記録的なエボラ流行
triage.triage_reason: WHOが前例のない加速を警告し、5州に拡大、致死率も高く（死亡1,800/確認3,973）、公衆衛生対応が不十分な状況でIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が公式声明を出しており、症例数の過小評価（実際は4倍以上の可能性）、医療従事者のストライキによる対応の遅延など、複数の悪化要因が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 확산...확진 4천 명 넘어 '수도 킨샤사' 비상
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo... confirmed cases exceed 4,000; Kinshasa, the capital, on high alert.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 cumulative cases, with 1,850 deaths (case fatality about 45.7%) as of Aug 5, 2026, exceeding the 2018–2020 maximum. Children and women bear a heavy burden: UNICEF reports more than 300 child deaths, with children making up about a quarter of confirmed cases but roughly a third of deaths. Fear has reduced healthcare use; in hardest-hit areas, service utilization fell over 40%, and maternal deaths have risen as pregnant women avoid care. Kinshasa is on high alert as the virus nears the capital. A 32-year-old man who traveled on the Congo River died after disembarking near Kinshasa; the vessel halted at Maluku, 65 km from Kinshasa, after 300 passengers were tested and 7 suspected cases tested negative. The WHO urges Ervebo vaccine trials in DRC, while authorities bolster ship surveillance. About 13,000 community volunteers have reached over 2.4 million people with prevention and early-detection information.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴでエボラ拡大…感染者4000人超、首都キンシャサに非常事態
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで4000人超・致死率約46%に達し、首都キンシャサ近郊まで拡大の恐れがあるためIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 首都キンシャサ近郊での感染疑い事例が報告されており、都市部への拡大が懸念される。WHOがエボラワクチン(Ervebo)治験を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: ଗଲାଣି ୨ ଜୀବନ Malaria Outbreak in Odisha | Two Deaths Reported in Naktideula Village
article.articleSummary: Malaria outbreak in Odisha, India, with two deaths reported from Naktideula village as of 2026-08-08. The outbreak has seen residents presenting with high fever, signaling ongoing transmission in the area. The report notes inadequate preventive measures and widespread concern as health authorities and the district administration face scrutiny over the response. It highlights demands for urgent government action and stronger public health intervention. The article provides a ground-level depiction of local reactions, but does not include laboratory confirmation details, infection source, or information on imported/exported cases. Overall, the incident underscores a malaria crisis in Naktideula, Odisha, prompting calls for improved surveillance, timely treatment access, and proactive measures from the Odisha Health Department.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州でマラリア流行、ナクティデウラ村で2人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 村レベルでの限定的なマラリア流行で死亡例が報告されているが、検査確認情報や感染源、症例数などの詳細が不明であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には至っていないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: オディシャ州ナクティデウラ村における局地的なマラリア流行。検査確認・感染源・症例規模など詳細情報が不足しており、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Avanza campaña de intensificación contra sarampión en Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles intensification campaign advances in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Measles intensification campaign in Sao Paulo, Brazil, administered 281,714 vaccine doses in the week beginning 3 August 2026, a sharp rise from about 24,000 doses between 27 June and 2 August 2026. Sao Paulo city accounts for 20 of 23 confirmed measles cases in the state this year. All patients are either unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated; the most affected group is children under one year, with 16 cases. To protect infants, authorities have offered a dose zero for 6–11-month-olds; 32,501 children in this age group have received it since 29 June. Dose zero is not a substitute for the standard vaccination schedule. Measles is highly contagious and can cause serious complications. Brazil eliminated endemic measles in 2016, lost the status due to renewed transmission, and regained elimination in 2024.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで麻疹対策強化キャンペーンが進展
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹排除認定を再取得したブラジルで再流行がみられ、乳児を中心に感染が拡大しており、政府が大規模な予防接種キャンペーンを実施していることから、伝播しやすさ・政府の関心の観点でシグナル基準を満たす。
triage.notes: サンパウロ州で23例確認、うち20例がサンパウロ市。1歳未満児が最多（16例）。全例未接種または不完全接種。ブラジルは2016年に麻疹排除を達成後、再流行により認定を失い、2024年に再取得済み。国内での大規模ワクチン接種対応が進行中で、国際支援の必要性は現時点で不明。

article.articleHeadline: Visitante com sarampo passa 11 horas na Universal Studios e expõe milhares de pessoas ao vírus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Visitor with measles spends 11 hours at Universal Studios and exposes thousands of people to the measles virus.
article.articleSummary: Measles exposure at Universal Studios Hollywood in Los Angeles County after an infected visitor spent 11 hours there on Sunday, July 26 (10:00–21:00). The Los Angeles County Department of Public Health began investigating on August 5, warning the virus may have spread and urging anyone who was at the park that day to verify immunity and monitor for symptoms through August 16, since measles typically appears 7–21 days post-exposure. Common signs include fever, cough, runny nose, red eyes, and a rash that usually starts on the face and spreads. Universal Studios Hollywood confirmed cooperation with health officials. As of August 6, 2026, the US has 2,465 measles cases, 93% of which are in unvaccinated or vaccination-unknown individuals. The CDC recommends two MMR vaccine doses: first at 12–15 months and second at 4–6 years. Brazil’s SUS provides vaccination as part of its program.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹感染者がユニバーサル・スタジオに11時間滞在し、数千人にウイルスを曝露
triage.triage_reason: 事象は米国ロサンゼルス郡での麻疹曝露であり、ブラジルへの言及はワクチン接種制度の一般情報に留まるため、対象国での実際の発生とは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国カリフォルニア州ロサンゼルス郡での麻疹曝露事例であり、ブラジルは自国のワクチン接種制度（SUS）に関する補足情報として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : les sept passagers testés du bateau de Maluku sont négatifs
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the seven passengers tested on the Maluku boat are negative.
article.articleSummary: On August 7, 2026, seven passengers aboard a Kisangani-origin boat near Kinshasa tested negative for Ebola after symptoms resembling malaria (fever, headache). The vessel has been held about 65 km upstream of Kinshasa since August 5; around 300 travelers were screened on August 6, with seven sampled for testing, as authorities noted an Ebola carrier is not contagious until symptomatic. The death that triggered the alert, a 32-year-old man who died in Pimu (Mongala province) after fever and diarrhea, is not yet confirmed as Ebola-linked. The outbreak began May 15 in Ituri and is attributed to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. As of August 4, INSP recorded 3,973 confirmed cases, 1,801 deaths, 776 recoveries, and 674 in isolation across five provinces; government data on August 7 cited over 4,000 cases and over 1,850 deaths, without specifying probable cases. WHO deployed teams to Maluku; Kinshasa-bound boats are now screened.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱DRC：マルクの船で検査された7人の乗客は陰性
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中の大規模エボラ流行（確定例約4000例、死亡者1800人超、5州に拡大）に関連する事案であり、WHOが対応チームを派遣し船舶スクリーニングを実施するなど、国際的関心・対応が既に高い状況にある。
triage.notes: 本記事自体は船上乗客の検査陰性という限定的な内容だが、背景にある大規模エボラ流行（2026年5月15日発生、Bundibugyoエボラウイルス株、5州にわたり拡大中）はすでにWHOの介入を要する深刻な公衆衛生危機であり、既存の流行の一部としてフルリスク評価の継続対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Tiruchi Corporation steps up disease surveillance ahead of monsoon
article.articleSummary: On 8 August 2026, Tiruchi Corporation intensified monsoon preparedness to tackle water- and vector-borne diseases. It identified 28 hotspots—notably Pattammal Street near the airport and East Boulevard Road—for dengue risk and monitors around 150 hospitals and 35 laboratories for fever, dengue, and malaria trends. So far this month, four dengue cases have been reported. To curb mosquitoes, 46 portable fogging machines and high-capacity foggers are deployed, with a dedicated team. About 350 domestic breeding checkers conduct door-to-door inspections across wards to identify and remove breeding sources, especially poorly maintained plots and open scrap yards. Notices will be issued to plot owners and scrap dealers. Schools will be inspected, with nodal officers appointed to monitor conditions and absenteeism.

triage.headline_ja: ティルチ市が雨季を前に疾病サーベイランスを強化
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン前の定例的な媒介動物対策・監視体制強化についての報道であり、デング熱症例数も少なく（今月4例）、異常性や深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威は認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による毎年恒例の雨季前の防疫対策記事。デング熱4例、マラリアへの言及はあるが具体的症例数の記載なし。ルーチン業務として見送り妥当。

article.articleHeadline: "WHO": Der Ebola-Ausbruch in der Demokratischen Republik Kongo übersteigt unsere Reaktionsfähigkeit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "WHO": The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceeds our capacity to respond.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceeds response capacity, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. As of the wave declared on May 15, 2026, confirmed Ebola cases have risen above 4,000, totaling 4,053 infections and more than 1,850 deaths. It is the second-largest Ebola outbreak worldwide and the fastest-spreading, driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is neither a vaccine nor an approved treatment. Tedros urged sustained commitment, more resources, and stronger international support to ensure safe access for response teams and to protect civilians and health workers, with solidarity from WHO and the African CDC. The article provides no symptom or laboratory detail beyond case counts, but stresses the need to intensify efforts to end the outbreak and save lives.

triage.headline_ja: 「WHO」：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、対応能力を超える
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長が対応能力を超えると表明した大規模エボラ流行（4,000人超感染、1,850人超死亡）で、ワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyo株による過去2番目の規模・最速拡大の流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長自身が『対応能力を超える』と発言し、国際支援強化を要請している点が重要。ワクチン・治療法未承認のBundibugyo株による流行で、致死率・拡大速度ともに深刻。

article.articleHeadline: 精准聚焦关键环节！东莞大朗城管全力织密虫媒传染病防控网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Precise Focus on Key Links! Dongguan Dalang Urban Management Strives to Tighten the Vector-Borne Infectious Disease Prevention and Control Network.
article.articleSummary: Dongguan’s Dalang City Management Sub-bureau intensifies vector-borne disease prevention through environmental sanitation and vector-disinfection enforcement. In Songbai Village along Xinyuan Third Road, inspectors found大量 litter and poor sanitation by the contracted cleaning company, violating City Domestic Waste Management Regulations. A case was opened; authorities issued a correction order and an investigation notice, demanding immediate cleanup and strengthened maintenance. The action centers on source control and precise enforcement, covering public areas, residential communities, and back alleys with emphasis on drainage and standing-water removal, daily waste clearance, routine cleaning, vector disinfection, and hazard remediation. The bureau will maintain regular patrols and ramp up oversight to push sanitation firms to fulfill responsibilities, standardize practices, and eradicate mosquito breeding sites, safeguarding residents’ health and supporting ongoing public health measures against vector-borne diseases in the district.

triage.headline_ja: 的確に重要項目に焦点！東莞大朗市城管が媒介虫感染症の予防管理網を全力で強化
triage.triage_reason: 特定の疾患発生ではなく、行政による日常的な衛生管理・害虫防除の取り組みに関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や具体的な感染症発生の報告はない。
triage.notes: 疾患名は「Unknown Illness」だが、記事内容は具体的な感染症発生ではなく、蚊媒介感染症予防のための衛生行政活動（ゴミ処理・害虫駆除の取締り）に関する内容。対象国の実際の感染症発生とは無関係のためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Erode district administration steps up measures against seasonal diseases
article.articleSummary: Erode district in Tamil Nadu stepped up preventive measures against seasonal fevers and vector-borne diseases on Aug 8, 2026. District Collector S. Kandasamy said actions target dengue, chikungunya and malaria amid monsoon-driven mosquito risk. A tyre removal drive (Aug 6) aimed to eliminate breeding sites; drinking-water chlorine testing was conducted across the district on Aug 8. Mosquito larva control will be carried out in all schools on Aug 10, with broader sanitation efforts. A mass cleaning campaign is planned for Aug 11 to remove garbage, unused water storage tanks and other breeding sources. Officials warn stagnant rainwater can boost mosquitoes and diarrhoea risk. Public guidance urges preventing water stagnation around homes and avoiding rainwater collection in tyres and containers. Fever, headache, body pain, vomiting or diarrhoea require medical attention.

triage.headline_ja: エロード県当局、季節性疾患対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の媒介動物感染症（デング熱、チクングニア熱、マラリア）に対する通常の予防的行政対応であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性の予防対策（幼虫駆除、清掃キャンペーン、水質検査等）に関する行政広報であり、具体的な症例数や流行状況は報告されていない。モンスーン期の恒例的な対策のため、対象国リストへの該当はあるが実際の発生イベントとしての特筆性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Twin city hosps report surge in monsoon illnesses among children
article.articleSummary: Monsoon-triggered surge in pediatric illnesses in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, with viral fever, cough/cold, diarrhoea and other infections. Hospitals report 40%+ higher paediatric OPD footfall over the past week; SVPPGIP/Sishu Bhawan in Cuttack sees daily attendance rise from 500–600 to about 800. Doctors note vector-borne diseases such as malaria and dengue, plus viral fever, common cold, flu and respiratory infections, are prevalent, while waterborne diseases like diarrhoea, dysentery, typhoid and jaundice arise from contaminated water. Influenza virus is highlighted as a major contributor. Most children recover in 5–7 days, though some develop complications due to low immunity or other conditions. Preventive guidance includes handwashing, better nutrition, avoiding street food during monsoon, and consulting a physician before using medicines, particularly antibiotics. Health department appeals for adherence to basic hygiene to reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: インド・双子都市の病院でモンスーン期の小児疾患が急増と報告
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン期に例年見られる季節性小児疾患（ウイルス性発熱、下痢、マラリア・デング等）の増加であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: モンスーン季節性疾患の増加報告であり、地域の医療機関が既に対応している通常の公衆衛生事象と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'épidémie d'Ebola ne montre " aucun signe de ralentissement ", alerte MSF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The Ebola outbreak shows no signs of slowing down, MSF warns.
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola virus disease outbreak shows no signs of slowing, with 3,605 confirmed cases and about 1,500 deaths by August 1, 2026, over eleven weeks, the largest outbreak documented in the country and the 17th Ebola outbreak there. New cases are reported daily in new localities, including areas outside established transmission chains. Ituri remains the epicenter, with spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uele. MSF reports over 1,400 staff supporting seven Ebola treatment centers and more than 15 isolation units in these provinces, in support of the Ministry of Health. Despite progress in testing and contact tracing, 90% of patients admitted to the Bunia center were not identified contacts, and only 59% of identified contacts in Ituri. The response must accelerate, with stronger community engagement and unimpeded access to affected zones, especially as the rainy season complicates movement and logistics. Other emergencies—malaria, measles, cholera, and malnutrition—continue, with strikes in Ituri disrupting operations.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ流行は「減速の兆しなし」、MSFが警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行が継続し、3,605例確定・約1,500人死亡と深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、複数州への拡大や国際支援の必要性も明白なためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事は主にエボラ流行に焦点を当てているが、マラリア・麻疹・コレラ・栄養失調などの併発緊急事態にも言及。イトゥリ州でのストライキが対応活動に支障をきたしている点も注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: സംസ്ഥാനത്ത് ആശങ്കജനകമായി എലിപ്പനി ബാധിച്ചുള്ള മരണം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarmingly, a death due to smallpox in the state.
article.articleSummary: Smallpox deaths in Kerala are rising alarmingly, with two recent fatalities in Ernakulam and Kozhikode and six deaths recorded in the past week. Health authorities are preparing to amend treatment guidelines as cases remain severe. Professor Dr. A. Althaf of Trivandrum Medical College states that smallpox accounts for more than half of state infectious-disease deaths, and notes an annual toll of about 300–400 deaths over the last five years. He emphasizes that prompt, proper treatment could prevent these deaths. A health department occupation analysis shows most victims are daily-wage workers who encounter muddy water and waterlogged areas during the monsoon. The transmission is described as occurring when water and soil are contaminated by the excreta of rats, donkeys, cats, dogs, and cattle, allowing bacteria to enter the human body.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州でレプトスピラ症（原文は「天然痘」と誤訳）による死亡が深刻化
triage.triage_reason: 疾患名は『Smallpox』となっているが、記事内容（ネズミの尿・泥水・雨季・人獣共通感染）から実際はレプトスピラ症（エリピニー）と判断される。地域的な風土病であり国際的拡大の懸念は低いが、死亡者数増加と治療体制見直しの動きがあり継続観察が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedotの疾患分類『Smallpox』は誤りで、記事内容はレプトスピラ症（Leptospirosis、マラヤーラム語で『エリピニー』＝ネズミ熱）を指していると考えられる。天然痘（根絶疾患）としての国際的重大性は該当しない。毎年雨季に発生する既知の風土病で、州保健当局が治療ガイドライン改定を検討中。

article.articleHeadline: Вторая крупнейшая вспышка эболы в истории: вирус в Конго мог мутировать
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The second-largest Ebola outbreak in history: the virus in Congo could have mutated.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports the second-largest Ebola outbreak in its history, driven by Bundibugyo strain. As of August 4, 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths; Africa CDC later said 4,000-case threshold exceeded. Outbreak began May 15, with transmission since January. Authorities fear possible mutation, with planned studies after talks with WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The main danger is heavy community transmission: over 66% of deaths occur outside clinics; MSF in Bunia reports 90% of admissions were not on prior contact lists; contact tracing averages about 10 per case (minimum 40). A shift to active case finding is planned: door-to-door surveys, IDP camp outreach, engagement of community leaders. Treatments include Remdesivir and Ervebo vaccination; vaccinated individuals show milder illness. Ituri remains epicenter, spreading to North and South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Chopo; Uganda reports 20 cases but containment was achieved. Kinshasa at risk; health system strained as care declines.

triage.headline_ja: 史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行：コンゴのウイルスは変異した可能性
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行（4000例超・死亡1801人）が発生し、コミュニティ内感染拡大とウガンダへの越境伝播、変異の懸念があり、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも20例確認されているが封じ込め済みと報告されており、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ウイルス変異の可能性についてはWHOとの協議・研究計画段階であり確定情報ではない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO recommends Ervebo vaccine trial against Bundibugyo virus in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DR Congo to host a randomized clinical trial of the Ervebo vaccine against Bundibugyo virus disease, after the WHO Technical Advisory Group recommended prioritising this research in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The recommendation followed July 31 reviews of safety, efficacy, availability and feasibility in the wake of a Bundibugyo outbreak that prompted a May 16 Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Preliminary animal data suggested Ervebo may offer some cross-protection against Bundibugyo disease, particularly in reducing deaths, but human effectiveness against infection and transmission remains unproven. Experts noted no identified safety concerns with Ervebo for use among contacts of confirmed Bundibugyo cases; however, Ervebo was developed for Ebola Zaire virus and its effectiveness against Bundibugyo disease needs evaluation through clinical research. A Bundibugyo-specific vaccine remains the preferred option, though early candidates lack published data; if efficacy is shown, large-scale production and access would be pursued.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国におけるブンディブギョウイルスに対するEbveboワクチン治験を推奨
triage.triage_reason: 既にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）が宣言されているブンディブギョウウイルス病アウトブレイクに関する続報であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 本記事はPHEIC宣言済みのブンディブギョウウイルス病アウトブレイクに対するワクチン治験（Ervebo）の推奨に関する続報。既存の緊急事態の進展情報として重要度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak surpasses 4,000 cases
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases as of 2026-08-08—the first time in the current outbreak, the world’s second-largest and fastest-spreading on record. Death toll nears 2,000 as authorities tighten screening to prevent spread to Kinshasa, including boat-passenger checks after a traveler died with Ebola-like symptoms. Frontline health workers report fighting the outbreak without pay and under dangerous conditions. The World Health Organization is urging trials of the Ervebo vaccine as officials warn the epidemic is outpacing containment. The rapid rise signals ongoing transmission across affected areas and underscores the urgent need for expanded vaccination trials, enhanced surveillance, and safer working conditions for responders to curb further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、症例数4,000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が4,000症例・死者2,000人近くに達し、キンシャサへの拡大リスクや封じ込め失敗の懸念があるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 史上2番目の規模・最速拡大のエボラ流行とされ、首都キンシャサへの波及防止のためのスクリーニング強化が行われている。WHOはワクチン治験の拡大を要請。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo confirma 23 casos de sarampo e especialistas emitem alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo confirms 23 measles cases and experts issue an alert.
article.articleSummary: As of 8 August 2026, São Paulo reports 23 confirmed measles cases, prompting an alert due to the virus’s high transmissibility, including spread before fever and rash appear, complicating contact tracing and outbreak control. Most patients had missed doses or incomplete vaccination, leading to a state push for universal immunization and revaccination for people aged 6 months to 59 years, including infants, children, adolescents, adults and seniors without up-to-date vaccination records. Campaigns center on the measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine across public clinics, mobile units, and schools to reach those unvaccinated or needing boosters. The focus areas are the capital São Paulo, São Bernardo do Campo, and Guarulhos, where coverage is below ideal. Despite Brazil’s 2024 elimination of endemic measles, outbreaks in Bolivia, Argentina, Peru and North America increase reintroduction risk amid travel and sub-95% vaccination rates; first-dose 77.5%, second-dose 65.5% of the 95% target.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロで麻疹23例確認、専門家が警戒呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルは2024年に麻疹排除国となったが再発生が確認され、ワクチン接種率不足と近隣国での流行により再拡大リスクがあるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 対象国リストにペルー・ボリビア・アルゼンチンは含まれないため、ブラジルのみをverified_locationsに記載。ブラジルは麻疹排除国だったが、近隣国からの再導入リスクとワクチン接種率不足（目標95%に対し1回目77.5%、2回目65.5%）が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: North Kashmir's Sonawari Reports Two Drug-Resistant TB Cases Among Women
article.articleSummary: Two drug-resistant tuberculosis cases in North Kashmir's Sonawari area involve women; diagnosis confirmed this year by LPA testing showing resistance to first-line drugs rifampicin and isoniazid. Patients are under treatment via the National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP). LPA enables rapid detection of TB and resistance patterns, with two molecular testing machines now in Sumbal and Hajin to aid early detection. The cases underscore ongoing TB control challenges in Jammu and Kashmir, which reported over 11,900 TB cases in 2025. Common symptoms include persistent cough over two weeks, fever, night sweats, chest pain, fatigue, and weight loss. Family history is noted in Sonawari; close contacts are screened, and patients enrolled since February 2026 are monitored regularly. Officials stress early diagnosis, strict treatment adherence, and awareness campaigns to prevent transmission; drug-resistant TB requires longer, more intensive therapy but is curable with proper management.

triage.headline_ja: 北カシミールのソナワリ地区で女性2名の薬剤耐性結核症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: 薬剤耐性結核の孤発的な2症例であり、既存の国家結核撲滅プログラム下で適切に管理されている。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、社会的関心も限定的なため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 発生地域にシリア(Deir ez-Zor)が含まれるが、記事内容はインド・ジャンムー/カシミール地方の結核症例に関するものであり、シリアは主題ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Cộng hòa Dân chủ Congo ghi nhận hơn 300 trẻ em tử vong do Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports more than 300 children have died from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Since mid-May, an Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has killed more than 300 children, about a quarter of infections and nearly a third of deaths. Ituri province is among the hardest hit, with about 1 million people displaced by conflict, and women and children comprising about 80% of the displaced. UNICEF says the outbreak is disrupting essential health services, with health-seeking in affected areas down over 40%. UNFPA reports maternal mortality in Ituri has nearly doubled, averaging six deaths per week, and pregnant women with Ebola face high miscarriage risk. The government, Africa CDC, UNICEF and WHO have mobilized about 13,000 community workers, reached more than 2.4 million people, and conducted 500,000 household visits to counter misinformation and encourage care. On Aug 7, WHO advised randomized Ervebo trials for Bundibugyo virus, noting possible cross-protection from animal data; Ervebo is licensed for Zaire ebolavirus only. The outbreak prompted a May 16 PHEIC, and total Ebola deaths in Africa exceed 1,000.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラで300人以上の子どもが死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数(重篤性、異常性、国際的拡大リスク)に該当し、PHEIC宣言済みの継続中の重大アウトブレイクであるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 既にPHEIC宣言済みのアウトブレイクで、Africa全体でのエボラ死者数が1000人超と報告されている。紛争による人口移動や医療アクセス低下が状況を悪化させており、継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: CHDC Congo ghi nhận trên 300 trẻ em tử vong do dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo records more than 300 children who have died from Ebola virus disease.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports over 300 child deaths from Ebola in the eastern outbreak, with Ituri Province hardest hit amid 1 million people displaced by conflict; women and children comprise about 80% of the displaced. UNICEF data show since mid-May the outbreak has caused more than 300 child deaths, about one-quarter of infections but nearly one-third of fatalities. The UN warns essential health services are severely disrupted, with health service use in affected areas down over 40% as people fear visiting facilities. UNFPA notes maternal mortality in Ituri has nearly doubled since the outbreak began, averaging six deaths per week; pregnant women with Ebola face miscarriage risk. 13,000 community health workers have reached over 2.4 million people with prevention messages and conducted 500,000+ household visits. WHO on Aug 7 proposed randomized Ervebo trials against Bundibugyo virus for potential cross-protection; Ervebo remains the only approved vaccine for Zaire ebolavirus.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ流行により300人以上の子供が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、大規模な子供の死亡・医療体制の崩壊・避難民増加など重大な公衆衛生危機が継続しているため。
triage.notes: 紛争による大規模避難民（100万人）と医療サービス利用40%減少が流行拡大の主要因。WHOはBundibugyoウイルスに対するErvebo交差防御試験を提案しており、亜種の可能性にも留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Kisangani : l'identification précoce des alertes sanitaires recommandée aux infirmiers - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kisangani: Early Identification of Health Alerts Recommended for Nurses - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Kisangani, Democratic Republic of Congo. On August 8, 2026, health workers in Kisangani (Tshopo Province, northeastern DRC) were urged to identify early alerts and triage patients at entry to health facilities to curb Ebola transmission. Temperature checks and rapid alert identification should be used, with alerts reported both in healthcare settings and communities. Nurses, who account for about 80% of frontline providers, are central to prevention and must disseminate messages about Ebola risks and protective behaviors in neighborhoods and homes. Facilities must be equipped with handwashing stations, disinfectants, and sufficient personal protective equipment to safeguard staff, patients, companions, and visitors. The provincial health division should bolster nurses' outreach, official communication, handwashing installation at strategic points, and safe disinfection practices. Measures were planned even before case confirmation in Kisangani, emphasizing prevention and health promotion.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニでのエボラ出血熱：看護師に対し健康警戒の早期識別が推奨される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR上常に通報対象となる高リスク疾患であり、DRC北東部での予防的対応強化が報じられていることから、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は症例確定前の予防的対応を報じており、キサンガニでの確定症例の有無は不明。エボラという疾患特性上、IHR基準を満たすためPICKUPと判定。続報でケース確定状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : la société civile déplore les risques liés au transport d'échantillons vers Komanda - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Civil society deplores the risks associated with transporting samples to Komanda - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: Ituri province civil society decries logistics hurdles in transporting Ebola samples from Mambasa and Mandima health zones to the Komanda laboratory for analysis. As of 8 August 2026, SOCICO/Mambasa coordinator Marie-Noëlle Anotane cites fuel shortages, limited mobility, and costs forcing reliance on public transport, which heightens Ebola transmission risk due to crowding and lack of distancing. Such transport issues threaten rapid laboratory confirmation and delay outbreak response interventions. The coordinator urges health authorities and response partners to bolster secure, rapid sample transport logistics to ensure effective patient management and to limit the spread of Ebola in Mambasa, Mandima, and surrounding areas.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：市民社会がコマンダへの検体輸送に伴うリスクを非難 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにおいて、検体輸送の遅延がヒト-ヒト感染拡大や対応遅延のリスクを高めており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はマンバサ・マンディマ保健地区からコマンダ検査室への検体輸送における燃料不足・公共交通機関依存等のロジスティクス課題を指摘しており、これが感染拡大や診断・対応の遅延リスクを高めている。エボラ出血熱は既知の重大感染症であり、既存アウトブレイクの継続・悪化を示す情報として重要視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Over 100 fall ill with Hepatitis A in Sirsa village; two girls on ventilator
article.articleSummary: Over 100 people, mostly children and young adults, have fallen ill with Hepatitis A in Desujodha village, Sirsa district, Haryana, after suspected contaminated drinking water from the village waterworks following leakage in newly laid pipelines. Two girls—21-year-old Prabhjot (AIIMS Bathinda) and 18-year-old Preet Kaur (DMC Ludhiana)—are on ventilators in critical condition. Others with Hepatitis A are admitted in Sirsa, Dabwali, Bathinda, Ludhiana and Rama Mandi. Health officials collected samples from 540 residents in five days; 216 suspected cases, 45 hospitalised. Of the admitted, two are under five, 26 up to 18, and 17 up to 60; 30 men and 15 women. A district team assures clean water, strengthened health services, and coverage of treatment costs. Four doctors and staff deployed; ambulance stationed; door-to-door checks and a testing camp underway. Boil water and maintain hygiene; pipeline replacement expected within 10 days.

triage.headline_ja: シルサ村でA型肝炎により100人以上が発症、少女2人が人工呼吸器を装着
triage.triage_reason: 水道管漏水による汚染水を原因とするA型肝炎集団感染で、100人以上が発症、45人が入院、2人が重篤化しており、住民の継続的曝露リスクと社会的関心の高さからフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 地方自治体（district team）が独自に対応しており、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限の兆候はない。汚染水源（新設パイプライン漏水）の修復完了（10日以内予定）まで曝露継続の可能性があり、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Butembo : une infirmière et un bébé de 8 mois parmi les nouveaux guéris d'Ebola au CTE de Katwa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Butembo: a nurse and an eight-month-old baby among the newly recovered from Ebola at the Katwa Ebola Treatment Center.
article.articleSummary: Butembo in North Kivu remains the epicenter of the 17th Ebola outbreak in the region (Bundibugyo strain). At Katwa Ebola Treatment Center, two more recoveries were recorded on August 7, 2026—a nurse and an eight‑month‑old baby—following treatment; four earlier recoveries were noted on August 2, including two healthcare workers. As of July 27, 2026, Butembo reported 220 confirmed cases out of 325 in the province. Since August 4, Lubero health zone has confirmed cases, becoming the third zone after Musienene and Masereka. By August 5, 2026, 77% of contacts were being followed. Two new treatment centers are under construction in Musienene and Beni; another center is planned in Tshopo with large capacity. Across five provinces, total cases reach 4,053 with 1,850 deaths and 793 recoveries, including 17 new recoveries. Authorities urge rapid health facility consultation for fever, vomiting, or diarrhea and reinforce prevention measures.

triage.headline_ja: ブテンボ:カトワ・エボラ治療センターで看護師と生後8か月の乳児がエボラから新たに回復
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中の第17次エボラ流行（5州で4,053症例、1,850死亡）に関する継続的な公衆衛生上重大な事案であり、新たな保健区域（Lubero）への拡大も確認されているためフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 既知の大規模流行（第17次エボラアウトブレイク）の継続報道。新規保健区域（Lubero）への拡大と致死率の高さ（約45.6%）が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Kwilu - Choléra : près de 420 cas dont 30 décès enregistrés dans 4 zones de santé
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kwilu – Cholera: nearly 420 cases, including 30 deaths recorded in four health zones.
article.articleSummary: As of August 8, 2026, cholera continues to affect Kwilu Province, with four health zones now affected. Since the start of June, 419 cholera cases have been reported, including 30 deaths. Bandundu Zone totals 212 cases and 14 deaths, with more than 198 recoveries. Kikongo reports 166 cases and 8 deaths, with over 100 recoveries; no new cases currently. Mokala and Ipamu remain active, with ongoing containment efforts. The principal transmission driver is consumption of non-potable water from the Kasaï River. Water chlorination is among the key interventions, carried out in Mokala's Piopio and Panu, and in Ipamu's Kinkole. The response is supported by both the national and Kwilu provincial governments, including water treatment inputs, personal protective equipment for health workers, and disinfection supplies for affected sites. The outbreak persists in Mokala and Ipamu.

triage.headline_ja: クワイル州 - コレラ：4つの保健地域で約420例、うち30人死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCクワイル州で6月以降419例・30人死亡（致死率約7%）のコレラ流行が4保健地域に拡大し継続中であり、重症度・持続的曝露・流行しやすさの観点からフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域にニュージーランド（Waikato等）が含まれているが、記事本文はDRCクワイル州のコレラ流行のみを扱っており、ニュージーランドは無関係（Bluedotの地域付与誤り）として除外した。致死率が約7%と高く、水系感染（カサイ川の非浄水利用）が主因で継続中の点に注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Saharsa Food Poisoning|100+ Fall Sick After Eating Puja Prasad|Vomiting-Diarrhea|Bihar Village | पूजा का प्रसाद खाते ही मच गया हाहाकार, 100 से ज्यादा लोग पड़े बीमार, उल्टी-दस्त से पूरे गांव में दहश
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Saharsa Food Poisoning | 100+ Fall Sick After Eating Puja Prasad | Vomiting-Diarrhea | A Village in Bihar | Chaos erupted after consuming Puja Prasad; more than 100 people fell ill, vomiting and diarrhea across the village.
article.articleSummary: Food poisoning outbreak in Sardha village, Simri Bakhtiyarpur block, Saharsa district, Bihar, after a Satyanarayan Puja Prasad. Over 100 villagers fell ill with vomiting and diarrhea beginning Friday morning following the Prasad distribution after Thursday’s worship. Patients span children to elders; rapid dehydration raised concern. An emergency medical team from Simri Bakhtiyarapur Sub-District Hospital set up a camp in Sardha, treating people with medicines and ORS; several patients were moved to private clinics or hospitals. Health officials monitor the situation; home-to-home checks continue and stocks of medicines remain adequate. Preliminary investigations point to food poisoning, with investigators examining whether the Prasad ingredients or contaminated water were the source. Laboratory confirmation has not yet been reported; authorities say the situation is currently under control.

triage.headline_ja: サハルサ食中毒｜プージャ・プラサード摂取後100人以上が発症｜嘔吐・下痢｜ビハール州の村
triage.triage_reason: 単発の食中毒事案であり、病原体不明ながら国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められず、既に医療対応が行われ状況は制御下にある。
triage.notes: 食中毒はプラサード（供物食品）や汚染水が原因と推定されており、感染症のヒト-ヒト感染の可能性は低い。ラボ確認は未報告。

article.articleHeadline: Avika Gor Hospitalised For Dengue, Husband Milind Shares New Update On Her Health, 'Not Improving..'
article.articleSummary: TV actress Avika Gor was hospitalised in Mumbai on August 6, 2026 after being diagnosed with dengue. On August 7, doctors advised 15 days of bed rest; her blood platelet count had fallen but is now improving, though she continues to experience significant body pain. Milind Chandwani stated she had a 103–104°F fever for five days yet still completed a pending shoot before admission. Gor, known for Balika Vadhu and Sasural Simar Ka, is currently part of Khatron Ke Khiladi 15.

triage.headline_ja: アヴィカ・ゴールがデング熱で入院、夫ミリンドが健康状態について新たな更新を発表『改善していない…』
triage.triage_reason: 有名人個人の一症例報道であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクを示す情報がないため。
triage.notes: デング熱自体はインドで流行が見られる疾患だが、本記事は著名人個人の症例に関するゴシップ記事であり、公衆衛生イベントとしての情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Hepatitis A outbreak leaves over 100 ill in Haryana village
article.articleSummary: Desujodha village in Haryana's Sirsa district reports a Hepatitis A outbreak with over 100 ill, mostly children and young adults. Contaminated drinking water is suspected after leaks in newly installed pipelines, with a pipeline replacement underway. Two young women are in critical condition—Prabhjot, 21, on a ventilator at AIIMS Bathinda, and Preet Kaur, 18, on a ventilator at DMC Ludhiana. Other patients are treated in Sirsa, Dabwali, Bathinda, Ludhiana and Rama Mandi. Over the past week, symptoms rose; Hepatitis A was confirmed among several patients. The health department sampled 540 residents; 216 suspected cases and 45 hospitalised. Residents protested for safe drinking water and action on the leaks.

triage.headline_ja: ハリヤナ州の村でA型肝炎の集団発生、100人以上が感染
triage.triage_reason: 汚染された飲料水を原因とするA型肝炎の集団発生で、216人の疑い例・45人入院・重症2名を含む規模であり、住民の抗議など社会的関心も高いため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 水道管の漏水による飲料水汚染が原因とされ、パイプライン交換が進行中。住民は安全な飲料水を求めて抗議している。国際的拡大リスクは低いが、地域内での感染拡大・重症化が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Quão perigoso é o sarampo? Sintomas para ficar de olho e como se proteger
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How dangerous is measles? Symptoms to watch for and how to protect yourself.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak prompts Brazil to expand vaccination in São Paulo, Guarulhos and São Bernardo do Campo for ages 6 months to 59 years, including those already vaccinated. A temporary dose zero for children 6–11 months is part of the August 2026 Multivaccination Campaign. By end-July 2026, Brazil reported 17 confirmed measles cases nationwide, with transmission linked to virus importation in the three cities. Measles is described as highly contagious, with renewed activity in the European Union (over 130,000 cases since 2024) and a resurgence in the United States, where the virus was eliminated in 2000, driven in part by vaccine hesitancy and low vaccination coverage. The article invites readers to learn about spread, symptoms, and protection.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹はどれほど危険か？注意すべき症状と予防法
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で輸入例に由来する麻疹アウトブレイクが確認され（7月末時点で17例）、政府が対象年齢を広げた緊急ワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施しており、感染拡大の可能性がある。
triage.notes: 米国・EUの麻疹再興状況は文脈説明として言及されているのみで、記事の主題はブラジル国内（サンパウロ州、グアルーリョス市等）の輸入例由来アウトブレイクとそれに対するワクチン接種拡大策である。

article.articleHeadline: Melanistic tigress dies of rare infection in Similipal's core area
article.articleSummary: On 6 August 2026, in the UBK (Upper Barakamada) deep core of Similipal Tiger Reserve, Odisha, a 5-year-old melanistic tigress died. Post-mortem identified babesiosis, a tick-borne parasite, with heavy tick infestation on the coat; snake bite is not ruled out. Autopsy noted recumbency, blood-tinged mucus at the nostrils, pale oral mucosa, gum hemorrhages, and hemorrhagic tracheal endothelium, with semisolid tracheal/oesophageal contents. NTCA-standard procedures were followed; samples were sent to the Centre for Wildlife Health at OUAT for comprehensive toxicological and pathological tests, including canine distemper, to determine the cause. The carcass was incinerated in the presence of the reserve’s field director. Similipal, described as the world’s largest habitat of melanistic tigers, currently has 12 melanistic tigers remaining (down from prior counts including a 2023 male death and a 2024 normal-colored cat death). In May, a melanistic tiger skin was seized from poachers nearby.

triage.headline_ja: シミリパルのコアエリアで黒色型トラがまれな感染症により死亡
triage.triage_reason: 野生のトラ1頭がダニ媒介性のバベシア症で死亡した事例であり、ヒトへの感染や公衆衛生上の影響を示す情報がなく、社会的関心やスクリーニング基準の該当も乏しい。
triage.notes: 本事例は野生動物（トラ）1頭の死亡であり、ヒト感染症の公衆衛生イベントではない。バベシア症はヒトにも感染しうるが、本記事はヒト感染や集団発生を示唆していない。

article.articleHeadline: Hyderabad: Minister Ponnam launches GHMC IEC initiatives on dengue, dog bite awareness
article.articleSummary: Hyderabad, Aug 8, 2026 — Telangana Transport and BC Welfare Minister Ponnam Prabhakar launched four GHMC Metropolitan Surveillance Unit (MSU) IEC initiatives to strengthen dengue prevention, mosquito control, dog-bite awareness, and disease reporting. The four initiatives are Dengue Prevention, Friday Dry Day, IDSP Community Reporting QR Code, and Dog Bite Awareness, unveiled at an Hyderabad awareness programme attended by GHMC Chief Medical Officer of Health Amar Singh Nayak, MSU officials, Assistant Medical Officers of Health and Entomology staff. Demonstrations of mosquito surveillance and control were shown. Prabhakar urged active citizen participation, advocating keeping homes and surroundings clean and eliminating stagnant water, and to observe Friday Dry Day weekly to remove breeding sources. GHMC Commissioner R. V. Karnan directed the Health Wing and Entomology staff to intensify field activities, reinforcing that disease prevention starts at the household level with sustained community-government collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: ハイデラバード:ポナム大臣、デング熱・犬咬傷啓発のGHMC IEC活動を開始
triage.triage_reason: デング熱予防のための行政広報・啓発活動に関する記事であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節的なデング熱予防のための行政広報・啓発キャンペーンについてのもので、具体的な感染者数や異常な流行状況の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Memperkuat Upaya Pencegahan dan Penanggulangan Penularan TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Strengthening Efforts to Prevent and Control TB Transmission.
article.articleSummary: West Sulawesi Province’s Health, Population and Family Planning Office (P2KB) and the West Sulawesi Police (Polda Sulbar) jointly conducted an assistive session with the Forum for Police–Community Partnerships (FKPM) to strengthen tuberculosis (TB) prevention and transmission control in Mamuju, Sulawesi Barat. Health chief Nursyamsi Rahim framed TB as a social challenge requiring broad community involvement; the pentahelix approach places security as a strategic partner in public health. The Garatta TBC initiative integrates government, health workers, police, village authorities, health volunteers, and communities to accelerate TB elimination in Sulbar. Police’s Dirbinmas officer Prasetya Sejati emphasized enhanced Bhabinkamtibmas capacity to improve health information flow and village-level support. TB program manager Harsalim stressed that success depends on at least six months of patient adherence, with two months for rapid bacterial kill and four months to prevent relapse and resistance; stopping early raises transmission and drug-resistant TB risks.

triage.headline_ja: 結核（TBC）感染防止・対策の取り組みを強化
triage.triage_reason: 既存の結核対策プログラムに関する通常の広報・啓発活動であり、異常性や新規性、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 地方保健当局と警察が連携した結核対策プログラム（Garatta TBC）の啓発活動に関する記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常事象の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية توصي باختبار لقاح "إرفيبو" ضد "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization recommends testing the Ervebo vaccine against Ebola
article.articleSummary: On 8 August 2026, the World Health Organization's technical advisory group recommended prioritizing Ervebo, the only licensed Ebola Zaire vaccine, for inclusion in a randomized clinical trial as part of the response to a Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Preliminary animal data show cross-protection by Ervebo, but its efficacy against Bundibugyo virus remains to be demonstrated. The organization notes that vaccinating contacts of infected individuals does not raise safety concerns. A vaccine specifically developed for Bundibugyo ebolavirus remains the preferred long-term option. The recommendation aims to assess whether Ervebo could contribute to outbreak control while ongoing development of a targeted vaccine continues.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、エボラウイルスに対する「エルベボ」ワクチンの試験実施を推奨
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国におけるブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス病アウトブレイクへの対応として、WHOがワクチン臨床試験を推奨。エボラは重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによるDRCでのアウトブレイクに関するWHO対応の記事。既存の承認ワクチン（エルベボ）の有効性が未確認であり、専用ワクチン開発が長期的な優先事項とされている。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: BMC Worker Dies After Falling During Dengue Inspection At BDD Chawl In Naigaon
article.articleSummary: 47-year-old BMC Pest Control Department worker Pandurang Todkar died after falling 5–7 feet while inspecting a water tank at BDD Chawl No. 6-A, Naigaon, Mumbai. He slipped during routine dengue/malaria control inspections; a metal rod reportedly struck his eye, leading to critical injuries. He was taken to KEM Hospital, where doctors performed CPR; he was declared dead on arrival around 2:55 pm. Todkar, a labourer with F/South ward, was part of intensified inspections of water tanks amid rising dengue and malaria cases. He was the sole breadwinner, leaving a wife and two sons, including 17-year-old Sairaj. Mumbai Mayor Ritu Tawde visited the hospital, promising pensionary benefits and a municipal job for eligible dependents. A day earlier, another BMC worker, 56, was fatally run over by a bus in Mulund West.

triage.headline_ja: ナイガオンのBDDチャウルでデング熱調査中に転落したBMC職員が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング・マラリア対策要員の労災死亡事故が主題であり、感染症の異常発生や公衆衛生上のリスクを示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング・マラリア対策の点検作業中の労災死亡事故であり、感染症の流行状況自体についての情報はない。'rising dengue and malaria cases'との言及はあるが具体的な症例数や公衆衛生上の影響の記述がなく、感染症シグナルとしての評価材料は不足している。

article.articleHeadline: De epidemie in Congo is snelst groeiende ebola-uitbraak ooit: al meer dan 1800 mensen overleden
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The epidemic in Congo is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak ever: more than 1,800 people have died.
article.articleSummary: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the fastest-growing on record, with over 1,800 deaths and nearly 4,000 confirmed cases since late April. Mortality among confirmed cases exceeds 45%, up from about 30% in late June, and officials warn the real caseload is higher as more than 70% of deceased patients die at home. Contact tracing at treatment sites detects only about 10% of infections. Uganda experienced early spread but was declared Ebola-free by the end of July. Factors driving spread include late hospital presentation and distrust, with violence around centers and restricted funerals hampering containment. No vaccine exists for the Bundibugyo variant; Zaïre Ebola vaccines are available. Moderna has started a Phase 1 trial in Canada for the current variant (80 volunteers), with plans to supply over 0.5 million doses to poorer countries, including Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行は史上最速の拡大、死者はすでに1800人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最速拡大とされるエボラ流行が発生し、致死率45%超・約4000症例・1800人超の死亡と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは既に7月末にエボラ終息宣言済みのため対象外。カナダはワクチン治験実施国であり流行地ではないため除外。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれず、DRCのみを検証対象とした。

article.articleHeadline: Эбола: эксперты ВОЗ рекомендовали начать испытания вакцины "Эрвебо" в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO experts recommended starting trials of the Ervebo vaccine in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: On 7 August 2026, WHO's Technical Advisory Group on Immunization, Vaccines and Biologicals published a report recommending Ervebo, the only registered Ebola vaccine (against Zaire ebolavirus), be prioritized for inclusion in randomized clinical trials in the Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for Bundibugyo on May 16. Previous guidance advised against using Ervebo outside rigorously planned protocols. At their third meeting, experts reviewed animal data suggesting cross-protection and reduced mortality risk against Bundibugyo. They concluded vaccinating contacts with Ervebo within trial settings is safe, but effectiveness against Bundibugyo disease and transmission remains unproven. A strain-specific vaccine would be preferred once data are available; production and access must be scaled up then.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHO専門家がコンゴ民主共和国で「エルベボ」ワクチンの臨床試験開始を推奨
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生しているBundibugyoエボラウイルスによるアウトブレイクは既にWHOによりPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として宣言されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当するため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 既にWHOによりBundibugyoエボラウイルスに対しPHEICが宣言されている（2026年5月16日）。本記事はワクチン試験に関する最新の専門家勧告についてのもので、既存のPHEIC事案の続報として扱うべき。フルRRAでは既存のリスク評価との統合を検討する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Главные новости дня | пятница: Украина, Газа, Эбола, цены на продовольствие
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Top News of the Day | Friday: Ukraine, Gaza, Ebola, Food Prices
article.articleSummary: As of 8 August 2026, the United Nations reports ongoing civilian casualties in Ukraine from attacks, including the destruction of a Save the Children office in Sumy and injuries to staff assisting with migration services in the Kherson region, while humanitarian operations continue amid risk. In Gaza, July aid deliveries rose 33% from June, but imports of machine oil, spare parts for transport and generators, and building materials remain restricted, hampering relief efforts; satellite data show a 9% increase in destroyed buildings since the ceasefire declared in October. Health updates: WHO's Technical Advisory Group recommended prioritizing Ervebo in clinical trials for the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; Ervebo is the only registered Ebola vaccine, effective against the Ebola Zaire strain, but its effectiveness against Bundibugyo strain has not yet been proven. Global food prices rose in July per FAO, driven by heat, energy costs, and geopolitical tensions.

triage.headline_ja: 本日の主なニュース｜金曜日：ウクライナ、ガザ、エボラ、食料価格
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関するWHO技術諮問グループのワクチン優先使用勧告が言及されているが、症例数・死亡者数など具体的な疫学情報が記事に含まれておらず、既知のアウトブレイクの続報にとどまるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はウクライナ・ガザ・エボラ・食料価格を扱う総合ニュースまとめであり、エボラに関する記述はDRCでのアウトブレイクに対するWHOのワクチン（Ervebo）優先使用勧告に限定される。Bundibugyo株への有効性は未実証と記載。ウクライナ・ガザは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: जमशेदपुर में डेंगू का पहला केस: TMH नर्सिंग हॉस्टल की युवती एलाइजा जांच में पाई गई पॉजिटिव - jamshedpur dengue first case confirmed at tmh nursing hostel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First dengue case in Jamshedpur: Young woman at TMH Nursing Hostel tests positive on ELISA.
article.articleSummary: First dengue case in Jamshedpur this year, confirmed by ELISA in a 28-year-old resident of the Tata Main Hospital (TMH) Nursing Hostel in Bistupur. The patient presented with high fever, headache and body pains; after standard medicines failed, she was hospitalized. ELISA testing at MGM Medical College confirmed dengue; she is being treated at TMH and is stable. In response, the district health department launched intensified surveillance and vector control around the affected area: anti-larvae spraying and dense fogging within a 500-meter radius of the hostel. Isolation beds have been reserved in Sadar Hospital and other major facilities for dengue-suspected patients, and clinicians are urged to promptly test fever cases. Public advisories emphasize avoiding water stagnation to prevent transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ジャムシェドプルで今年初のデング熱患者確認：TMH看護学生宿舎の女性がELISA検査で陽性
triage.triage_reason: 今年最初の単発デング症例であり、通常の季節性感染症対応の範囲内で、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 地元保健当局が迅速に媒介動物対策（防蚊・消毒）と隔離病床確保を実施しており、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内。単発症例のため経過観察の必要性も低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Mambasa : l'épidémie progresse dans quatre zones de santé - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Mambasa: the outbreak is spreading in four health zones - ACP.
article.articleSummary: On 8 August 2026, in Ituri province's Mambasa territory, four health zones report confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, signaling outbreak spread. Nia-Nia health zone remains epicenter with 119 confirmed cases; Mambasa zone has 13 cases and 11 deaths; Mandima zone has 18 confirmed cases; Lolwa zone 10 confirmed cases. Two confirmed cases have been identified among the pygmy community in Lolwa. Civil society group SOCICO urged urgent strengthening of epidemiological surveillance, community sensitization, and patient care across the affected zones to curb wider transmission. Marie-Noëlle Anotane, SOCICO coordinator, called on health authorities and partners to pay particular attention to the remote Lolwa, Mandima, and Nia-Nia areas, bolstering logistics and response mechanisms for the exposed populations.

triage.headline_ja: マンバサでのエボラ:流行は4つの保健地域に拡大している - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がイトゥリ州マンバサ地域内の4つの保健地域に拡大しており、確認症例160件以上・死亡例を伴う深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念があり、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラ流行はDRCイトゥリ州マンバサ準州内で拡大しており、遠隔地（ロルワ、マンディマ、ニアニア）やピグミー族コミュニティへの感染拡大も報告されている。市民社会団体が監視体制・患者ケアの強化を要請しており、既知の進行中アウトブレイクの悪化事例としてフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Chandipura Virus Alert: बच्चों में तेजी से फैल रहा चांदीपुरा वायरस, जानें लक्षण, बचाव और संक्रमण होते ही क्या करें?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chandipura Virus Alert: Chandipura virus is spreading rapidly among children; learn the symptoms, prevention, and what to do as soon as infection occurs?
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus, an RNA virus of the Rhabdoviridae family first identified in Chandipura village, Nagpur district, Maharashtra in 1965, is driving a pediatric outbreak in India. In Gujarat, about 22 children have died; Rajasthan and other states are under investigation for suspected cases. The virus primarily affects children under 15; transmission occurs through bites of sandflies, not via direct person-to-person contact. Early symptoms mimic viral fever, but progression can cause high fever, headache, vomiting, weakness, seizures, drowsiness, confusion, neck or body stiffness, and encephalitis. No vaccine or specific antiviral exists; treatment is supportive, with close monitoring of respiration, blood pressure, and neurological status. Prevention focuses on sandfly avoidance: insect nets, repellents, full-sleeved clothing, cleanliness to reduce breeding sites, and eliminating garbage and standing water. If rapid deterioration or neurological signs appear, seek immediate hospital care.

triage.headline_ja: チャンディプラウイルス警報：子どもたちの間で急速に拡大するチャンディプラウイルス、症状・予防・感染時の対処法を知る
triage.triage_reason: グジャラート州で22人の小児が死亡するなど重篤な脳炎症例が発生しており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性）を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: サンドフライ媒介のチャンディプラウイルスによる小児脳炎アウトブレイク。グジャラート州で22人死亡、ラジャスタン州等で疑い例調査中。ワクチン・特効薬なし、対症療法のみ。

article.articleHeadline: Chandipura Virus Gujarat: 39 Cases, 23 Deaths
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus outbreak in Gujarat as of 8 Aug 2026 shows 217 suspected cases since 30 June, with 39 laboratory-confirmed infections and 23 deaths. The outbreak began in Panchmahal district, where two young children from Godhra taluka died earlier; authorities intensified door-to-door surveillance and insecticide spraying. Of 217 samples tested, 208 have results; nine pending. On 14 July, 27 suspected, 7 positive, 12 negative, eight pending; three positive children among deaths. Chandipura virus is transmitted by sandflies and causes acute encephalitis syndrome, primarily in children; rapid progression makes early recognition and treatment crucial. Health authorities continue surveillance and laboratory testing to track spread across Gujarat; earlier briefing noted 184 suspected, 35 confirmed, and 22 deaths, with the latest figures showing increases in suspected and lab-confirmed cases and one additional death as pending results resolve.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州のチャンディプラウイルス：感染確定39例、死亡23例
triage.triage_reason: インド・グジャラート州でチャンディプラウイルス感染症が拡大しており、疑い217例・確定39例に対し死亡23例と致死率が高く、小児を中心に急速進行する脳炎症候群であるため、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を満たしフルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスはサシチョウバエ媒介性で、グジャラート州で毎年季節性に発生するが、今回は疑い例・確定例・死亡数が増加傾向にあり注視が必要。ヒト-ヒト感染の報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Bundibugyo: la RDC se prépare à élargir l'utilisation du vaccin Ervebo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bundibugyo Ebola virus: the DRC is preparing to broaden the use of the Ervebo vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to expand, with authorities planning to broaden Ervebo vaccination beyond Ebola Zaïre protection to Ituri and North Kivu. Observations indicate prior Zaïre vaccination may offer partial protection against Bundibugyo, especially against lethal forms, but human efficacy against Bundibugyo is not yet proven. Rapid cross-protection trials are planned within weeks: a small cohort study in about two weeks, followed by larger phase 3 trials during the outbreak to confirm real-world efficacy. WHO's SAGE recommended prioritizing Ervebo for phase 3 in the absence of a Bundibugyo-specific vaccine. INRB head Jean-Jacques Muyembe proposes a “vaccine shield” around at-risk areas, prioritizing Tshopo and Haut-Uélé, as a preventive public health measure alongside ring vaccination around cases. Vaccination logistics include ~2,000 doses in DRC; ~500,000 doses in global stock; ~$98 per dose; Gavi pledging ~$40 million to enable access; longer-term African production discussions with MSD.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国、エルベボ・ワクチンの使用拡大を準備
triage.triage_reason: DRCでブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱の流行が拡大中であり、既存ワクチンの有効性が未確立という異常性、国際的支援（Gavi資金拠出、WHO SAGE関与）の必要性からPICKUPと判断。
triage.notes: Ituri・TshopoはいずれもDRC国内の州であるため、verified_locationsは国単位でDRCのみを記載。ブンディブギョ型はザイール型と異なる株であり、既存ワクチン(Ervebo)のヒトにおける有効性は未証明。フェーズ3試験計画中。
