article.articleHeadline: Ebola Bundibugyo: la RDC se prépare à élargir l'utilisation du vaccin Ervebo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bundibugyo Ebola: the DRC is preparing to expand the use of the Ervebo vaccine.
article.articleSummary: DRC authorities plan to expand Ervebo use to Ituri and North Kivu amid the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak. Observations suggest prior Ebola Zaire vaccination may offer some protection against Bundibugyo, though human efficacy is unproven; new trials will assess this. An Ervebo cross-protection study could start in 2–3 weeks, with a small cohort in about two weeks and larger phase-3 work to follow, after a July 31 WHO recommendation prioritizing Ervebo given lack of Bundibugyo-specific vaccines. INRB director Muyembe proposes a 'vaccination shield' around high-risk zones, vaccinating populations in Tshopo and Haut-Uélé to pre-empt spread, alongside ring vaccination. DRC has about 2,000 doses; global stock holds ~500,000 doses; Gavi pledges $40 million; price around $98 per dose. Two Bundibugyo vaccines are in early phase-1 trials in the UK and Canada, but Ervebo offers immediate utility due to existing safety data and supply.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョ・エボラ:コンゴ民主共和国がエルベボワクチンの使用拡大を準備
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクが拡大しており、複数州へのワクチン接種拡大やWHO勧告など公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念があるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 英国・カナダはブンディブギョ株ワクチンの臨床試験実施国であり、実際のアウトブレイク発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo continues to spread at an 'alarming and unprecedented rate'
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-08, the Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread at an alarming and unprecedented rate, with the latest numbers reported from DR Congo. MSF, the WHO, and Africa CDC express concerns about the outbreak's trajectory and potential for further spread. The report notes that some suspected cases near Kinshasa, the capital, tested negative, offering some good news amid the rise in cases. Outbreak News TV's video includes updates along with interview material and analysis on health and disease. The piece underscores the urgency of surveillance, containment efforts, and international concerns from major health organizations as the Bundibugyo outbreak evolves in DR Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、『驚異的かつ前例のない速度』で拡大継続
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がコンゴ民主共和国で首都キンシャサ近郊にまで拡大し、WHO・MSF・Africa CDCが懸念を表明していることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 首都キンシャサ近郊で疑い例が報告されたが陰性であったとの情報あり。感染拡大の地理的範囲・具体的症例数・渡航制限の有無については記事本文が提供されておらずサマリーのみのため、続報での詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Vacina do sarampo: filas passam de uma hora com novos casos em SP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles vaccine: queues exceed one hour with new cases in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases rise in São Paulo state, with 23 confirmed and seven new cases in the capital this week. In response, the city launched a vaccination campaign for people aged 6 months to 59 years across all Basic Health Units (UBSs) and AMAs/Integrated UBSs. The De Olho na Fila site tracks vaccination sites, dose availability, and queue lengths. Reporters observed long waits, with many units exceeding one hour; at the Dr. Italo Domingos Le Vossi clinic in Mooca (Zona Leste), five people were served in about six minutes each after a 32-minute queue for five. Residents described delays as a barrier to vaccination, urging more staff and extended hours, especially around lunch. Measles is highly contagious and airborne, risking pneumonia or ear infections in children. Vaccination includes dose zero (6–11 months), 1st dose at 12 months, and 2nd dose at 15 months; under-two prioritization persists, though waits remain lengthy.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹ワクチン接種:サンパウロで新規症例増加により1時間超の行列
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州・市で麻疹症例が増加し、ワクチン接種会場に長い行列ができるなど市民の関心が高まっており、ヒト-ヒト感染力の強さと曝露継続のリスクがあるためフルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 報道はサンパウロ市・州内の麻疹症例増加とワクチン接種の混雑に焦点を当てており、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は見られない。感染力の高さとワクチン接種率不足による今後の拡大可能性は注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Paulistanos enfrentam filas para tomar vacina contra sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo residents stand in line to receive the measles vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Measles vaccination drive in São Paulo on 8 August 2026 drew long lines, with 57 of 62 open vaccination sites crowded around noon, according to De Olho Na Fila. Some posts showed medium or no queues, though data at two locations were outdated. At AMA UBS Integrada Água Rasa (East Zone), the queue extended outside and waiting times exceeded an hour. Ana Beatriz Chacur, 42, with 12-year-old twin daughters and husband, sought a booster after school guidance and social media alerts. Today, 62 of 512 posts were open; vaccination sites operate Monday through Friday. The East Zone had the most sites open (24), followed by South (17), North (16), West (5), Center (0). Health authorities reported 84,632 measles doses and 24,952 other vaccines—109,584 total—the largest daily total since mobilization began Aug 3, amid concern of an approaching outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ市民、はしかワクチン接種のため長蛇の列
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロではしかワクチン接種キャンペーンが大規模に行われており、アウトブレイク接近への懸念が示されているが、実際の症例数・重症度等の詳細情報が不足しているため継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン接種の混雑状況が中心で、実際の麻疹症例数・死亡者数・年齢分布などの疫学データが記載されていないため、フルRRAに進む前に続報を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: गुजरात में चांदीपुरा वायरस के मामले बढ़कर 39 हुए, मृतकों की संख्या हुई 23 | Gujarat: Chandipura virus cases rise to 39; death toll reaches 23
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gujarat: Chandipura virus cases rise to 39; death toll reaches 23.
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus outbreaks in Gujarat, India, continue to escalate. From June 30 to Aug 8, 2026, 217 suspected cases have been reported; 39 are laboratory-confirmed and 23 of the confirmed patients have died. Of the 217 samples, 208 have results while 9 await. Initial cases were in Panchmahal district, with two villages in Godhra taluka recording infections and fatalities among young children. After intensified surveillance, home surveys and widespread insecticide spraying were deployed, with hundreds of health teams testing residents and collecting samples. By mid-July, cases expanded to multiple districts beyond Panchmahal. The virus is primarily transmitted by sandflies and can cause acute encephalitis syndrome, especially in children, necessitating rapid identification and treatment. An August briefing reported 184 suspected, 35 confirmed, and 22 deaths; current figures show further increases, and authorities continue nationwide monitoring and testing, with nine lab reports pending to clarify additional confirmations.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州でチャンディプラウイルス感染例が39人に増加、死者数23人に達する
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いチャンディプラウイルス（脳炎症候群）の感染が拡大し、複数郡に広がりつつあり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常性が認められるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: サンドフライ媒介のチャンディプラウイルスによる急性脳炎症候群アウトブレイク。確定患者39人中23人（約59%）が死亡と致死率が高く、特に小児に影響。パンチマハル県ゴドラ郡で発生し、複数郡へ拡大中。今後の検査結果（9件保留）により数値がさらに増加する可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Katihar News: दूषित पेयजल से होने वाली बीमारियों से बच्चों को कराया गया अवगत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Katihar News: Children were informed about diseases caused by contaminated drinking water.
article.articleSummary: In Katihar district, Sameli, Morasanda Middle School hosted a Safe Saturday program led by Principal Barun Kumar Yadav to educate students about health risks from contaminated drinking water. The session emphasized the importance of safe and clean drinking water, warning that consuming contaminated water can cause diarrhea, typhoid, and other illnesses. Students were advised to ensure water cleanliness before drinking, keep home and school water sources clean, cover water containers, and, when needed, boil water or use approved purification methods. The program aimed to empower children with practical prevention measures against waterborne diseases and to promote safe water practices. The initiative also reinforces routine hygiene and safe drinking-water habits among students.

triage.headline_ja: カティハールニュース:汚染された飲料水による病気について子どもたちに啓発
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生報告ではなく、学校での衛生教育プログラムに関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際の腸チフス発生事例の報告ではなく、学校での予防啓発活動を伝えるものであるため、感染症イベントとしての実質的な情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: RF.5 Omicron variant linked to Covid in Pune
article.articleSummary: RF.5 Omicron sub-lineage linked to Covid infections in Pune, with wastewater data showing viral load rising from the first week of July. RF.5 identified in samples from Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra, Delhi, Karnataka, Uttarakhand, Chandigarh, Kerala, and Madhya Pradesh, while Omicron remains the dominant lineage and no evidence yet of altered virus behavior. National Institute of Virology report on detection has been submitted to the government. CSIR-NCL wastewater surveillance in Pune indicates early Covid activity; current sewage strain appears mild, with no current cause for concern. BJ Medical College is sequencing 24 samples (including wastewater) with results due in coming days to clarify circulating variants. Health department notes that Covid admissions have not increased significantly and current variants are not causing more severe illness.

triage.headline_ja: プネーでCOVID-19に関連するRF.5オミクロン変異株を確認
triage.triage_reason: 新たなオミクロン系統RF.5がインド複数州で検出されたが、重症化や感染力増強の証拠はなく、現時点で公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 新変異株RF.5は複数州の下水サーベイランスで検出されているが、感染性や重症度の変化は確認されておらず、入院増加も見られない。National Institute of Virologyやシークエンス結果待ちの段階。

article.articleHeadline: সমুদ্রের জলে 'মাংসখেকো' ব্যাকটেরিয়া, আমেরিকায় ৫ মৃত্যু, ভারতে কতটা বিপদ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seawater 'flesh-eating' bacteria: five deaths in America, how dangerous is it in India?
article.articleSummary: Vibrio vulnificus, a flesh-eating bacterium thriving in warm coastal and brackish seawater, is a growing concern in Louisiana, USA. In 2026, nine infections have been reported there, with five deaths. All patients had preexisting illnesses and wounds exposed to seawater, highlighting wound exposure as a major risk. Transmission can also occur through seafood, especially raw or undercooked shellfish. Louisiana health authorities have warned coastal residents as cases rise; Florida reported Vibrio infections in 2025, indicating regional activity. The bacterium has scientific evidence of presence in India, though human infections remain rare. Warmer waters drive seasonal increases, underscoring precautions for open wounds in the sea and for seafood handling.

triage.headline_ja: 海水中の「人食い」細菌、アメリカで5人死亡、インドではどれほど危険か？
triage.triage_reason: 主要な発生地は米国ルイジアナ州であり対象国リストに含まれない。インドについては細菌の存在が科学的に確認されているのみで、実際の感染例は「稀」とされ発生事実がないため対象外。
triage.notes: 米国内の環境曝露・創傷感染による散発事例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染はない。インドでの実際の感染事例は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: GHMC Launches IEC Drive to Combat Rainy Season Vector-Borne Diseases
article.articleSummary: Hyderabad, 8 August 2026 — GHMC commissioner R.V. Karnan directed health wing entomology staff to intensify field-level activities for prevention of vector-borne diseases during the rainy season. At the launch of awareness and information, education and communication (IEC) initiatives by the Metropolitan Surveillance Unit (MSU), the campaign emphasizes dengue prevention, a ‘Friday dry day,’ and the Integrated Disease Surveillance Project (IDSP). IDSP is an initiative of the National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC). Reports of dog bites, recurrent diarrhoea, jaundice, and other conditions can be submitted to NCDC via the QR code on the Health Ministry or NCDC website. Transport Minister Ponnam Prabhakar launched these initiatives and called for increased citizen participation.

triage.headline_ja: GHMC、雨季のベクター媒介疾患対策としてIECキャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: ハイデラバードにおけるデング熱予防のための通常の啓発活動・行政キャンペーンであり、異常な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 季節性のデング熱予防に関する行政の予防的広報活動であり、具体的な症例数や流行状況の記載はない。対象国リストにインドは含まれるが、本記事は日常的な公衆衛生キャンペーンでありシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Cachoeira da Prata reforça combate ao Aedes aegypti e orienta população sobre prevenção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cachoeira da Prata steps up the fight against Aedes aegypti and educates the public on prevention.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-08, Cachoeira da Prata is intensifying Aedes aegypti control to curb transmission of dengue, chikungunya and Zika. Key measures include targeted insecticide application in areas requiring intervention, as part of ongoing vector surveillance and prevention to protect community health. The campaign emphasizes that elimination of breeding sites also depends on residents' daily actions: keep water tanks and other containers tightly closed, remove items that collect standing water, and regularly inspect yards and home surroundings. The article underlines that combating arboviruses requires sustained vigilance and community cooperation, combining public authorities' interventions with simple everyday precautions to reduce risks and safeguard residents. No specific case data are reported in the article beyond the described control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: カショエイラ・ダ・プラタ、ネッタイシマカ対策を強化し住民に予防を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 特定の症例データはなく、通常の蚊媒介性感染症対策・啓発活動を報じる内容であり、異常性や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 地域の通常業務としての蚊媒介性感染症予防キャンペーンを報じる記事であり、具体的な症例数や異常な流行状況の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Paulistanos enfrentam filas para tomar vacina contra sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo residents face long lines to get a measles vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Measles vaccination drive in São Paulo, Brazil, on Saturday, August 8, 2026, saw long lines across the city. Of 62 vaccination sites open today, 57 had long queues around 1 p.m.; two posts showed medium queues, one small, and two listed as 'no queue' with outdated data. At AMA UBS Integrada Água Rasa (Tatuapé–Mooca area), the queue extended outside, with waits over an hour at noon. A family—Ana Beatriz Chacur, 42, with 12-year-old twin daughters and a 47-year-old husband—sought vaccination after learning of the need via social media and school, which requested a booster for eligible students. On Friday (7th), 84,632 measles doses and 24,952 other vaccines were administered, totaling 109,584—the highest daily total since mobilization began on August 3. Vaccination site distribution: East Zone 24 open sites, South 17, North 16, West 5, Center 0.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ市民、麻疹ワクチン接種のため長蛇の列に並ぶ
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なワクチン接種キャンペーンが実施されているが、実際の麻疹症例数・流行状況の詳細は記事に記載がなく情報不足のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は大規模ワクチン接種キャンペーンの様子を報じているが、麻疹の症例数や死亡者数など疫学的詳細が不明。感染拡大の背景にあるアウトブレイクの規模を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Swara Bhasker hospitalized after testing positive for dengue
article.articleSummary: Indian actress Swara Bhasker tested positive for dengue and was hospitalized in India. She informed fans via Instagram, posting a hospital photo and writing 'Dengue-fied and hospitalised!' but did not reveal her symptoms or how long she has been admitted. The report confirms a dengue diagnosis but provides no details on laboratory confirmation beyond the positive test or the infection source. Bhasker is known for appearing on the television reality show Pati Patni Aur Panga with her husband Fahad Ahmad, and she has not announced her next project. The article centers on a dengue case within the Indian entertainment sector, with no mention of fatalities or broader outbreak context.

triage.headline_ja: スワラ・バスカー、デング熱陽性で入院
triage.triage_reason: 著名人1名の個別デング熱感染事例に過ぎず、公衆衛生上の異常性や拡大リスクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 著名人の個人的な健康ニュースであり、インドにおけるデング熱流行状況の情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo Sparks Global Health Concerns
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 3,973 confirmed cases and nearly 1,800 deaths as of August 4, 2026, with a case fatality around 45%. Key symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle pain, headache, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhea, and, in some cases, bleeding. The World Health Organization and Africa CDC warn of sustained transmission and have prompted the U.S. CDC to extend a travel ban on foreign nationals who recently visited the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan through August 12, 2026. Overwhelmed health facilities, staff burnout, and community fear are hindering care-seeking. Urgent measures call for enhanced surveillance, contact tracing, testing, expanded treatment access, and deployment of more personnel, alongside addressing misinformation and mistrust. Incubation ranges from 2 to 21 days, most cases presenting within 8–10 days. WHO remains vigilant and emphasizes international cooperation to prevent cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが世界的な公衆衛生上の懸念を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行(症例3,973、致死率約45%)で持続的な人-人感染と国際的な渡航制限措置が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 米国、ウガンダ、南スーダンも発生地域として記載されているが、記事の主題はDRCでの流行であり、渡航禁止措置の対象地域として言及されているのみ。対象国リストにウガンダ・南スーダン・米国は含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Everything you need to know about Australia's bird flu surge
article.articleSummary: Australia has confirmed more than 100 cases of the H5N1 bird flu across five states, with the bulk in South Australia. Testing confirmed the first wildlife mass mortality on an island off SA’s southeast coast, identified as Heard Island, where baby seals were affected. A federal risk analysis found 386 native Australian bird and mammal species at high to extreme risk from H5N1. By early August there were 155 confirmed cases across five states; a national poultry biosecurity framework began July 31, with DAFF coordinating and states/territories handling surveillance and advice. Public participation is critical: avoid contact with affected wildlife and report sightings via hotline. Internationally, spread has affected Argentina, Chile, Peru, Uruguay and Brazil, with at least 30,000 sea lions infected and more than 17,000 southern elephant seals died in Argentina, highlighting conservation concerns.

triage.headline_ja: オーストラリアの鳥インフルエンザ急増について知っておくべきすべてのこと
triage.triage_reason: オーストラリア国内でH5N1が5州で100例超・在来種386種が高リスクとされる異常な野生動物流行であり、南米複数国（アルゼンチン、チリ、ペルー、ウルグアイ、ブラジル）にも拡大するなど国際的拡大がみられるためIHR基準2つ以上に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はオーストラリアにおけるH5N1の野生動物流行だが、オーストラリアは対象国リストに含まれない。記事内で南米諸国（アルゼンチン、チリ、ペルー、ウルグアイ、ブラジル）における実際の感染拡大（アシカ・アザラシの大量死等）が明記されているため、対象国リストに含まれるブラジルのみverified_locationsに計上した。ヒトへの感染事例については記事中に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ, Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'nde Ebola Aşısının Test Edilmesini Önerdi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO recommends testing of the Ebola vaccine in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO recommends prioritizing randomized testing of the Ebola vaccine Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as part of outbreak response. Ervebo is the only licensed Ebola vaccine; the WHO Technical Advisory Group notes early animal data suggest cross-protection, but human efficacy against Ebola virus disease has not yet been demonstrated. Vaccinating people who have contact with patients is deemed safe. In the long term, development of a virus-specific vaccine remains the preferred option. As of August 8, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is accelerating and exceeding current response capacity, with reported deaths surpassing 1,800. The statement emphasizes continued need for improved vaccines and rapid evaluation via randomized trials.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラワクチンの試験実施を推奨
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ流行が加速し死者数が1,800人を超え、現行の対応能力を超えているとされ、IHR基準の複数該当及び国際支援の必要性が示唆される。
triage.notes: 死者数1,800人超、対応能力超過との報告あり、フルRRAでの詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Épidémie d'Ebola : trois ambulances et 20 motos pour appuyer les équipes en Tshopo - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: three ambulances and 20 motorcycles to support the teams in Tshopo - LePotentiel
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak response in Tshopo Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, gains mobility as three ambulances and 20 motorcycles are allocated to intervention teams. Financed by the Congolese government and delivered by the National Public Health Institute (INSP) to the Provincial Health Division of Tshopo, the assets aim to enhance epidemiological surveillance and field operations. Motorcycles will improve access in hard-to-reach sectors, enabling alert investigations, case follow-up, and timely interventions. Ambulances strengthen medical transport for individuals requiring care. The initiative, part of the government's operational capacity reinforcement, seeks to bring health response closer to communities, reduce intervention delays, and support community engagement and awareness as part of the Ebola response. Beyond transport, the resources support proximity surveillance and outbreak-control activities to detect and limit virus spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行:チョポ州のチームを支援するため救急車3台とバイク20台が投入
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国チョポ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する記事であり、致死率の高い感染症の継続的な流行対応（サーベイランス強化・症例追跡）が確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事自体は物資支援に関する内容だが、チョポ州で進行中のエボラアウトブレイクの存在を裏付けるものであり、致死性の高い疾患であることからPICKUP判定とした。感染者数・死亡者数など具体的疫学情報は記事に含まれていないため、続報での詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Rio Branco está entre capitais com nível de alerta para casos de SRAG
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio Branco is among the capitals on alert for SARI cases.
article.articleSummary: Rio Branco is among Brazilian capitals—Manaus, Porto Alegre, Curitiba, Florianópolis, Belo Horizonte, Salvador and São Luís—in alert/at-risk/high-risk SRAG activity per the Fiocruz InfoGripe bulletin (Aug 6, 2026). The assessment covers the last two epidemiological weeks; Acre also ranks among 14 states with SRAG incidence at alert/risk/high risk during SE 30 (Jul 26–Aug 1). National SRAG trends overall are declining or stabilizing. RSV remains the leading cause of SRAG in the period, representing 54.1% of positives in the past four weeks, followed by rhinovirus (26.1%), influenza B (9.3%), influenza A (7.3%), and SARS-CoV-2 (1.8%). SRAG burden is higher in young children, while influenza A is a major mortality driver among older adults. Recommendations: up-to-date vaccination, regular handwashing, avoiding close contact with symptomatic individuals, and masking in health facilities; symptomatic people should stay home or wear a mask when leaving the house.

triage.headline_ja: リオ・ブランコ、SRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）症例で警戒レベルにある州都の一つに
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおける季節性のRSV・インフルエンザによるSRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）のサーベイランス報告であり、全国的には減少・安定傾向にある。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、通常の季節性呼吸器感染症動向報告に該当する。
triage.notes: Fiocruz InfoGripeによる定例のSRAGサーベイランス速報。RSVが主要因（54.1%）、全国的傾向は減少・安定化中であり、季節性の通常報告と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : un CTE de 80 lits inauguré à Kasenyi pour renforcer la riposte contre Ebola à la frontière avec l'Ouganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: an 80-bed Ebola Treatment Center inaugurated in Kasenyi to strengthen the Ebola response at the border with Uganda.
article.articleSummary: An 80-bed Ebola Treatment Center (ETC) was inaugurated on August 7, 2026, in Kasenyi, Ituri's Tchomia health zone, near the Uganda border, to bolster cross-border responses to Ebola virus disease. The integrated facility enhances detection, isolation, and management of suspected or confirmed Ebola cases and includes a mobile diagnostic laboratory to shorten delays between alert and confirmation. The opening underscores intensified bilateral cooperation between the DRC and Uganda, with coordinated surveillance, infection prevention, and laboratory diagnostics in this high-mobility frontier area. The outbreak remains active in five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, and Tshopo. INSP data for Aug 5–6, 2026 report 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths (case fatality rate 45.7%), with 793 recovered and 694 currently in care. Kasenyi ETC strengthens response capacity and cross-border coordination to curb transmission across the border.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州：ウガンダ国境沿いのカセニィにエボラ対応強化のため80床の治療センターが開設
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行が5州に拡大し、確定4,053例・死亡1,850例（致死率45.7%）と深刻。ウガンダ国境地帯での越境対応強化が報じられており、国際的拡大リスクと社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC国内（イトゥリ州カセニィ）でのエボラ治療センター開設に関するもの。ウガンダは国境協力の文脈で言及されているが、流行自体はDRC国内で発生しているためウガンダは対象国リストに含まれず除外。既存の大規模流行の継続報告であり、既にWHO等で把握されている可能性が高いが、フルRRAでの継続評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الخنازير البرية تحمل بكتيريا خارقة 98.2بالمائة من سلالات الإشريكية القولونية مقاومة للمضادات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Wild boars carry superbugs: 98.2% of E. coli strains are antibiotic-resistant.
article.articleSummary: Wild boars in Brazil harbor antibiotic-resistant Escherichia coli, presenting a health risk beyond agricultural and ecological concerns. A Brazilian study reports that 98.2% of E. coli strains isolated from these wild boars are resistant to antibiotics, indicating widespread antimicrobial resistance in wildlife. The findings show that wild boars carry bacteria resistant to multiple antibiotic classes, opening the door for transmission of these bacteria to other hosts and environments. The report underscores wildlife as a reservoir for antimicrobial resistance and highlights a potential transmission pathway at Brazil's wildlife interfaces. Referred to as 'superbugs,' these resistant bacteria reflect a growing concern as of 2026-08-08.

triage.headline_ja: 野生イノシシがスーパーバグを保有：大腸菌株の98.2%が抗生物質耐性
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの野生イノシシにおける薬剤耐性大腸菌の研究報告であり、ヒトへの感染事例や急性の公衆衛生事象は確認されていないが、薬剤耐性菌のリザーバーとしての懸念があり継続監視が望ましい。
triage.notes: 本記事はヒト感染事例を報告しておらず、野生動物における抗菌薬耐性(AMR)の研究結果に関するもの。One Healthの観点から薬剤耐性菌の拡散リスクとして注視すべきだが、現時点で緊急のRRA実施を要する公衆衛生事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 15 cases in Jul, 11 in Aug: Dengue stings city
article.articleSummary: Lucknow reports dengue cases rising with seasonal monsoon. 15 dengue cases in July and 11 infections in the first five days of August, signaling a preliminary uptick though no hotspot identified. All recorded patients this year have mild illness; no severe dengue, deaths reported. Common symptoms include fever, headache, body ache, weakness, with nausea and vomiting in some patients. Health officials warn to seek urgent care for severe signs: severe abdominal pain, repeated vomiting, gum or nasal bleeding, blood in vomit or stools, extreme weakness. District malaria officer Dr Ritu Srivastava said anti-mosquito measures are being implemented citywide, including surveillance and efforts to eliminate breeding sites. Residents are advised to prevent water accumulation in coolers, containers, rooftops, and other sites where Aedes mosquitoes breed, as cases remain sporadic across the city.

triage.headline_ja: 7月に15件、8月に11件：デング熱が市内で猛威
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱の軽度な増加であり、重症例・死亡例なく、地域の通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内である。
triage.notes: 季節性のモンスーンに伴うデング熱の軽度な増加を報じるローカルニュース。全症例が軽症で、地元当局が通常の蚊対策を実施中。フルRRAの必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: الخنازير البرية تحمل "بكتيريا خارقة".. 98.2% من سلالات الإشريكية القولونية مقاومة للمضادات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Wild boars carry 'superbugs'... 98.2% of Escherichia coli strains are resistant to antibiotics
article.articleSummary: As of Aug 8, 2026, a Brazil-based study collected rectal swabs from 100 European wild boars and found Escherichia coli in 56 animals; among those, 55 isolates (98.2%) were multidrug-resistant to multiple antibiotics, notably sulfonamides, tetracyclines, amoxicillin, ampicillin, and doxycycline. Salmonella appeared in one sample but lacked the virulence and resistance genes studied, suggesting lower immediate risk. The wild boars’ mobility between forests, farms, and human environments creates multiple pathways for resistance spread across ecosystems, potentially reaching humans via environmental and food chains. The findings underscore the need for integrated antimicrobial resistance surveillance across wildlife and the environment, not solely clinical settings.

article.articleHeadline: A leishmaniose, conhecida como calazar, ainda desafia a saúde pública; saiba identificar os alertas - Tribuna do Norte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leishmaniasis, known as kala-azar, continues to pose a challenge to public health; learn how to identify the warning signs.
article.articleSummary: Visceral leishmaniasis, known as kala-azar, is a zoonotic disease that remains a challenge for veterinary and public health. WHO notes Brazil is among six countries that account for about 90% of cases. The Agosto Verde campaign aims to raise awareness on prevention, early diagnosis, and control, focusing on endemic regions—North, Northeast, interior of São Paulo, and Mato Grosso do Sul—where urban expansion has increased contact with the vector. Transmission occurs by sandfly bite, with dogs as the main reservoir; human-to-dog or dog-to-human transmission is not direct. Symptoms in dogs include dermatologic signs (alopecia, crusting around eyes and ears, non-healing wounds, nose depigmentation), plus weight loss, apathy, lameness, epistaxis, and ocular issues. Diagnosis starts with serologic blood tests and a screening test, followed by confirmatory laboratory or molecular tests on skin, bone marrow, or lymph nodes. Early detection reduces spread and organ damage; mortality often stems from chronic kidney disease.

article.articleHeadline: When bird flu hit the UK, suffering seabirds died in their thousands. Australia's wild flocks will soon do the same
article.articleSummary: H5N1 avian influenza (2.3.4.4b) has reached Australia, detected two months ago in migratory seabirds likely from subantarctic breeding grounds. A government analysis found almost 400 bird and mammal species at high risk. Europe’s 2022 outbreaks triggered mass mortality in Sandwich terns and tens of thousands of deaths; brain involvement causes 'star-gazing'. Australia is expected to experience large mortalities and possible species losses, especially given half the country’s birds are endemic. Most at risk are Sulidae (gannets, boobies), cranes, darters, Anatidae (ducks, geese, swans), and Laridae (gulls, terns, noddies); pelicans, crows, ravens, falcons and kestrels are also susceptible. Pinnipeds have suffered tens of thousands of deaths abroad (Peru, Chile, Brazil, Uruguay, Argentina), and on Australia’s Heard and McDonald Islands; three resident Australian species—the New Zealand fur seal, Australian fur seal, and Australian sea lion—face very high risk, with potential severe declines. Continent-wide spread raises extinction risk.

article.articleHeadline: 杭州女子腳趾有傷口遭流浪狗舔舐 醫生評估屬狂犬病三級暴露 - 星島日報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hangzhou woman's toe wound licked by a stray dog; doctor assesses it as rabies exposure Category III - Sing Tao Daily.
article.articleSummary: Hangzhou, China: A woman’s toe wound, from paronychia, was licked by a stray dog, and clinicians deemed it rabies exposure Category III (highest risk). Under China’s 2023 Rabies Exposure Prevention and Post-Exposure Handling guidelines, licking broken skin requires immediate wound care, rabies immunoglobulin, and rabies vaccination. Rabies is nearly 100% fatal without timely post-exposure prophylaxis, but proper, prompt treatment can prevent disease. The doctor also notes that mucous membrane exposure—saliva reaching the mouth, nose, or eyes—poses Category III risk, including close contact or kissing with potentially infected animals. For uncertain skin integrity, a simple self-check involves swabbing the area with alcohol; if it stings, seek evaluation at a rabies clinic to determine the need for preventive treatment.

article.articleHeadline: Gripe aviária é confirmada em marreco no Parque Ibirapuera
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza confirmed in a duck at Ibirapuera Park.
article.articleSummary: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) confirmed in a wild duck (Dendrocygna viduata, irerê) at Ibirapuera Park in São Paulo’s South Zone, Brazil. The case, identified and confirmed by the Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense after clinical examination and sampling, is isolated with no link to commercial poultry or food production. The incident was reported by the Secretariat of Agriculture and Supply (SAA); there are no commercial poultry facilities within 10 km, and enhanced epidemiological surveillance will monitor for mortality or clinical signs in the area. São Paulo and Brazil’s sanitary status remains unchanged with respect to the World Organisation for Animal Health (OMSA). No human cases have been reported in the state. Avian influenza can infect humans via direct or prolonged contact with infected birds or contaminated materials; human-to-human transmission is extremely rare, and symptoms resemble influenza.

article.articleHeadline: Governo de SP confirma caso isolado de gripe aviária em ave silvestre no Parque do Ibirapuera
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo State Government confirms an isolated case of avian influenza in a wild bird at Ibirapuera Park.
article.articleSummary: Isolated case of highly pathogenic avian influenza detected in a wild duck (irerê) found at Ibirapuera Park in São Paulo city’s southern zone. Diagnosis by the Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense after analysis of samples. The event is restricted to wildlife with no link to commercial poultry or the food-supply network. The World Organisation for Animal Health classification remains unchanged; no export restrictions on Brazilian chicken meat and eggs. Poultry production continues safely and consumption of poultry products remains allowed. No commercial farms within 10 kilometers of the park. Authorities will intensify regional surveillance and implement public-education actions with local residents. As of 2026-08-08, no human cases have been reported in São Paulo. Health authorities monitor exposed individuals and maintain contingency planning with ongoing surveillance in parks, zoos, and reserves to contain the virus.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Mambasa : l'installation de laboratoires mobiles recommandé dans deux zones de santé - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Mambasa: The installation of mobile laboratories is recommended in two health zones - ACP.
article.articleSummary: As of August 8, 2026, Ebola in Mambasa, Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, prompts acceleration of mobile laboratory installations in two health zones of Mambasa Territory. Marie Noëlle Anotane, coordinator of SOCICO/Mambasa, urged provincial health authorities to finalize the lab in Mambasa amid 31 total cases (13 in one zone, 18 in surrounding areas). A mobile lab in Nia-Nia already enables local sample processing, but the Mambasa and Mandima zones still face analytical delays. Expanding mobile laboratories is expected to shorten the time to test results and improve management of individuals in isolation, potentially reducing transmission during this Ebola outbreak.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Kisangani : les partenaires appelés à soutenir le pilier de communication - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kisangani: partners called on to support the communications pillar - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Kisangani, Tshopo Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with nine confirmed cases and five deaths (local case fatality rate 56%) reported as of August 8, 2026. Health authorities call on technical and financial partners to robustly support the communications pillar to curb spread and counter misinformation. To avoid a scenario like Ituri, a multisectoral coordination cell will be established, reinforcing community engagement through religious leaders, youth groups, and local media. Minister Dr. Simon Bokongo emphasizes that Ebola response is not a local issue and that the press must be integrated to relay messages continuously. The plan involves collaboration with the Congolese Press Agency and RTNC, integrating media into planning. Direct partner assistance for communication and awareness is deemed essential to strengthen the response.

triage.notes: イトゥリ州での過去の流行拡大を懸念し、多分野連携体制の構築とコミュニケーション強化のための対外支援が要請されている。致死率56%と高く、感染拡大防止のための情報発信体制強化が急務とされる。

article.articleHeadline: Una nueva matanza de las ADF deja al menos 13 muertos en el norte de RDC en plena crisis del ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new massacre by the ADF leaves at least 13 dead in northern DRC amid the Ebola crisis.
article.articleSummary: 13 people were killed in Ituri province’s Mambasa territory, Banana École, overnight August 7–8, 2026, in an attack by the Islamic State–linked Allied Democratic Forces (ADF). The assault followed a lethal pattern: bodies in streets and homes set ablaze, with several civilians reported missing or abducted. Civil society groups had warned authorities days earlier about ADF presence in parts of the territory. The ADF have destabilized northern DR Congo for years, triggering mass displacement that hinders Ebola response efforts and risks faster transmission of the outbreak, which, since May 2026, has become the country’s worst-documented Ebola crisis with a provisional death toll exceeding 1,800. The violence further endangers health workers and compounds containment challenges in this Ebola hotspot.

triage.headline_ja: ADFによる新たな虐殺、エボラ危機の最中にコンゴ民主共和国北部で少なくとも13人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 2026年5月以降のDRCエボラ流行は死者1,800人超と同国史上最悪級であり、武装勢力の攻撃により住民避難が拡大し感染対応が阻害されているため、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクを伴うシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はADFによる武力攻撃だが、DRCの過去最悪規模のエボラ流行（死者1,800人超）を背景情報として含み、紛争による対応阻害が感染拡大リスクを高めている点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Brazzaville: Lutte contre les épidémies - Les employés de la maison de retraite Kambissi en formation
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Brazzaville: Fighting epidemics - The staff of the Kambissi nursing home in training
article.articleSummary: Brazzaville, Republic of the Congo—staff at the Seniors Kambissi nursing home were trained on cholera and Ebola fever prevention on 7 August 2026. The session, organized by Globus in partnership with CNORE, emphasized hygiene best practices and surveillance measures to curb epidemic spread, with instructional presentations and take-home guidance for responding to acute diarrhea. Informational leaflets and posters, developed with the Ministry of Health, were distributed to reinforce prevention messages. Administrative head Clémence Makanga welcomed the training, noting improved measures for elderly care. The event aligns with ongoing public health engagement; Globus highlighted its socio-economic work and thanked First Lady Antoinette Sassou Nguesso. Background context includes access to potable water for over 300,000 Brazzaville residents created through Russian partners and the Globus project, aiding cholera prevention. The initiative also introduced the Avenir.cg platform for civic tasks.

article.articleHeadline: La OMS recomienda ensayos con la vacuna Ervebo para intentar frenar el actual brote en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO recommends Ervebo vaccine trials to try to curb the current outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to surge, with 1,850 deaths reported to date and the largest infection burden ever recorded there, and the second-highest globally. This is the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the fastest growing since its declaration. The current outbreak involves the Bundibugyo variant, for which no vaccine or treatment exists. The World Health Organization has urged prioritizing Merck's Ervebo vaccine in human trials for this outbreak, following a July 31 technical group meeting. In animal studies, Ervebo conferred up to 75% survival in primates and 100% in ferrets, with vaccinated animals showing milder symptoms and lower viral loads. Antibodies against Bundibugyo induced by Ervebo were weaker than those against the Zaire variant but appeared to have some neutralizing activity. The WHO declared a PHEIC on May 16; the recommendation supports randomized trials vaccinating contacts with no identified safety risks.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国での現行アウトブレイク抑制のためErvebo（エルベボ）ワクチン試験を推奨

triage.notes: 既存のPHEIC宣言済みイベントであり、既にフルRRA対象として継続監視されている可能性が高い。ワクチン開発・治験動向のフォローアップが重要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, the epidemic is running faster than relief efforts
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo caused by Bundibugyo virus is expanding faster than the response. Africa CDC and WHO urge stronger containment: faster diagnostics, contact tracing, new beds, ambulances, labs, and greater health worker support. A WHO-Africa CDC mission on 4–5 August identified Bunia, Ituri, as the epicenter. By 4 August, Congo reported 3,973 confirmed cases, 1,801 deaths, and 776 recoveries across 51 health zones in five provinces; 99 new cases and 52 deaths were recorded in the last 24 hours. About 90% of infections are in Ituri; only 75% of contacts are followed up (target 95%). Hospitals are strained; North Kivu centers operate at 139% capacity, and Ebola cases have appeared in five of 69 IDP camps in Ituri. The virus may have circulated since January in Mongbwalu. Ervebo is being tested; trials include monoclonal antibodies, remdesivir, and a Bundibugyo-targeted vaccine candidate. No travel restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、流行の拡大が支援活動の速度を上回る
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスによる大規模流行が進行中で、死亡者数・患者数が急増し医療体制が逼迫、WHO・Africa CDCが緊急対応を要請しているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 感染は主にイツリ州（特にブニア、モングワロ）に集中し、北キブ州の医療施設も139%の収容能力で運用中。IDPキャンプ内での感染例も確認されており、接触者追跡率が目標の95%に対し75%と不十分な状況。国境を越えた拡大の直接的証拠は記事内になし。

article.articleHeadline: Taiwan reports first confirmed case of locally transmitted typhoid fever
article.articleSummary: Taiwan's CDC confirms the first locally acquired typhoid fever case of 2026: a woman in her 70s from central Taiwan with no travel history, who developed fever and diarrhea in mid-July, was hospitalized, diagnosed by testing, and is recuperating at home. Taiwan has four typhoid cases in 2026 (1 local, 3 imported); since 2022 there have been 40 cases (11 locally transmitted, 29 imported), with imported cases predominantly from Indonesia (22). Typhoid is caused by Salmonella Typhi; incubation is about 8–14 days (range 3–60). Transmission is via food or water contaminated with feces or urine from infected individuals or carriers. Symptoms include persistent fever, headache, fatigue, loss of appetite, abdominal pain, diarrhea, relative bradycardia, and trunk rash. Prevention emphasizes hand hygiene, boiled or bottled water, fully cooked foods, and avoiding cross-contamination; wash hands before meals, after toilet use, before handling food, and after diaper changes.

article.articleHeadline: Fermele industriale de pui favorizează apariția unor bacterii mai periculoase
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Industrial poultry farms promote the emergence of more dangerous bacteria.
article.articleSummary: Industrial intensive poultry farming accelerates Campylobacter transmission and evolution—the leading bacterial cause of gastroenteritis and may elevate resistance, complicating human treatment. A PNAS study shows exchange of Campylobacter lineages between wild birds and farmed chickens has intensified with expanding production. Dense farms create a mixing vessel where bacteria meet, evolve, and acquire new traits. Oxford’s Sam Sheppard notes growing chick populations have picked up more lineages from diverse wild birds, producing evolving strains with dangerous potential. In the UK, Campylobacter causes more gastroenteritis cases annually than other foodborne bacteria combined, with about 60–80% linked to handling raw chicken. Cross-contamination via juice onto surfaces or hands is possible. The study analyzed ~2,800 genomes from chickens and wild birds across 30 countries (1979–2024), including the UK, US, and China, finding domestic-wild exchanges ~100× pre-domestication. Global chicken numbers ~27 billion, ~70% of bird biomass, underscoring pathogen-evolution risk; calls to reassess production scale.

triage.headline_ja: 工業的養鶏場がより危険な細菌の出現を助長している
triage.triage_reason: 特定の国・地域における感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、複数国の遺伝子データを用いたカンピロバクター進化に関する学術研究の紹介記事であるため、シグナルとして扱う根拠がない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定のアウトブレイク事例ではなく、1979-2024年の30カ国・約2800ゲノムを用いたカンピロバクターの家禽-野鳥間伝播進化に関する学術研究（PNAS掲載）の紹介。中国は研究対象国の一つとして言及されているのみで、同国内での具体的な発生事例ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu: São Paulo records second case in a wild bird - 08/08/2026 - Environment - Folha
article.articleSummary: Second avian influenza case confirmed in São Paulo state in 2026, in a wild white-faced whistling duck (Dendrocygna viduata) found at Parque Ibirapuera, southern São Paulo. It is an isolated wild-bird case; no sanitary-status change for São Paulo or Brazil per the World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE). No commercial poultry establishments within 10 km of the location; epidemiological surveillance is underway in the area to detect additional cases. A previous avian influenza case was reported in July in Guaíra, also in a white-faced whistling duck.

triage.notes: 野生の口笛ガモ（Dendrocygna viduata）における単発症例。ヒトへの感染や商業養鶏場への波及は報告されておらず、OIEへの衛生ステータス変更報告もなし。動物衛生上のモニタリング事案として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: 開心遊泰淪惡夢1／登船未穿救生衣險落水　遊客控旅行社不甩防疫害全團染諾羅
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Happy trip to Thailand turns into a nightmare (Part 1) / Boarding the ship without a life jacket, nearly fell overboard; tourists blame the travel agency for ignoring epidemic-prevention measures, causing the entire group to contract Norovirus.
article.articleSummary: 22 travelers from a Taiwan-based travel agency’s six-day Chiang Mai tour to Thailand contracted Norovirus after trip leader Lin ignored epidemic-prevention and safety measures. On a Mekong River boat, no life jackets or safety briefing were provided, and passengers boarded a turbulent vessel; one husband nearly fell overboard. As vomiting and diarrhea emerged, Lin did not isolate the sick or enforce precautions, and even mocked two masked travelers as outdated. The entire group, including Lin, eventually fell ill. Return at Chiang Mai International Airport revealed visa-related difficulties for A, a Taiwanese woman traveling with her American husband; Lin remained indifferent. It later emerged that 22 participants included two solo travelers, the couple, and eighteen of Lin’s private friends; two elderly aunts who did not speak English were left lost at the airport and only found by airline staff. Critics accuse Lin of unprofessionalism and nepotism, endangering traveler safety and rights.

triage.headline_ja: 楽しいはずのタイ旅行が悪夢に(1)／船に乗る際に救命胴衣を着用せず転落しかける　旅行者が旅行会社を非難、防疫を怠り全員がノロウイルスに感染
triage.triage_reason: 特定のツアー団体22名に限定されたノロウイルス感染であり、旅行会社の対応不備をめぐる消費者トラブルが主題。公衆衛生上の広域拡大リスクや異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は旅行会社の防疫対応不備・接客トラブルに関する消費者問題が中心で、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての重要性は低い。台湾・米国は罹患者の国籍であり発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Eusébio adotará método Wolbachia contra dengue, zika e chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Eusébio will adopt the Wolbachia method to combat dengue, Zika, and chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: Eusébio, Brazil, will deploy a Wolbachia-based release program to curb dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The city allocated about R$60,000 for renovations, equipment, climate-control, and a vehicle to transport capsules. The Ministry of Health, Fiocruz, and Wolbito will provide technical support, supply Wolbachia-infected mosquito eggs, train staff, and oversee the project. The initiative will cover all of Eusébio, prioritizing areas with higher vector presence. Ovitramp surveillance since June will map Aedes aegypti to determine release points and capsule quantities. Trap installation runs through August; capsules arriving in September with releases planned from October for two to five months, quantities defined after mapping. Conventional vector control continues, aiming for 80–90% of mosquitoes free of arboviruses. Spillover to Itaitinga, Aquiraz, and Fortaleza will be monitored; LIRAa data for January–March 2027 is expected. Dengue had 25 confirmed cases January–June 2026; no chikungunya or Zika reported in that period.

triage.headline_ja: エウゼビオ市、デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱対策としてウォルバキア法を採用
triage.triage_reason: 報道内容は予防的なウォルバキア法導入という通常の公衆衛生対策であり、デング熱症例数も少なく異常事態や緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 2026年1-6月のデング熱確定症例は25件のみで、ジカ熱・チクングニア熱の報告はなし。ウォルバキア法導入は予防的な蚊媒介感染症対策プログラムであり、既存の緊急事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Nakes Tangani Ebola di RD Kongo Protes, Gaji 3 Bulan Belum Cair
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Healthcare workers treating Ebola in DR Congo protest; three months' pay has not been paid.
article.articleSummary: Dozens of healthcare workers treating the Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo protested on Tuesday, August 4, 2026, demanding salaries and allowances unpaid for nearly three months. The demonstration occurred as the government pursues its Ebola response in the region, with frontline staff warning that delayed pay could hamper medical services and emergency response on the ground. No case counts are provided in the report. The protest highlights financial strains facing the outbreak response and raises concerns about continuity of care, surveillance, and rapid reaction capacity amid ongoing Ebola management in eastern DRC. The event illustrates how workforce and funding gaps can threaten outbreak containment and patient outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ対応の医療従事者が抗議、3か月分の給与未払い
triage.triage_reason: エボラ対応中の医療従事者への給与未払いが対応能力・サーベイランスの継続性を脅かす可能性があり、WPRO基準（重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性）に複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラの新規症例情報ではなく、既存の対応体制における給与未払い抗議が主題。対応継続性へのリスクとして注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Blood Bag : रक्त पिशवीची एचआयव्ही, हिपॅटायटिस अन्‌ मलेरिया चाचणी बंधनकारक
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Blood Bag: HIV, Hepatitis and Malaria Testing Mandatory.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-08, Maharashtra's FDA has made HIV, Hepatitis, and Malaria testing mandatory for every blood bag, aiming to enhance safety, quality, and protection for patients and blood donors. The directive is accompanied by formal guidelines. FDA Commissioner Tukaram Mundhe has shifted his focus to blood banks, instructing all licensed blood centers in the state to immediately review their procedures and implement necessary improvements. The order emphasizes standardized, mandatory screening across blood centers to reduce risks associated with transfusion and to ensure consistent laboratory practices. While the report does not mention case counts or outbreaks, the move reflects a coordinated public-health effort to strengthen transfusion safety infrastructure and compliance across Maharashtra's licensed facilities.

triage.headline_ja: Blood Bag: 血液パックのHIV・肝炎・マラリア検査が義務化
triage.triage_reason: 感染症の発生や症例報告ではなく、輸血血液の安全性向上を目的とした行政的なスクリーニング義務化に関する規制発表であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は症例数やアウトブレイクに言及しておらず、マハーラーシュトラ州FDAによる血液バンクの検査基準強化という予防的・制度的措置に関する内容。感染症イベントとしての発生報告ではないため対象国リストへの該当なしと判断。

article.articleHeadline: CHDC Congo ghi nhận hơn 300 trẻ em tử vong vì Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo records more than 300 child deaths from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province continues since mid-May, with the region bearing the heaviest burden. Official figures show over 300 child deaths, accounting for roughly one-quarter of infections but nearly one-third of fatalities. More than 1 million people are displaced by conflict, with women and children making up about 80% of the displaced. UNICEF reports maternal mortality in Ituri has nearly doubled since the outbreak began, averaging six pregnancy-related deaths per week; pregnant women with Ebola face high miscarriage risk. The government, Africa CDC, UNICEF, and WHO have deployed about 13,000 community health workers, reached over 2.4 million people, and conducted around 500,000 household visits to counter misinformation and promote care-seeking. Separately, on Aug 7, WHO convened experts who urged randomized trials of Ervebo against Bundibugyo virus; Ervebo is licensed for Zaire ebolavirus. Trials remain prioritized; Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are still under development.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラで300人以上の子どもが死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱による多数の死者(子ども300人以上)、紛争による大規模避難民、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクを伴う継続的アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事象。
triage.notes: 既知の継続的アウトブレイク(2026年5月中旬以降)。WHOがBundibugyoウイルスに対するワクチン試験を検討中である点も注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: [자막뉴스] 어린이 사망자만 300명...바이러스 무차별 확산에 민주콩고 '초비상'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [Caption News] 300 children have died... The Democratic Republic of the Congo in a 'state of extreme emergency' due to the indiscriminate spread of the virus.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak is described as a state of extreme emergency. As of Aug 5, cumulative confirmed cases are 4,053 with 1,850 deaths (case fatality rate 45.7%), surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak. UNICEF says over 300 children have died; children account for about a quarter of confirmed cases but nearly a third of deaths. Fear has reduced hospital visits; health-service use in hardest-hit areas has fallen more than 40%, and prenatal care avoidance has nearly doubled maternal deaths. A potential spread to Kinshasa is being watched after a 32-year-old man on a Congo River vessel developed fever and diarrhea, disembarked, and died; the boat continued to Maluku (65 km from Kinshasa) where it was stopped. All 300 passengers were tested; 7 suspected cases tested negative. WHO recommends clinical trials of Ervebo in DRC, and authorities are strengthening ship surveillance into Kinshasa. About 3,000 community mobilizers have informed over 2.4 million people.

triage.headline_ja: [字幕ニュース] 子供の死者だけで300人...ウイルスの無差別な拡散で民主コンゴ「超非常事態」
triage.triage_reason: 致死率45.7%の大規模エボラアウトブレイクが2018-2020年流行を上回り、キンシャサへの拡大懸念も生じているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 首都キンシャサへの拡大が懸念される事例（船舶での発症・死亡例）が報告されており、監視強化中。WHOはErvebo臨床試験を推奨。続報での拡大状況確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: J&K Gets Rs 173.44 Crore for TB Elimination in Five Years
article.articleSummary: Jammu and Kashmir received Rs 173.44 crore and Ladakh Rs 21.81 crore under the National TB Elimination Programme via the National Health Mission. J&K’s annual allocations rose from Rs 23 crore (2021-22) to Rs 65.47 crore (2025-26); Ladakh rose from Rs 3.90 crore to Rs 5.16 crore. Universal drug-susceptibility testing (DST) and free TB drugs are emphasized, with 11,296 NAAT laboratories, 108 Line Probe Assay labs, 74 Liquid Culture labs, 37 Intermediate Reference Labs and six National Reference Labs. The programme has 815 DR-TB treatment centres and introduced the BPaLM regimen for DR-TB. National Health Mission funds NTEP via the RCH Flexipool. Globally, India accounted for 26% of TB deaths in 2023 (WHO Global TB Report 2024), 25% in 2024 (Global TB Report 2025). TB incidence fell 21% (237 to 187 per lakh, 2015–2024); mortality fell 25% (28 to 21). Treatment coverage rose to 92% by 2024 from 53% in 2015.

triage.headline_ja: ジャンムー・カシミール州、結核撲滅5カ年計画に173.44億ルピーを取得
triage.triage_reason: 国家結核撲滅プログラムへの予算配分に関する行政報道であり、異常な発生や急性の公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核撲滅プログラムへの予算配分と実績（罹患率・死亡率の減少、治療カバレッジ向上）に関する定期的な行政報告であり、緊急のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 200 Hari Mengawal Rifampisin: Pengalaman Menjadi Ayah dari Penyintas TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 200 Days of Rifampicin Monitoring: The Experience of Becoming a Father to a TB Survivor
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB), caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis, remains a leading killer. Indonesia has the second-highest global TB burden, just below India, with hundreds of thousands infected annually and about 120,000 deaths; roughly one life is lost every 14 hours. The piece follows a father whose daughter is diagnosed with TB, a revelation that shattered his optimism about infection risk. After months of cough, fever, and weight loss, Mantoux, blood tests, and chest X-ray confirmed TB. Treatment requires a long, daily six-month drug course, including rifampicin, challenging adherence. The father reorders daily life to sustain the regimen, likening it to a marathon toward his child’s recovery. The narrative highlights the emotional toll on families and the need for early detection, laboratory confirmation, and sustained therapy in a high-burden country as of 2026-08-09.

triage.headline_ja: リファンピシン投与200日間の記録：結核サバイバーの父としての経験
triage.triage_reason: 個人の闘病体験記であり、既知の風土病（結核）に関する一般的な啓発記事のため、新規シグナルとしての緊急性はない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシアにおける個人の結核闘病体験を扱う人間ドラマ記事。インドと比較した罹患率統計への言及はあるが、インドで発生している具体的イベントではないためインドはverified_locationsに含めない。結核は既知の風土病であり、突発的な公衆衛生イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo confirma caso de gripe aviária em marreco do Parque Ibirapuera
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo confirms avian influenza case in duck at Ibirapuera Park.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo confirms the second avian influenza case in wild birds this year, with the virus identified in an irerê (Dendrocygna viduata) found at Ibirapuera Park in the city’s southern zone. Confirmation occurred on Friday, 2026-08-07, after testing by the Federal Laboratory for Agricultural Defense. Officials say the event is isolated and there is no current change to São Paulo’s or Brazil’s sanitary status with respect to the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH). No commercial poultry farms were identified within 10 kilometers of the site. Regional Defesa Agropecuária teams are conducting epidemiological surveillance in the Ibirapuera area to check for additional cases among wild birds. The irerê is native to South America, tropical Africa, and the Antilles. A prior avian influenza case this year in the state also involved an irerê, found in July in Guaíra, interior of São Paulo.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ、イビラプエラ公園のカモで鳥インフルエンザ症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: 野鳥1羽での鳥インフルエンザ確認で、当局は孤立事例と説明し商業養鶏場への影響もなく、公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。
triage.notes: 野鳥（イレレ）での鳥インフルエンザ検出事例で、ヒト感染や家禽への波及は報告されていない。今年2例目だが当局は衛生状況に変化なしと説明。

article.articleHeadline: Número de casos de sarampo confirmados em São Paulo sobe para 23
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Number of confirmed measles cases in São Paulo rises to 23.
article.articleSummary: Measles (sarampo) outbreak in São Paulo, Brazil: 23 confirmed cases in the state as of Aug 8, 2026, with 20 in the city of São Paulo, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, and 1 in Guarulhos. The capital reports about 200 suspected cases under investigation. Vaccination efforts are intensifying in São Paulo and these municipalities to curb transmission. The campaign runs until Sept 1, including a Dia D on Aug 22 when all Basic Health Units (UBS) will be open; over 480 UBSs are participating. On Aug 7, more than 84,000 doses were administered. Vaccination hours are 7:00–19:00 at UBSs; weekends follow the same hours at Integrated Health Units (UBSIs). Target group: babies from 11 months to adults up to 59 years; all should be vaccinated, even if previously immunized. Pregnant and immunosuppressed individuals should not be vaccinated; lactating women may receive the vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州の麻疹確定症例数が23人に増加
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の確定23例・疑い約200例が報告され、大規模なワクチン接種キャンペーンが実施されており、行政の高い関心とヒト-ヒト感染拡大の可能性があるためフルリスク評価が望ましい。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・サンパウロ州における麻疹の国内発生に関するもので、他国への影響や渡航制限は言及されていない。行政による大規模ワクチン接種キャンペーンが進行中であり、地域的な感染拡大リスクが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: കൊതുക്​ നിയന്ത്രണം പാളുന്നു; ആശങ്കയായി വീണ്ടും ചിക്കുൻഗുനിയ വ്യാപനം | Mosquito control fails; Chikungunya outbreak a concern again
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mosquito control is failing; Chikungunya outbreak is a concern again.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak resurges in Kerala, India, with Thiruvananthapuram and surrounding districts reporting ongoing transmission. By August 7, 2026, the state had 114 laboratory-confirmed chikungunya cases and 63 suspected cases, plus one death. Official surveillance is judged by public health experts to underestimate true infections since chikungunya is rarely fatal and many patients are not hospitalized or tested. With rising cases amid monsoon-related warmth, Aedes mosquitoes proliferate, potentially fueling both chikungunya and dengue spread. Chikungunya reached Kerala during 2006-07 after originating in the 2004-05 Indian Ocean outbreaks, with recent years seeing renewed activity after a lull; prior reports occurred in 2019-20. High-risk groups include pregnant women, newborns, and individuals with diabetes or hypertension, who may suffer severe illness such as arthritis-like swelling, intense pain, and prolonged debility. The article provides no details on imported or exported cases. WHO had warned in July 2025 of a global resurgence risk.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊対策の失敗;再び懸念されるチクングニア熱の流行
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州で蚊媒介対策が機能せずチクングニア熱（確定114例、疑い63例、死亡1例）が再拡大しており、季節的要因での感染拡大リスクと社会的懸念が認められるため。
triage.notes: ケララ州（インド）における季節性チクングニア熱の再流行。過去にも2006-07年、2019-20年に発生歴あり、地域固有の周期的流行と考えられる。デング熱との同時拡大リスクにも言及あり。

article.articleHeadline: SP confirma segundo caso de gripe aviária do ano em ave encontrada no Ibirapuera
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo confirms the second avian influenza case this year in a bird found at Ibirapuera Park.
article.articleSummary: Second case of Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) in São Paulo state in 2026 was confirmed in a ireré (Dendrocygna viduata) found at Ibirapuera Park. Identification followed isolation, clinical examination, and sampling by the Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense (MAPA). The virus is considered isolated and not linked to commercial poultry or food production. No commercial poultry farms were within 10 km of the park. Regional surveillance will monitor the area, with guidance to residents. São Paulo reports no human cases to date. The first 2026 case, confirmed July 15 in the same species, involved a bird rescued in an urban area and taken to Guaíra Zoo (Barretos region). Because this concerns a wild bird, there is no embargo on meat or egg exports, nor a change in status with the World Organisation for Animal Health. Human infection occurs mainly via direct contact with contaminated animals; avoid touching dead birds.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、イビラプエラ公園で発見された鳥から今年2例目の鳥インフルエンザ感染例を確認
triage.triage_reason: 野生鳥での散発例で商業養鶏との関連はなく人への感染も報告なしだが、都市公園での検出かつ本年2例目であり継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 野生鳥（ireré）での孤立した検出で、商業養鶏場は10km圏内になく、貿易禁輸や動物衛生機関へのステータス変更もない。人への感染例なし。

article.articleHeadline: 跨境醫美風險大3-2》感染、壞死、非法填充物 醫揭跨境醫美風險
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: High Risks in Cross-Border Medical Aesthetics (3-2): Infection, Necrosis, Illegal Fillers — Doctors Reveal the Risks
article.articleSummary: Taipei plastic surgeons warn that cross-border cosmetic procedures pose serious post-operative risks for patients returning from China or Korea. Infections and vascular embolism causing tissue necrosis are common complications when follow-up care is limited after overseas treatments, and unapproved fillers used abroad can migrate and trigger chronic inflammation. Post-operative care is the main challenge: brief overseas stays hinder ongoing monitoring, leaving Taiwanese physicians without complete medical records and raising repair difficulty. Materials used overseas differ from Taiwan regulations; some Chinese clinics reportedly use unnamed 'Ukrainian gel' for breast and buttock augmentation, which may migrate; Korea’s exosome and stem cell therapies can produce facial irregularities requiring home-based treatment. Documented cases include nasal ala necrosis from vascular embolism after hyaluronic acid in Korea, leg infections after overseas fillers, and an umbilical deformity after abdominal lift in China. Travel after surgery also increases infection, thrombosis, and slower recovery; thorough pre-op evaluation and long-term post-care plans are essential.

triage.headline_ja: 越境医療美容のリスク大(3-2):感染、壊死、違法な充填物 — 医師が越境医療美容のリスクを明かす
triage.triage_reason: 個々の美容整形合併症に関する報道であり、感染症の集団発生・公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は越境美容医療（台湾人が中国・韓国で施術を受けた後の合併症）に関する個別医療リスクの解説記事であり、感染症のアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の脅威事案ではない。疾患名は'Unknown Illness'だが、これは美容整形後の局所感染・壊死等であり、伝染性疾患ではないため対象国verified_locationsは該当なしとした。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak have now surpassed 4,000 cases
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases, reaching 4,053 with 1,850 deaths as of 9 August 2026. Declared May 15, it is the second-largest Ebola epidemic on record and the fastest-spreading, behind only the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone, ~28,000). True scale likely higher; analyses suggest the virus was active in Ituri by January or earlier, with more than 500 suspected cases from mid-Jan to May 15. Confirmed infections are in five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. Delayed detection, overstretched surveillance, ongoing conflict, and lack of approved vaccines or treatments for this strain have allowed the disease to outrun containment, with displacement and insecurity further complicating response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、感染者数が4000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行が4,000症例・1,850死亡に達し、史上2番目の規模かつ最速拡大とされ、複数州に拡大し封じ込めが失敗している。公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にシエラレオネ、アンゴラ、リベリア、ギニアが含まれるが、これらは過去の2014-2016年流行との比較文脈で言及されているのみで、現行のアウトブレイクはDRC国内（Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo）に限定されているためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai: BMC Employee Dies After Fall During Dengue Breeding Site Inspection
article.articleSummary: 47-year-old Pandurang Todkar, a BMC Pest Control Operation Department worker, died after falling 5–7 feet while inspecting a suspected dengue breeding site at BDD Chawl No. 6-A, Bhoiwada, central Mumbai, around 3 pm. He was taken to King Edward Memorial Hospital and pronounced dead on arrival. Mayor Ritu Tawde visited the hospital, offered condolences, and directed pension and an eligible heir’s municipal job. The incident comes as Mumbai records a July 2026 surge in monsoon diseases: malaria up from 655 in June to 1,380 in July; dengue 266 to 466; gastroenteritis 603 to 851; Covid-19 27 to 58. The BMC’s citywide survey through July 26 screened 6,51,336 houses, 23,09,842 residents, collected 75,650 blood samples, and organized 123 health camps, with 52,286 leptospirosis preventive treatments. Citizens urged to take precautions against mosquito- and water-borne diseases.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイ:デング熱発生源調査中の転落によりBMC職員死亡
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はデング熱発生源調査中の労災死亡事故であり、感染症そのものの異常な増加や重大な公衆衛生上のリスクは示されていない。付随するモンスーン期の感染症統計は季節的な増加であり特に異常性はない。
triage.notes: 記事の主な内容は労災死亡事故であり、感染症サーベイランスデータ（マラリア・デング熱・胃腸炎・COVID-19のモンスーン期増加）は季節的傾向として言及されているのみで、異常な流行や国際的懸念を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: JPSC Protest: रांची छात्र आंदोलन में संक्रमण और डिहाइड्रेशन का खतरा, अनशनकारी राहुल क्रांति अस्पताल में भर्ती - ranchi student protest health risks rise amid rain and humidity
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: JPSC Protest: Risk of infection and dehydration in the Ranchi student protest; hunger-striker Rahul Kranti admitted to hospital
article.articleSummary: Jaipal Singh Mundu Stadium in Ranchi, Jharkhand, where students protest alleged irregularities in JPSC and JSSC, faces health risks due to rain and humidity. Crowded, open-air conditions have raised concerns about viral infections and dehydration among marchers, with symptoms including headaches, sore throat, weakness, and fever. Palamu resident Rahul Kranti, fasting amid the protest, developed fever and was diagnosed with a viral infection; his condition is currently stable under medical supervision. At Sadar Hospital, one protester was admitted while another fainted and received IV fluids before discharge after evaluation. Officials warn that dense crowds heighten transmission risk and call for regular medical check-ups, adequate medicines, clean drinking water, sanitation, and essential health facilities to protect protesters during the ongoing demonstrations.

triage.headline_ja: JPSC抗議活動:ランチーの学生デモで感染症と脱水症状のリスク上昇、ハンガーストライキ参加者ラーフル・クランティ氏が入院
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、抗議デモにおける個別の体調不良（ウイルス性感染症・脱水）事例であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 疾患名は「Unknown Illness」だが、記事内容は特定病原体による感染症アウトブレイクではなく、抗議活動参加者の個別の体調不良（発熱・脱水）に関する報道。公衆衛生イベントとしての基準を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: La dengue évolue de manière complexe à Hà Tĩnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever is evolving in a complex way in Hà Tĩnh.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreaks in Hà Tĩnh Province, Vietnam, remain ongoing and complex. The Vũng Áng area (Kỳ Long housing complex) has reported 114 cases since April 6, with no new cases in the past 8 days, indicating a prolonged transmission marked by persistence of Aedes mosquitoes and environmental challenges. A new focus was detected on August 4 in Tan Đức village, Ky Hoa commune, with 5 cases confirmed as of August 9. Hà Tĩnh CDC, working with Ky Hoa People's Committee and local health stations, has implemented outbreak measures including environmental sanitation, larval and nymph destruction, and household-level insecticide spraying. Plans to mobilize residents and authorities for sanitation campaigns and larval control aim to curb spread and prevent a larger outbreak amidst unfavorable weather (periods of sun followed by rain) that sustain mosquito breeding.

triage.headline_ja: ハティン省でデング熱が複雑な様相を呈している
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで毎年発生する風土病的なデング熱の局地的流行であり、症例数も小規模（114例＋5例）で重症度や異常性を示す情報がなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 地元当局（Hà Tĩnh CDC）が既に環境衛生・幼虫駆除・殺虫剤散布などの対策を実施中であり、外部支援の必要性は示されていない。季節性のデング熱流行として通常の監視対象に留まる。
